The adopted modified inorganic nanometer oxide can make the hydrophilic area in the anion exchange membrane more sufficient, chain accumulation in the anion exchange membrane is broken, then impedance is reduced, the conductivity is improved, meanwhile, the introduction of the inorganic nanometer oxide can further reduce swelling of the membrane, the size stability of the membrane is improved, and the service life of the membrane is prolonged.
Applicants: QINGHE YUANTAI CHANGZHOU NEW MATERIAL TECH CO LTD

Title: Cylindrical anion exchange membrane type electrolytic cell
Abstract: The invention discloses a cylindrical anion exchange membrane type electrolytic cell which comprises a front end cover and a rear end cover, and a shell is arranged between the front end cover and the rear end cover; a cathode electrolyte inlet, an anode electrolyte inlet, a cathode gas outlet, an anode gas outlet, a cathode electrode and an anode electrode are arranged on the front end cover; and the rear end cover is provided with a catholyte outlet and an anolyte outlet. According to the cylindrical anion exchange membrane type electrolytic cell, the hydrogen production efficiency of the electrolytic cell can be improved, and the energy utilization rate is increased.

Title: Anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production electrolytic bath
Abstract: The utility model relates to an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production electrolytic bath, which comprises a plurality of membrane electrode assemblies, a bipolar plate, collector plates on two sides, insulating spacers on two sides and end plates on two sides, and each membrane electrode assembly comprises an anion exchange membrane, a cathode and an anode. The anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production electrolytic cell comprises a cathode and anode in-vitro gas-liquid circulation channel, and the cathode and anode in-vitro gas-liquid circulation channel comprises an electrolyte inlet main path, an electrolyte outlet main path, an oxygen outlet main path and a hydrogen outlet main path and is used for connecting liquid inlets or gas outlets corresponding to all small chambers in parallel through branches. And the adjacent small chambers near the flow fields on the two sides of the bipolar plate are completely isolated from each other in the lateral direction.

Title: Anion exchange membrane, preparation method thereof and application of anion exchange membrane in flow battery and hydrogen production electrolytic cell
Abstract: The invention belongs to the field of ion exchange membranes, and discloses an anion exchange membrane and a preparation method thereof, and application of the anion exchange membrane in a flow battery and a hydrogen production electrolytic bath. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, copolymerizing a tetraphenyl ethylene-vinyl monomer and a styrene monomer through solution polymerization to obtain a copolymer A; carrying out chloromethylation reaction on the copolymer A to obtain a copolymer B; and finally reacting the copolymer B with trimethylamine to obtain a high-molecular polymer C. The high-molecular polymer C can be prepared into an anion exchange membrane, and the membrane is prepared by using common polar high-boiling-point solvents such as N, N-dimethylformamide and the like through a solution tape casting method. The anion exchange membrane can be applied to a flow battery, can improve coulombic efficiency and energy efficiency in a vanadium flow battery system, and ensures cycling stability; the composite material can be especially applied to AEM hydrogen production electrolytic cells, and has excellent durability, high ionic conductivity and mechanical properties.

Title: Anion exchange polymer, anion exchange membrane, method and device
Abstract: According to the anion exchange polymer, the anion exchange membrane, the method and the device provided by the invention, a cationic group with high alkali resistance is introduced into a polyaryl polymer structure, and meanwhile, a cationic side chain is introduced, so that the ionic conductivity and the alkali-resistant stability of the anion exchange polymer are synchronously improved; the anion exchange membrane prepared from the anion exchange polymer has the advantages of excellent ionic conductivity and alkali-resistant stability, can stably operate for a long time in a high pH value environment, and is not easy to degrade or reduce the performance. Therefore, the anion exchange membrane has remarkable advantages in electrochemical processes such as water electrolysis hydrogen production, so that the anion exchange membrane has a wide application prospect in electrochemical devices such as a water electrolysis reactor and the like.
Applicants: HUANENG YIMIN COAL & ELECTRICITY CO LTD;;HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RES INST

Title: Method for treating anion exchange membrane by solvothermal method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to a method for treating an anion exchange membrane by a solvothermal method and application thereof. The method comprises the following steps: S000, preparing the anion exchange membrane; s100, cutting the anion exchange membrane to a certain size, placing the anion exchange membrane in a polytetrafluoroethylene reaction kettle containing an ethylene glycol/water mixed solution, and placing the polytetrafluoroethylene reaction kettle in a drying oven for heating; and S200, taking out the anion exchange membrane, washing the anion exchange membrane with deionized water, then placing the anion exchange membrane in 1M KOH, and soaking the anion exchange membrane for a certain time until the anion exchange membrane generates sufficient ion exchange. According to the invention, an effective ion transmission channel in the anion exchange membrane is optimized while the mechanical strength of the membrane is not obviously changed, and conduction of OH <-> in the membrane in a catalytic process is accelerated. The mechanical strength of the membrane and transmission of OH <-> are effectively balanced, and the catalytic current density of an AEM electrolytic tank is improved.

Title: COATING OF ANION EXCHANGE MEMBRANES
Abstract: The invention relates to the coating of anion exchange membranes with catalytically active substances. The catalytically actively coated anion exchange membranes are used in electrochemical cells, especially for water electrolysis. The problem addressed by the invention is that of specifying a process for coating an anion exchange membrane which can be conducted at relatively low temperatures. This problem is solved by a swelling step. Aside from the swelling step and the processing temperature, the sequence of the process according to the invention resembles a decal process. However, the use of the partly liquid swelling agent means that the process according to the invention can be considered to be a wet process. The process enables the processing of anion-conducting polymers at moderate temperatures. The anion-conducting polymers may be present in the anion exchange membrane and/or in the composition that is applied to the anion exchange membrane. The advantage of the process according to the invention is that it can be conducted at comparatively low temperatures, namely below 100°C.

Title: Enhanced anion exchange membrane for hydrogen production through water electrolysis and preparation method of enhanced anion exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention discloses an enhanced anion-exchange membrane for hydrogen production through water electrolysis and a preparation method of the enhanced anion-exchange membrane. The enhanced anion exchange membrane is composed of polymer resin A (side chain functionalized poly (p-terphenyl piperidine) polymer) and a base material modified by a semi-interpenetrating polymer (SIPN). The polymer resin takes alkali-resistant polyterphenyl piperidine as a main chain and is laterally grafted with a quaternary ammonium cation alkyl side chain containing a hydrophilic group, transmission sites of OH <-> are increased under the condition that the functionalization degree of the main chain is certain, and a microphase separation form is effectively constructed through interaction of the hydrophobic polymer main chain and the hydrophilic functionalized alkyl side chain, so that the polymer resin is prepared. The ionic conductivity of the membrane is greatly improved. According to a semi-interpenetrating network structure formed based on SIPN, high-molecular resin and a base material are tightly combined, and the problem that a composite membrane in the market is too high in gas permeability is solved.

Title: Composite alkaline electrolyte for protecting anion exchange membrane in electrolysis process
Abstract: The invention belongs to the field of new energy, and discloses a composite alkaline electrolyte for protecting an anion exchange membrane in an electrolysis process, which comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 0.6-5.6% of strong base, 0.1-5% of strong base weak acid salt, 0.01-0.3% of surfactant and the balance of water. According to the composite alkaline electrolyte disclosed by the invention, the OH concentration is remarkably reduced through the pH regulation effect of the buffer salt, and the corrosion damage of traditional alkaline liquor to the surface of an anion exchange membrane is effectively inhibited; the surfactant can promote bubble coalescence and rapid separation from the surface of the electrode, improve the available area of the surface of the electrode, reduce the mass transfer resistance of the edge of the anion-exchange membrane, improve the electrochemical reaction efficiency, significantly improve the overall performance of the battery, and effectively solve the problem of corrosion degradation of the anion-exchange membrane in a high-temperature and strong-alkali environment. And the performance of the electrolyte can be kept stable within the temperature range of 40-90 DEG C, so that the long-term operation stability of the battery is greatly improved.

Title: AEM ELECTROLYZER WITH STRUCTURAL GASKETS
Abstract: An AEM electrolyzer comprises structural end elements (20, 30) and an electrolytic structure (22) comprising a plurality of electrolytic cells (40) to which respective gasket assemblies (50) completely made of elastomeric material are associated and in which portions of anode side inlet channels (23) and outlet channels (24) and of cathode side inlet channels (25) and outlet channels (26) are obtained, while a pressurisable chamber is obtained between at least one of the end elements (20, 30) and the electrolytic structure (22) to compensate for the gas pressure in the electrolytic structure itself. An AEM electrolyzer is obtained with reduced production costs and high electrical efficiency.

Title: Alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell
Abstract: The invention discloses an alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell which comprises a cathode end plate, a cathode plate, a gasket, an anode plate and an anode end plate, and the cathode end plate, the cathode plate, the gasket, the anode plate and the anode end plate are fastened by screws through the peripheral screw holes. The alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell has the advantages of being simple in structure, convenient to assemble and fast in response, can well adapt to the volatility of renewable energy sources, is applied to the field of renewable energy source hydrogen production, and can improve the economical efficiency. The device can work under the alkaline or pure water condition, expensive precious metal does not need to be used as an electrode catalyst, and the cost of a hydrogen production system is greatly reduced.
Applicants: YANGTZE RIVER DELTA RES INSTITUTE UESTC HUZHOU

Title: Polyaryl-3-piperidone polymer, anion exchange membrane, and preparation method and application of polyaryl-3-piperidone polymer and anion exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention discloses a polyaryl-3-piperidone polymer, an anion exchange membrane and a preparation method and application of the polyaryl-3-piperidone polymer and the anion exchange membrane. A main chain of the polymer does not contain ether bonds and has cation 3-piperidine onium salt, so that the polymer has good alkali-resistant stability; through copolymerization with a hydrophobic unit, modification of a polymer is realized, a polymer with a hydrophilic/hydrophobic controllable structure is formed, and then the anion exchange membrane with excellent mechanical stability, ionic conductivity and alkali-resistant stability and relatively low swelling ratio is prepared. A membrane electrode further assembled by the prepared anion exchange membrane material can be used for alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production and alkaline fuel cells.

Title: Conjugated branched anion exchange membrane, preparation method and application
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of alkaline water electrolyzers, and particularly discloses a preparation method and application of a conjugated branched anion-exchange membrane, a series of conjugated branched anion-exchange polymers are prepared by changing the types and proportions of monomers, solvents and catalysts, and the conjugated branched anion-exchange polymers are used as anion-exchange membrane core components for alkaline electrolyzers. The synthesis strategy is simple, convenient and effective, the preparation cost is low, the performance is excellent, meanwhile, the universality is high, industrial production is facilitated, and the application potential is large.
Applicants: NINGBO ZHONGKE QINGYI FILM TECH CO LTD

Title: High-alkali-stability anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and provides a high-alkali-stability anion exchange membrane as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the anion exchange membrane with high alkali stability comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing a poly (isatin-biphenyl) polymer main chain by virtue of a superacid catalyzed polycondensation reaction, then preparing a piperidine cation-containing side chain ionization reagent by virtue of a Michaku reaction, and finally grafting the ionization reagent to the poly (isatin-biphenyl) main chain by virtue of the Michaku reaction, so as to obtain the anion exchange membrane with high alkali stability. And preparing the anion exchange membrane by a blade coating method. According to the preparation method of the anion exchange membrane with high alkali stability provided by the invention, the anion exchange membrane has good alkali stability, and long-term operation of the anion exchange membrane in a water electrolysis device can be ensured.
Applicants: CSSC HANDAN PERIC HYDROGEN ENERGY TECH CO LTD

Title: Anion-exchange membrane electrolysis water membrane electrode assembly and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and discloses an anion exchange membrane electrolysis water membrane electrode assembly and a preparation method thereof. The anion exchange membrane electrolysis water membrane electrode assembly comprises an anion exchange membrane, an anode gas diffusion electrode and a cathode gas diffusion electrode, the anode gas diffusion electrode comprises an anode catalyst layer and an anode gas diffusion layer, and the cathode gas diffusion electrode comprises a cathode catalyst layer and a cathode gas diffusion layer; the anode catalyst layer comprises a first anode catalyst layer and a second anode catalyst layer, the first anode catalyst layer and the second anode catalyst layer are sequentially attached to the surface of the anode diffusion layer from inside to outside, and the aperture of the first anode catalyst layer is larger than that of the second anode catalyst layer. By arranging the first anode catalyst layer and the second anode catalyst layer, an anode catalyst layer structure with gradient pore size distribution is formed, and meanwhile, the activity and the stability of the anion exchange membrane electrolysis water membrane electrode assembly are improved.

Title: Preparation method of NiFe-LDH modified anion exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of a NiFe-LDH modified anion exchange membrane, which belongs to the field of polymer functional membranes and is used for preparing the anion exchange membrane through an inorganic ion doping technology and a tape casting membrane preparation process. A strong hydrogen bond network in a doped NiFe LDH channel is utilized to effectively promote conduction of hydroxyl ions, rapid transmission of the hydroxyl ions in the NiFe LDH channel is increased, transmission resistance is reduced, and the principle can be attributed to interaction among hydroxyl, interlayer anions and the hydroxyl ions. The prepared anion exchange membrane can be applied to an alkaline water electrolysis system, the electrolysis voltage required in the water electrolysis process is effectively reduced, and the membrane electrolysis performance is improved.

Title: Fluoroalkyl-chain-containing polyfluorene anion exchange membrane, fluoroalkyl-chain-containing polyfluorene alkaline binder and preparation method and application of fluoroalkyl-chain-containing polyfluorene anion exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention relates to the field of water electrolysis. In order to solve the problem of low performance of a traditional water electrolyser, the invention discloses a fluoroalkyl chain-containing polyfluorene anion exchange membrane, a fluoroalkyl chain-containing polyfluorene ionic polymer binder and a preparation method and application thereof. The fluorine-containing alkyl chain polyfluorene anion exchange membrane is a copolymer containing the following repetitive structural units: # imgabs0 #, Ar1 is an aromatic group containing fluorenyl, Ar2 is an aromatic group, R represents a fluorine-containing alkyl chain, n represents the degree of polymerization, n is a positive integer of 10-200, the weight-average molecular weight is 5000-800000 g/mol, m is the molar ratio of a quaternary ammonium salt-containing part, and m is a non-endpoint arbitrary value between 0 and 1. The fluorine-containing alkyl chain polyfluorene anion exchange membrane has good alkali stability, is applied to an alkaline water electrolysis bath, and has relatively high current density.
Applicants: NINGBO ZHONGKE HYDROGEN FILM TECH CO LTD

Title: AN ELECTROLYZER POROUS DIAPHRAGM, METHOD FOR PRODUCING THE SAME, AN ELECTROLYZER COMPRISING THE POROUS DIAPHRAGM, AND USE OF THE POROUS DIAPHRAGM IN ELECTROLYSIS
Abstract: The present disclosure provides an electrolyzer porous diaphragm comprising: a microporous polymer scaffold having a plurality of pores having inner surfaces, wherein the microporous polymer scaffold has a first direction, a second direction and a thickness direction, wherein the first direction is orthogonal to the second direction, and the first and second directions are each orthogonal to the thickness direction; and a hydrophilic additive, wherein the hydrophilic additive is deposited on the inner surfaces of the plurality of pores of the microporous polymer scaffold, wherein the microporous polymer scaffold has a matrix tensile strength (MTS) in the second direction of at least about 55 MPa, wherein the second direction is the direction in which the microporous polymer scaffold has its minimum matrix tensile strength, and wherein the porous diaphragm has a contact thickness of less than about 150 μm. The present disclosure also provides a method for producing the electrolyzer porous diaphragm, an electrolyzer comprising the electrolyzer porous diaphragm, and use of the electrolyzer porous diaphragm or the electrolyzer in the electrolysis of water to produce hydrogen.

Title: Branched polyarylpiperidine anion exchange membrane and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of anion exchange membranes, in particular to a branched polyarylpiperidine anion exchange membrane and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the anion exchange membrane comprises the following steps: S1, by taking p-terphenyl, benzenetricarboxaldehyde and N-methyl-piperidine-4-ketone as raw materials, synthesizing a branched polymer through an acid catalytic polymerization reaction; s2, introducing a cationic group with iodomethane through a Menxu reaction, so as to obtain functionalized branched polyarylpiperidine; s3, obtaining the branched polyarylpiperidine anion exchange membrane through a flat plate tape casting method and an anion exchange reaction. The preparation method is simple and suitable for large-scale production; the prepared anion exchange membrane has high ionic conductivity, excellent chemical stability and mechanical strength, has good machinability and application potential, and has a good application prospect in a water electrolysis hydrogen production technology.

Title: Branched polyaromatic piperidine anion exchange membrane, preparation method and application
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and discloses a branched polyaromatic piperidine anion exchange membrane, a preparation method and application. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing a branched polymer precursor, preparing a quaternized branched polymer, and preparing the branched anion exchange membrane: dissolving the quaternized branched polymer in a third solvent, and drying in a vacuum drying oven to obtain the branched anion exchange membrane in the form of iodide ions, and soaking the branched anion-exchange membrane in the form of iodide ions in a NaOH solution for ion exchange, so that the branched anion-exchange membrane in the form of iodide ions is completely converted into a form of hydroxyl ions. According to the invention, ether-free skeleton polyaromatic hydrocarbon is selected as a main chain and has the characteristic of strong alkali-resistant stability, six-membered nitrogen heterocyclic ions are adopted as functional groups, and a large steric hindrance structure can hinder nucleophilic substitution and elimination reaction, so that the alkali-resistant stability of the anion exchange membrane is improved, and the service life of the anion exchange membrane is prolonged.

Title: Polynorbornene-based composite anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a polynorbornene-based composite anion exchange membrane and a preparation method and application thereof, the composite anion exchange membrane comprises polysulfone resin and ionic polynorbornene, or the composite anion exchange membrane comprises polybenzimidazole resin and ionic polynorbornene, or the composite anion exchange membrane comprises polybenzimidazole resin and ionic polynorbornene, or the composite anion exchange membrane comprises polybenzimidazole resin and ionic polynorbornene. The composite material comprises polysulfone resin, polybenzimidazole resin and ionic polynorbornene. According to the polynorbornene-based composite anion exchange membrane disclosed by the invention, the polysulfone resin or the polybenzimidazole resin is introduced into the ionic polynorbornene, so that the mechanical strength of the anion exchange membrane in a wet membrane state can be remarkably improved, the polynorbornene-based composite anion exchange membrane can be used for assembling a more stable water electrolysis device, and the durability is improved.
Applicants: INST CHEMISTRY CAS;;BEIJING QINGWEI MEMBRANE TECH CO LTD

Title: A WATER ELECTROLYZER SYSTEM
Abstract: Disclosed herein is a spatially decoupled redox flow water electrolyzer, that has a hydrogen-producing catholyte section formed from a catholyte tank, having a cathode, and a hydrogen generation compartment, where the catholyte tank and the hydrogen generation compartment are fluidly connected to one another by a fluid pathway, so as to facilitate the circulation of a liquid catholyte from the catholyte tank to the hydrogen generation compartment and back to the catholyte tank and an oxygen-producing anolyte section formed from an anolyte tank, having an anode, and an oxygen producing compartment, where the anolyte tank and the oxygen producing compartment are fluidly connected to one another by a fluid pathway, so as to facilitate the circulation of a liquid anolyte from the anolyte tank to the oxygen producing compartment and back to the anolyte tank, an anion-exchange membrane is disposed between the catholyte and anolyte tanks and a current collector attached to the catholyte and anolyte tanks. In use, the hydrogen generation compartment contains a catalyst capable of catalysing hydrogen production when brought into contact with a cathodic redox mediator when the cathodic redox mediator is in a reduced state and the oxygen generation compartment contains a catalyst capable of catalysing oxygen production when brought into contact with an anodic redox mediator when the anodic redox mediator is in an oxidised state.

Title: Cross-linked polyarane, anion exchange membrane and preparation method and application of anion exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention provides cross-linked polyarane, an anion exchange membrane and a preparation method and application of the anion exchange membrane, and relates to the technical field of hydrogen production through electrolysis of water, the cross-linked polyarane comprises at least two polyphenyl structures, and one polyphenyl structure is bonded with the other polyphenyl structure through a group obtained after a reaction of a diketone precursor; each polyphenyl structure comprises a unit with a cation and a unit with an anion, and the unit with the cation comprises a group with at least two phenyl groups and a group obtained by reacting a ketone precursor providing ions after the reaction; one group with a phenyl group is bonded with the other group with the phenyl group through a group obtained after the ketone precursor providing ions after the reaction is reacted, and the other group with the phenyl group is also bonded with the group with the phenyl group in the other polyphenyl structure through a group obtained after the diketone precursor is reacted. Therefore, the anion exchange membrane formed based on the cross-linked polyarane is relatively low in swelling rate and relatively high in mechanical property.
Applicants: NINGBO ZHONGKE HYDROGEN FILM TECH CO LTD

Title: COPOLYMER, ANION EXCHANGE MEMBRANE CONTAINING COPOLYMER, ANION EXCHANGE MEMBRANE TYPE WATER ELECTROLYTIC CELL OR FUEL CELL, AND MANUFACTURING METHOD FOR HYDROGEN USING ANION EXCHANGE MEMBRANE WATER ELECTROLYTIC CELL
Abstract: To solve the problem of the conventional copolymers in which it is difficult to enhance both ion conductivity and ion exchange capacity while maintaining functionality as an anion exchange membrane and achieve sufficient durability under sufficient alkaline conditions.SOLUTION: This is achieved by a copolymer containing repeating unit formula (I) and repeating unit formula (II), an anion exchange membrane containing the copolymer, an anion exchange membrane type water electrolytic cell or fuel cell, and a manufacturing method for hydrogen using an anion exchange membrane water electrolytic cell.SELECTED DRAWING: None

Title: Wind chime type side chain anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a wind chime type side chain anion exchange membrane, a preparation method thereof and application of the wind chime type side chain anion exchange membrane in water electrolysis hydrogen production, and belongs to the technical field of anion exchange membranes. The anion exchange membrane is prepared from a poly (p-terphenyl-dibenzofuran-piperidinium) polymer grafted with a'windbell type 'side chain. The process is simple and convenient, large-scale production is facilitated, the acid consumption can be reduced, and the production cost can be reduced. The prepared anion exchange membrane has high ionic conductivity, low swelling and high alkali resistance, and effectively solves the problems of low electrolytic efficiency, insufficient mechanical stability and durability and the like of the current commercial anion exchange membrane, so that the service life of the membrane is remarkably prolonged, the comprehensive use cost is reduced, the economic benefit is remarkable, and the application prospect is wide.

Title: Membrane electrode assembly for anion exchange membranes water electrolysis and manufacturing method thereof
Abstract: The present invention relates to a membrane electrode assembly (mea) in which an anion exchange membrane and a catalyst layer including a catalyst and an ionomer are disposed on both surfaces of the anion exchange membrane, wherein the ionomer and the anion exchange membrane each include trimethylammonium and allylammonium functionalized polyphenylene oxide (ppo) (allyl-m-ppo), and the ionomer and the anion exchange membrane are cross-linked at the interface of the anion exchange membrane by a cross-linking agent.
Applicants: UNIV NAT INCHEON RES & BUSINESS FOUND

Title: Double-ion-channel synergetic enhanced conduction anion exchange membrane for hydrogen production by alkaline electrolysis of water and preparation method of double-ion-channel synergetic enhanced conduction anion exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of anion exchange membranes, in particular to a dual-ion-channel synergistic enhanced conduction anion exchange membrane for alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production and a preparation method of the dual-ion-channel synergistic enhanced conduction anion exchange membrane for alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production, and the dual-ion-channel synergistic enhanced conduction anion exchange membrane for alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production is prepared by blending and crosslinking quaternized polyether-ether-ketone and carboxylated polyether sulfone, the carboxylated polyethersulfone provides a cation channel to form a double-ion synergistic conduction structure; the preparation process of the anion exchange membrane comprises the steps of quaternized polyether-ether-ketone synthesis, carboxylated polyether sulfone synthesis, membrane casting solution preparation, tape casting drying, crosslinking treatment and alkali liquor ion exchange. By constructing a double-ion channel structure, the synergistic conduction of anions and cations is realized, and the total ion conduction efficiency of the membrane is remarkably improved. The two polymer components form a continuously interlaced channel network, so that the defect that the conduction path of the traditional single ion channel membrane is isolated is avoided.
Applicants: BEIJING YINENG HYDROGEN SOURCE TECH CO LTD

Title: ANION EXCHANGE POLYMERS AND MEMBRANES FOR ELECTROLYSIS
Abstract: Anion exchange polymers comprise a plurality of repeating units of formula (I). The polymer may be synthesized from a super acid catalyzed poly hydroxy alkylation reaction of monomers Ar1', Ar2', and X1' to form a neutral precursor polymer followed by a Menshutkin reaction to convert the neutral precursor polymer to the anion exchange polymer. Anion exchange membranes and membrane electrode assemblies incorporating the anion exchange polymers are also described.

Title: Comb-shaped polyarylene methylene indole anion exchange membrane for alkaline electrolytic tank and preparation method of comb-shaped polyarylene methylene indole anion exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of alkaline anion exchange membranes, and discloses a comb-shaped polyarylene methylene indole anion exchange membrane for an alkaline electrolytic tank and a preparation method of the comb-shaped polyarylene methylene indole anion exchange membrane. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, synthesizing poly (arylene methylene indole) three-monomer polymers with different monomer proportions, then directly functionalizing the polymers by taking indole-2, 3-ketone of the polymers as grafting sites to obtain a membrane material, and preparing the membrane. The prepared membrane has good ionic conductivity, alkali stability and mechanical strength, and can be applied to an alkaline electrolytic tank.

Title: WATER ELECTROLYSIS CATALYST
Abstract: A family of catalysts for oxygen evolution reaction (OER) in alkaline condition is disclosed. The catalysts utilize elements which are abundant on earth, leading to lower costs compared to IrO2 catalysts. The catalysts can be used in the anode of an anion exchange membrane-based water electrolyzer. The family of new catalysts comprises Ni, Fe, M, B, and O, where M is a metal from Group VIB, Group VIII, and elements 57-71 of the Periodic Table. The catalyst has a layered double hydroxide structure. Methods of making the catalysts are also described.

Title: ADDITIVES FOR IMPROVED ELECTROLYZER DURABILITY
Abstract: The disclosed technology relates to a composition for mitigating hydrogen cross-over and for mitigating polymer oxidation by adding radical scavenging organic inhibitors within an anion exchange membranes ("AEM") electrolyzer.

Title: Application of cobalt-based perovskite catalyst in hydrogen production of alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell
Abstract: The invention discloses an application of a cobalt-based perovskite catalyst in hydrogen production of an alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell, the catalyst is Ba2Co (2-x) MxO6, M = Fe, Ni, Ru, Ir, 0lt; xlt; and 2, the excellent catalytic activity of the anode oxygen evolution reaction (OER) of the anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell is shown. M transition metal and Co in the Ba2Co (2-x) MxO6 have a synergistic effect and jointly reduce the reaction energy barrier of electrolyzed water, so that the oxygen production performance is promoted. After the anion exchange membrane is applied to electrolyzed water in an anion exchange membrane electrolytic tank, the oxygen production quality activity is greatly improved.

Title: Anion exchange membrane, preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention provides an anion exchange membrane as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and the specific steps are as follows: a copolymer of biphenyl and N-methyl-4-piperidone is taken as a main chain, 1, 2-bis (2-iodoethoxy) ethane is taken as a side chain, crown ether macrocyclic molecules are added to promote the self-aggregation of quaternary ammonium ions in the side chain, and the self-aggregation of quaternary ammonium ions in the side chain is promoted; the crown ether/ethyoxyl double-induced anion exchange membrane material with the self-aggregation conduction channel is obtained. The anion exchange membrane material prepared by the method has a self-assembly process of cation-dipole/large pi bond stacking interaction, so that mutually connected ion transmission channels are constructed, rapid transportation of hydrated anions is realized, and the conductivity of the anions is improved. The anion exchange membrane is a key core component in alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production and fuel cells, and can also be used for anion dialysis and the like. The method is simple and easy to implement, raw materials can be industrially produced, and the method has wide application prospects.

Title: Anion exchange membrane with integral asymmetric structure as well as preparation method and application of anion exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention discloses an anion exchange membrane with an integral asymmetric structure as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to an ion exchange membrane as well as preparation and application thereof. The invention aims to solve the technical problems of high system tank voltage, low electrolysis efficiency and short service life when the conventional ion exchange membrane with a symmetrical structure is used for an alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production system. The anion exchange membrane disclosed by the invention is composed of a chloromethylated polysulfone base membrane with an asymmetric structure and methacryloyloxyethyl trimethyl ammonium chloride grafted on the surface of the base membrane; wherein the asymmetric structure base membrane is composed of a compact surface layer and a lower supporting layer; the preparation method comprises the following steps: by taking chloromethylated polysulfone as a matrix, adding sulfonated polyetheretherketone and polyvinylpyrrolidone to form a casting solution, preparing a base membrane by an immersion precipitation phase conversion method, and grafting the methacryloyloxyethyl trimethyl ammonium chloride to the surface of the base membrane. When the membrane is used for electrolytic hydrogen production of an alkaline solution, the cell voltage is only 3.10 V under the current density of 1000 mA cm <-2 >, and the membrane can continuously and stably run for 100 hours and is used for the fields of electrolysis, electrodialysis and batteries.

Title: Anionic polymer, anion exchange membrane, method and electrolyzed water reactor
Abstract: The invention provides an anionic polymer, an anion exchange membrane, a method and an electrolytic water reactor, the anionic polymer selects a polyaryl skeleton structure, and the polyaryl skeleton structure is connected with a cationic group with high alkali resistance and a fluorine-containing side chain structure; according to the anion exchange membrane prepared from the anionic polymer, a cationic group with high alkali resistance and a side chain structure for providing an in-situ polymerization site are introduced into a polymer skeleton structure containing a fluorine-containing structural unit, so that the alkali-resistant stability and the dimensional stability are improved while the high ion conductivity of the anion exchange membrane is maintained; the comprehensive optimization and improvement of the performance of the anion exchange membrane are realized.
Applicants: HUANENG YIMIN COAL & ELECTRICITY CO LTD;;HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RES INST

Title: Preparation method of anion exchange membrane water electrolyser anode catalyst
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of new energy materials, and particularly discloses a preparation method of an anion exchange membrane water electrolyser anode catalyst, which comprises the following steps: (1) preparing a precursor solution: dissolving Ni salt and Fe salt in an oleylamine solution, and uniformly stirring and mixing to obtain the precursor solution; (2) adding a phosphorus source and a reducing agent: adding the phosphorus source and the reducing agent into the precursor solution prepared in the step (1), and uniformly stirring and mixing to obtain a mixed solution; (3) preparing NiFeP: introducing protective gas into the mixed solution prepared in the step (2) for gas washing so as to remove impurities; and adjusting the temperature, setting a heating program, operating the program, and finishing the preparation of the NiFeP catalyst after the heating process is finished. The nanoscale NiFeP catalyst prepared by the preparation method disclosed by the invention shows extremely low bath pressure in an AEMWE test, and is superior to commercial IrO2; the NiFeP catalyst has excellent stability and excellent energy efficiency, so that the NiFeP catalyst has a wide application prospect and a relatively high commercial value.

Title: Preparation and application of branched poly (aryl piperidine) anion exchange membrane material with high free volume
Abstract: The invention belongs to the field of high-performance anion exchange membranes for hydrogen production by electrolysis of water and preparation of the high-performance anion exchange membranes, and particularly discloses a branched poly (aryl piperidine)-based anion exchange membrane material with a high free volume as well as a preparation method and application of the branched poly (aryl piperidine)-based anion exchange membrane material. A branching agent 9, 9-diphenylfluorene is introduced into a polymer structural unit, so that the free volume in the membrane material is increased, meanwhile, the movement capacity of part of chain segments is limited, swelling of the membrane material due to water absorption is inhibited, the ionic conductivity and the dimensional stability of the membrane material are effectively improved, and the prepared anion exchange membrane can be applied to hydrogen production through water electrolysis.

Title: Catalyst for water electrolysis of anion exchange membrane preparation method thereof and water electrolysis electrode comprising thereof
Abstract: A catalyst for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis according to various embodiments of the present invention may include: a core including a transition metal; and a shell disposed on the core and including a transition metal hydroxide. According to various embodiments of the present invention, a method for preparing a catalyst for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis may comprise the steps of: mixing a first transition metal salt, a basic material, and a solvent and magnetic stirring the mixture; adding a reducing agent to the solution in which the magnetic field is stirred to prepare a transition metal nanofiber sponge; compressing the transition metal nanofiber sponge with a membrane and immersing the same in an aqueous solution containing a second transition metal salt; and reacting with a sulfur precursor after the immersing step. The membrane electrode assembly according to various embodiments of the present disclosure may include a catalyst for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis or a catalyst layer including the catalyst.

Title: Rack-based anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell capable of adjusting operating power
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrolytic cells, and particularly discloses a rack-based anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell capable of adjusting operation power, the rack-based anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell comprises a square current collecting end plate and a mounting plate which are arranged in parallel, a plurality of small electrolysis chambers are arranged between the current collecting end plate and the mounting plate in series, and current collecting blocks are arranged at the tops of polar plates of the small electrolysis chambers; the plurality of current collecting blocks are arranged in a row along the transverse direction; a rack stretching across the top of the electrolysis chamber is arranged at the tops of the current collecting end plate and the mounting plate through connecting lugs, a gear sliding block mechanism is arranged on the rack, and a sliding contact block connected with the current collecting end plate through a wire is arranged on the gear sliding block mechanism; the number of the small electrolysis chambers in the actual operation process is adjusted by changing the position of a gear sliding block mechanism on the upper portion of the electrolytic cell, then the hydrogen production rate and the consumed power of the electrolytic cell are adjusted, the fluctuation electric power of a power grid is adapted, and energy loss is reduced.
Applicants: SHAANXI QINGNENG POWER TECH CO LTD

Title: Application of ternary perovskite-like metal organic framework material in anion exchange membrane water electrolyser device
Abstract: The invention discloses application of a ternary perovskite-like metal organic framework material in an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell device, and relates to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production technology and application of anode electrode materials of the water electrolysis hydrogen production technology, the ternary perovskite-like metal organic framework material is used for constructing an anode catalyst of the electrolytic cell device, and the molecular formula of the ternary perovskite-like metal organic framework material is [CH3NH3] [Co < 0.33 > Ni < 0.33 > Fe < 0.33 > (HCOO) 3]. Through system design and optimization of catalyst preparation process parameters, the anode catalyst prepared by adopting the optimization scheme shows remarkable OER activity under the alkaline electrolysis condition, and the application potential of the ternary perovskite-like MOF material as the anode of the AEM electrolytic cell is verified. The invention provides an anode catalyst construction strategy which is clear in preparation process and high in adaptability, has important significance for optimizing and improving AEMWE performance, and has good industrial application prospects.
Applicants: GUANGDONG TANYU NEW MAT CO LTD

Title: CHIRAL METAL OXIDE-BASED ANION EXCHANGE MEMBRANE WATER ELECTROLYSIS DEVICE AND MANUFACTURING METHOD THEREFOR
Abstract: Provided are a chiral metal oxide-based anion exchange membrane water electrolysis device and a manufacturing method therefor. The chiral metal oxide-based anion exchange membrane water electrolysis device includes an L-type or D-type chiral metal oxide, which may possess chirality-induced spin selectivity, and thus, when used in a water electrolysis device including same, spin polarization may be controlled without an additional external magnetic field, and the efficiency of an electrode and the device may be improved.

Title: NI-COATED SUBSTRATE FOR SEPARATOR OF ANION EXCHANGE MEMBRANE WATER ELECTROLYSIS DEVICE, AND METHOD FOR PRODUCING SAME
Abstract: Provided is an Ni-coated substrate for a separator of an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis device, which exhibits excellent corrosion resistance in the usage environment of a separator of an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis device, which exhibits excellent contact resistance properties with a porous transport layer, and which has excellent productivity. An Ni-coated substrate for a separator of an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis device according to the present invention comprises a metal substrate and an Ni coating layer on a surface of the metal substrate. The thickness h (μm) of the Ni coating layer satisfies formula (1), and is 1 μm or less. (Fe+Cr×2-Ni×8)/(100×h)<10 … (1) Fe, Cr and Ni in formula (1) indicate the content values (mass%) of the elements contained in the metal substrate, and take a value of 0 if the element in question is not contained.

Title: Preparation method of PPy-CS-DIM nanotube composite anion exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention belongs to the field of new energy and anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a PPy-CS-DIM nanotube composite anion exchange membrane. According to the preparation method, a chemical oxidation method is adopted, methyl orange and ferric chloride are utilized to form a self-assembled nanotube template, and meanwhile, quaternized starch and 1, 2-dimethylimidazole are introduced to prepare the ternary composite nanotube based on polypyrrole. The PPy-CS-DIM nanotube has a unique confinement micropore effect, and an efficient and ordered hydroxyl ion transmission channel can be constructed, so that the ionic conductivity of the membrane is greatly improved. The nanotube is added into a polymer OPBI substrate, and a high-performance OPBI anion exchange membrane can be prepared. By adjusting the doping content of the PPy-CS-DIM nanotube, the ionic conductivity of the OPBI membrane is optimized, and compared with a pure OPBI anion exchange membrane, the ionic conductivity of the obtained composite anion exchange membrane is remarkably improved.

Title: Polyaralkyl crosslinking modified polybenzimidazole anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a polyaralkyl crosslinking modified polybenzimidazole anion exchange membrane as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The high-performance anion exchange membrane with a clear hydrophilic/hydrophobic microphase separation structure is designed by cross-linking modified polybenzimidazole modified by a long alkyl side chain ion conduction group and a polyaralkyl polymer with a haloalkane side chain and then casting the membrane. The prepared membrane has good dimensional stability and relatively high ionic conductivity, and can be applied to anion exchange membrane water electrolyzers and alkaline fuel cells.

Title: HIGH TEMPERATURE TYPE ANION EXCHANGE MEMBRANE WATER ELECTROLYSIS APPARATUS COMPRISING THE SAME AND METHOD FOR PREPARING THE SAME
Abstract: The present invention relates to a high-temperature type anion exchange membrane comprising a polybenzimidazole-based polymer, to a water electrolysis device comprising the same, and to a production method thereof. The high-temperature type anion exchange membrane has high ionic conductivity while being stable even at high temperature (over 100°C).

Title: ELECTRODE AND METHOD FOR MANUFACTURING ELECTRODE
Abstract: The present disclosure relates to an electrode and a method for preparing the same. According to the present disclosure, an electrode for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis that can achieve improved electrochemical performance and also has excellent durability can be provided.

Title: Crosslinked quaternary ammonium functionalized polyarylether sulfone anion exchange membrane material for water electrolysis hydrogen production and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention belongs to the field of high-performance anion exchange membranes for hydrogen production by electrolysis of water and preparation of the high-performance anion exchange membranes, and particularly discloses a cross-linked quaternary ammonium functionalized polyarylether sulfone anion exchange membrane material as well as a preparation method and application of the cross-linked quaternary ammonium functionalized polyarylether sulfone anion exchange membrane material. Polycation side chains are introduced into a polymer structure unit to improve the aggregation degree of ions, and meanwhile, a cross-linked structure is introduced to limit the chain spacing, so that the local OH <-> concentration in the membrane is reduced. Secondly, a benzene ring flexible side chain is used as an interval between ions, the charge induction effect between the ions and a skeleton structure is reduced, the ionic conductivity and chemical resistance stability of the membrane material are effectively improved, and the prepared anion exchange membrane can be applied to hydrogen production through water electrolysis.
Applicants: UNIV CHANGZHOU;;SHANDONG XINGSHUN NEW MAT CO LTD

Title: Management system for changing anion exchange membrane water electrolysis stack and control method thereof
Abstract: The replacement management system for an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis stack and a method for controlling the same are disclosed to replace a water electrolysis stack at an appropriate timing. The replacement management system for the anion exchange membrane water electrolysis stack comprises: a plurality of water electrolysis stacks arranged in parallel to produce hydrogen; and a control unit controlling the plurality of water electrolysis stacks. The control unit calculates a difference between a density measurement value of water and an electrolyte supplied to the plurality of water electrolysis stacks and a density measurement value of oxygen and the electrolyte discharged from the plurality of water electrolysis stacks to convert a calculated difference into an absolute value. When the absolute value is equal to or less than a set value, the control unit determines that a replacement target has a presence among the plurality of water electrolysis stacks. Furthermore, the control unit calculates a difference between temperature measurement values at a front end and a rear end of each of the water electrolysis stacks to convert a calculated difference into an absolute value. When the absolute value is equal to or less than the set value, the control unit determines a corresponding water electrolysis stack satisfying a condition as the replacement target, and operates an alarm signal so that a manager is capable of performing a replacement work.

Title: Anion exchange membrane electrolysis water oxygen evolution electrode and preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of catalytic materials, and particularly relates to an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis oxygen evolution electrode and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly preparing a high-strength porous metal carrier, then comprehensively loading a catalytic material on the high-strength porous metal carrier to form a catalytic layer, then washing off the catalytic layer on one side of the high-strength porous metal carrier, and forming a conductive layer to obtain the anion exchange membrane water electrolysis oxygen evolution electrode. The high-strength porous metal carrier has compression resistance, the stacking compression amount is small, the surface is smooth, and the contact resistance is small; the catalyst layer is in a sheet shape, has a high specific surface area and provides a large number of active sites for reaction; the conductive layer is made of fiber alloy and has conductivity close to that of pure nickel. The anion exchange membrane electrolysis water oxygen evolution electrode is assembled in an electrolysis stack, and when the cell voltage is 1.9 V, the current density of the stack reaches 4 A/cm < 2 >.

Title: Conductive diamond-based anion exchange membrane water electrolysis electrode, preparation method thereof and water electrolysis hydrogen production tank comprising electrode
Abstract: The invention provides an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production tank which comprises a cathode and an anode, and the anode is a conductive diamond-based anion exchange membrane water electrolysis electrode. A catalyst of the conductive diamond-based anion exchange membrane water electrolysis electrode is conductive diamond composite transition metal or transition metal alloy. According to the supported catalyst obtained by the preparation method disclosed by the invention, the survival rate of active sites of the metal oxide catalyst of the anode non-noble metal can be remarkably improved, and the service life of the catalyst is prolonged; compared with a traditional catalyst layer formed by a metal oxide, the supported catalyst obtained by the preparation method disclosed by the invention has the advantages that the electronic conductivity of the catalyst can be remarkably improved, and meanwhile, the structured catalyst is beneficial to the operation of an electrolytic bath under high current density. And the catalyst-electrode integrated rapid thermal forming method is beneficial to large-scale mass production application.
Applicants: GUANGZHOU DEBAISHUN BLUE DIAMOND TECH CO LTD

Title: Membrane electrode for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a membrane electrode for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production and a preparation method thereof. The membrane electrode comprises an anion exchange membrane, and a cathode catalyst layer and an anode catalyst layer are arranged on the two sides of the anion exchange membrane respectively; the catalyst loading capacity in the cathode catalyst layer is 0.2-1.0 mg/cm < 2 >, and the cathode catalyst layer comprises a platinum-carbon catalyst, a platinum-ruthenium-carbon catalyst and/or a platinum-ruthenium-carbon catalyst; the catalyst loading capacity in the anode catalyst layer is 1.0-10mg/cm < 2 >, and the anode catalyst layer comprises a nickel-iron oxide catalyst, an iridium oxide catalyst, a cobaltosic oxide catalyst, a cobalt-iron alloy catalyst and a cobalt-nickel catalyst, and/or the catalyst loading capacity in the anode catalyst layer is 1.0-10mg/cm < 2 >; by accurately controlling the thickness and particle distribution of the catalyst layer, the interface contact between the catalyst and the membrane material is optimized, the resistance loss in the electrolysis process is reduced, and meanwhile, the catalytic activity is improved.
Applicants: HEFEI COMPREHENSIVE NATIONAL SCIENCE CENTER ENERGY RES INSTITUTE ANHUI ENERGY LABORATORY

Title: Anion exchange membrane water electrolysis membrane electrode cooperatively constructed by hydrophilic/hydrophobic materials and water electrolysis cell
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen energy, in particular to an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis membrane electrode constructed by a hydrophilic material and a hydrophobic material in a synergetic mode and a water electrolysis cell, and the anion exchange membrane water electrolysis membrane electrode constructed by the hydrophilic material and the hydrophobic material in the synergetic mode. Comprising a cathode gas diffusion layer, a cathode catalyst layer, an anion exchange membrane, an anode catalyst layer and an anode gas diffusion layer which are sequentially stacked, a hydrophilic component and a hydrophobic component are added into the cathode catalyst layer and the anode catalyst at the same time; a hydrophilic component and a hydrophobic component are added into the anode gas diffusion layer and the cathode gas diffusion layer at the same time. According to the technical scheme, the hydrophilic material and the hydrophobic material are introduced into the catalyst layer at the same time, ion transfer and gas diffusion are balanced, the hydrophilic material and the hydrophobic material are introduced into the gas diffusion layer at the same time, gradient wettability is constructed, liquid water reverse osmosis is inhibited, and efficient cooperation of water management and gas diffusion is achieved.
Applicants: BEIJING YINENG HYDROGEN SOURCE TECH CO LTD

Title: Manufacturing method of an anion exchange membrane using eactant-assisted dissolution of perfluorinated sulfonyl fluoride
Abstract: An object of the present invention is to provide a polymer solution composition having excellent anion conductivity and chemical stability by improving the solubility of a perfluorinated sulfonyl fluoride polymer, which is a perfluorinated polymer that is not soluble, and a method for manufacturing an anion exchange membrane using the same. The anion exchange membrane manufactured through the method for manufacturing the anion exchange membrane has excellent electrochemical performance and economic feasibility at the same time, and thus can be applied to a redox flow battery, a fuel cell, an integrated regenerative fuel cell, a water electrolysis device, and a water treatment device.

Title: ANION EXCHANGE POLYMERS AND MEMBRANES FOR ELECTROLYSIS
Abstract: Anion exchange polymers comprise a plurality of repeating units of formula (I). The polymer may be synthesized from a super acid catalyzed polyhydroxyalkylation reaction of monomers Ari ' and Xi ' to form a neutral precursor polymer followed by a Menshutkin reaction to convert the neutral precursor polymer to the anion exchange polymer with halide-based counterions, and then an ion exchange reaction to covert the anion exchange polymer with halide-based counterions to acetate (CH3COO ), trifluoroacetate (CF3COO ), propionate (CH3CH2COO ), or butanoate anion (CH3CH2CH2COO ) counterions. Anion exchange membranes and membrane electrode assemblies incorporating the anion exchange polymers are also described.

Title: Composite anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, in particular to a composite anion exchange membrane and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the composite anion exchange membrane comprises the following steps: mixing a polymer, an organic solvent and an aldehyde compound to form a membrane casting solution; forming the membrane casting solution to prepare an aldehyde compound compounded anion exchange membrane; and immersing the aldehyde compound compounded anion exchange membrane into an acid solution containing an amino compound, and carrying out aldehyde amine condensation reaction to form the compound anion exchange membrane, the polymer and the amino compound contain quaternary ammonium groups. The covalent organic framework doped composite anion exchange membrane with a large area can be simply and rapidly synthesized, and the composite anion exchange membrane has good structural stability and excellent ionic conduction performance and can meet the application requirement of hydrogen production through water electrolysis.

Title: Anion-exchange membrane electrolysis water membrane electrode and efficient and rapid activation method thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis membrane electrode and an efficient and rapid activation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of hydrogen production by water electrolysis. The method comprises the following steps: assembling an anode, a cathode and an anion exchange membrane into a single cell, and introducing an electrolyte; applying initial voltage to start the electrolytic tank; step 2, increasing the voltage step by step according to a preset voltage step length, keeping a preset time under each voltage step until a target voltage is reached, and forming an activation cycle; and repeatedly carrying out a plurality of activation cycles, monitoring the current change in real time in the activation process, calculating the current change rate under the same voltage step in two adjacent activation cycles, and stopping activation when the current change rate is smaller than a preset threshold value. According to the invention, the rapid and controllable activation of the membrane electrode is realized by combining the stepped circulating boost with the current change rate criterion, the activation time is remarkably shortened, the electrochemical impact is avoided, and the performance stability and consistency of the membrane electrode are improved.
Applicants: HEFEI COMPREHENSIVE NATIONAL SCIENCE CENTER ENERGY RESEARCH INST ANHUI ENERGY LABORATORY

Title: ALKALINE ANION EXCHANGE MEMBRANE WATER ELECTROLYZER USING NI ELECTRODEPOSITED HYDROPHILIC POROUS CARBON MATERIAL AND METHOD FOR PREPARING THE SAME
Abstract: The present invention relates to a membrane electrode assembly of an alkaline anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer and, more specifically, to a membrane electrode assembly which comprises: an anion exchange membrane; and a Ni-electrodeposited hydrophilic porous carbon material which is an electrode material on the anion exchange membrane. Accordingly, the present invention can: largely reduce the amount of a metal catalyst used as an electrode on an anion exchange membrane in the alkaline anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer; greatly reduce the thickness of the electrode; and make the mass transfer of gas or water very fast. In addition, the manufacturing process of the membrane electrode assembly is very easy and simple compared to a conventional process; and manufacturing costs can be greatly reduced.

Title: Anion exchange membrane electrolysis catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses an anion exchange membrane electrolysis catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of electrocatalysts.The anion exchange membrane electrolysis catalyst is characterized in that graphene oxide serves as a carrier, cerium sulfide nano-particles are loaded on the surface of the graphene oxide, more active sites of a composite material are promoted to be exposed, and the stability of the composite material is improved; moreover, the loaded cerium sulfide nanoparticles effectively regulate and control the electronic structure on the surface of the graphene oxide, and the adsorption and desorption capabilities of the composite material on hydrogen atoms are improved, so that the activity of an electro-catalytic hydrogen evolution reaction is improved. The ruthenium-containing compound is converted into RuS2 and is loaded on the CeS2/graphene oxide composite material, so that the overpotential of the anion exchange membrane electrolysis catalyst is greatly reduced, and the CeS2/graphene oxide composite material exposed in a sulfur atmosphere and the ruthenium-containing compound form a Ce-S-Ru bond through annealing; the electro-catalysis hydrogen evolution performance and the stability of the anion exchange membrane electrolysis catalyst under the acidic condition are improved.
Applicants: BEIJING JINGNENG TECH CO LTD;;BEIJING YINENG HYDROGEN SOURCE TECH CO LTD

Title: ANION EXCHANGE MEMBRANE COMPRISING CROSS-LINKED POLYMER OF SEBS AND POLYFLUORENE, AND METHOD FOR MANUFACTURING SAME
Abstract: The present invention relates to an anion exchange membrane comprising a cross-linked polymer in which polyfluorene is cross-linked with styrene-ethylene-butylene-styrene (SEBS). The anion exchange membrane according to the present invention has excellent mechanical properties and thermal stability while having high ionic conductivity, and can be applied to a water electrolysis device.
Applicants: KOREA ADVANCED INST SCI & TECH;;LOTTE CHEMICAL CORP

Title: Cathode gas diffusion layer and preparation method thereof, membrane electrode and anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell
Abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a cathode gas diffusion layer and a preparation method thereof, a membrane electrode and an anion exchange membrane electrolyzer, the cathode gas diffusion layer comprises a matrix layer, a transition layer and a hydrophilic layer which are sequentially stacked, and the transition layer comprises at least two layers of hydrophobic layers which are stacked; the contact angle between the hydrophobic layer close to the hydrophilic layer and water is smaller than that between the hydrophobic layer away from the hydrophilic layer and water, the contact angle between the hydrophilic layer and water is smaller than or equal to 90 degrees, and the contact angle between the hydrophobic layer and water is larger than 90 degrees. According to the cathode gas diffusion layer provided by the invention, under anode liquid inlet circulation, the hydrophilic layer can ensure the wetting of the cathode side anion exchange membrane, so that the transmission efficiency of OH <-> and the total gas production amount of hydrogen are improved, the problem of rapid loss of the anion exchange membrane caused by water shortage and concentration difference of the cathode side anion exchange membrane is relieved, and the service life of the cathode side anion exchange membrane is prolonged. The gradient hydrophobic transition layer can regulate and control the moisture permeation amount of the cathode side, so that the risk of water logging is reduced, and the hydrogen discharge efficiency and the hydrogen purity are improved.
Applicants: HUIZHOU EVE HYDROGEN ENERGY CO LTD

Title: Anion exchange membrane water electrolysis system
Abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of electrolyzed water, and provides an anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water system, which comprises an electrolytic bath device, an anion exchange membrane and an anion exchange membrane, the anode gas-liquid separation tank is communicated with an outlet of the anode region of the electrolytic bath device; the cathode gas-liquid separation tank is communicated with an outlet of the cathode region of the electrolytic bath device; the anode alkali liquor storage tank is communicated with an inlet of the anode area through an anode liquor inlet pipeline; an anode liquid inlet valve is arranged on the anode liquid inlet pipeline; the cathode alkali liquor storage tank is communicated with the inlet of the cathode area through a cathode liquor inlet pipeline; the anode alkali liquor storage tank and the cathode alkali liquor storage tank are communicated with the buffer alkali liquor storage tank through buffer pipelines; the anode alkali liquor storage tank is communicated with the buffer alkali liquor storage tank through a first circulating pipeline; the cathode alkali liquor storage tank is communicated with the buffer alkali liquor storage tank through a second circulating pipeline; the liquid supply module is used for providing alkali liquor and/or pure water for the anode alkali liquor storage tank and the cathode alkali liquor storage tank; and a computer control system. The method has the advantage of improving the stability of electrolyzed water.
Applicants: HONGJI CHUANGNENG TECH FOSHAN CO LTD

Title: Anion exchange membrane, preparation method thereof and water electrolysis hydrogen production device
Abstract: The invention provides an anion exchange membrane, a preparation method thereof and a water electrolysis hydrogen production device, and belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and the anion exchange membrane comprises a supporting layer and a homogeneous layer located on one side of the supporting layer in the thickness direction. The homogeneous layer comprises anion exchange resin and a plasticizer, and the supporting layer comprises a porous base material and anion exchange resin and a plasticizer which are filled in the porous base material. Wherein the anion exchange resin comprises a compound as shown in a formula I in the specification. The plasticizer comprises N-ethyl p-toluene sulfonamide. The anion exchange membrane provided by the invention can have good mechanical strength and pressure resistance, the resistance of a membrane forming surface can be reduced, the thickness uniformity of each part can be ensured, the anion exchange membrane has excellent comprehensive performance, the preparation cost is low, and the anion exchange membrane is suitable for large-scale production and application.
Applicants: HUIZHOU EVE HYDROGEN ENERGY CO LTD

Title: Anion exchange membrane and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production of anion exchange membranes, in particular to an anion exchange membrane and a preparation method of the anion exchange membrane. The polymer comprises: a rigid main chain formed by copolymerization of an isatin structural unit, an aromatic diphenol structural unit and a polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon structural unit; the flexible side chains are bonded on a plurality of bonding sites of the rigid main chain through quaternization reaction, and quaternary ammonium salt cation groups are arranged on the flexible side chains; wherein the plurality of bonding sites comprise a nitrogen atom on the isatin structural unit and an oxygen atom on the aromatic diphenol structural unit. The preparation process provided by the invention is high in synthesis efficiency and low in cost, and the anion exchange membrane obtained by the preparation method has high ionic conductivity and excellent chemical stability and is suitable for various electrochemical application scenes.

Title: Composite anion-exchange membrane based on cationic group modified polyethylene supporting layer and preparation method of composite anion-exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention discloses a composite anion exchange membrane based on a cationic group modified polyethylene supporting layer and a preparation method of the composite anion exchange membrane. The composite anion exchange membrane is prepared by using an ultrathin porous polyethylene membrane which is irradiated by gamma rays and grafted with nitrogen-containing cationic monomers as a hydrophilic support layer and performing vacuum impregnation with an anion exchange resin solution. The composite anion exchange membrane is good in interface bonding and compact in structure, not only has excellent mechanical performance, ionic conductivity and dimensional stability and excellent alkali resistance, but also has an obvious price advantage compared with an existing anion exchange membrane; the method has wide application prospects in the fields of water electrolysis hydrogen production, fuel cells, electrochemical synthesis, flow batteries, electrodialysis and the like.

Title: High-surface-roughness anion exchange membrane based on radiation grafting and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of anion exchange membranes, and discloses a radiation-grafting-based anion exchange membrane with high surface roughness and a preparation method thereof, polyethylene (PE), polypropylene (PP), ethylene tetrafluoroethylene (ETFE), polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF), polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) and the like are used as main chains, aryl side chains containing quaternary ammonium cation groups are adopted, and the radiation-grafting-based anion exchange membrane with high surface roughness is prepared. A novel anion exchange membrane material is synthesized through a radiation grafting process, so that the anion exchange membrane material has relatively high mechanical property, conductivity and chemical stability; meanwhile, the material has higher surface roughness, so that the material has higher hydrophilicity, higher adhesion to a catalyst layer and larger contact area with the catalyst layer, thereby having more excellent fuel cell and water electrolysis performance; in addition, the synthesis method is relatively simple in overall process, mild in reaction condition, relatively short in reaction time, relatively low in cost and easy for large-scale production.

Title: Anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production test system and test method thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production testing, in particular to an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production testing system and a testing method thereof. The invention discloses an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production test system. The hydrogen side gas-liquid separation device is arranged at one end of the electrolysis device and is communicated with the electrolytic cell, and a gas-liquid separation device is arranged in the hydrogen side gas-liquid separation device and is used for carrying out gas-liquid separation on hydrogen which is formed by electrolysis in the electrolytic cell and contains alkali liquor steam; and the oxygen alkali washing device is arranged at the other end of the electrolysis device, and the oxygen alkali washing device is communicated with the electrolysis tank so as to carry out alkali washing treatment on oxygen which is formed by electrolysis in the electrolysis tank and contains alkali liquor steam. A two-way alkali liquor recovery mechanism is adopted, the gas-liquid separation device is arranged on the hydrogen side, the alkali washing device is arranged on the oxygen side, and the problem that alkali liquor on the hydrogen side is lost due to traditional single-side alkali washing is solved.
Applicants: CHANGZHOU QINGZHOU ENERGY TECH CO LTD

Title: OXYGEN EVOLUTION REACTION ELECTRODES
Abstract: OER electrodes are comprised of low cost fibrous PTLs conformally coated with one to three layers of metal oxides, metal oxyhydroxides, metal hydroxides or a combination thereof. The OER electrodes comprise a unique structure and morphology which achieve a low overpotential and excellent durability in use. The structure, morphology and loading of the electrocatalyst is easily tunable and appropriately scalable to the required application in an AEM and AEL electrolyzer. AEM electrolyzers comprising the OER electrodes achieve high performance and promising cell durability.

Title: - Membrane Electrolyte Assembly for Alkaline Water Electrolysis and Method for manufacturing the same
Abstract: The present invention relates to a membrane-electrode assembly (MEA) for alkaline water electrolysis and a manufacturing method thereof. The MEA is used for alkaline water electrolysis and includes an anion exchange membrane and an electrode catalyst layer coated on both sides of the anion exchange membrane. The electrode catalyst layer includes a non-noble metal oxide and a binder. According to the present invention, when alkaline water electrolysis (AEMWE) is performed, operation is possible even at a high current and voltage efficiency is improved, thereby increasing productivity of at least hydrogen (H_2).

Title: Polymer, cross-linked anion-exchange membrane and preparation method and application of cross-linked anion-exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention provides a polymer, a cross-linked anion exchange membrane and a preparation method and application thereof. According to the polymer and the cross-linked anion exchange membrane, aryl compounds, trifluoroketone compounds and N-methylpiperidone are polymerized to form a main chain, the main chain has excellent rigidity and flexibility, a quaternary ammonium salt alkenyl compound is introduced as a cross-linking agent, cross-linking is completed through heating in the membrane forming process, and the cross-linked anion exchange membrane is prepared. The quaternary ammonium salt side chain introduced into the side chain has excellent hydrophilic and hydrophobic phase separation characteristics. The polymer and the cross-linked anion exchange membrane have excellent oxidation-reduction resistance and alkali resistance, have the characteristics of stable physical and chemical properties, excellent ion flux, excellent mechanical properties (the elongation at break is greater than 60%) and simple process, and can be widely applied to the fields of hydrogen production by water electrolysis and the like.
Applicants: SUQIAN LYUNENG HYDROGEN TECH CO LTD

Title: Power-adjustable anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell based on sliding rods
Abstract: The invention discloses a power-adjustable anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell based on a sliding rod.
