The power-adjustable anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell comprises a gear sliding block mechanism and a plurality of small electrolytic chambers clamped between a cathode current collecting end plate and an anode current collecting end plate, the gear sliding block mechanism comprises a mounting seat, a connecting plate and a sliding rod, two ends of the connecting plate and the sliding rod are fixedly connected with the cathode current collecting end plate and the anode current collecting end plate, the mounting seat is in sliding connection with the connecting plate, and a rack is fixedly arranged on the connecting plate; an output shaft of the stepping motor is fixedly connected with a driving bevel gear, the mounting seat is rotationally connected with a rotating shaft, and the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a driven bevel gear and a driven gear; the sliding rod comprises a plurality of conductive sliding rods which are sequentially arranged at intervals and fixedly connected through insulating rings, the sliding rods are slidably sleeved with conductive sliding rings, the conductive sliding rings are fixedly connected with the bottom face of the mounting base, bipolar plates of the electrolysis small chambers are fixedly connected with current collecting blocks, the current collecting blocks are fixedly connected with the conductive sliding rods, and voltage of the conductive sliding rings is conveyed to the current collecting blocks through the conductive sliding rods and conductive connecting rods. And the number of the small electrolysis tanks in actual operation can be changed.
Applicants: SHAANXI QINGNENG POWER TECH CO LTD

Title: Anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention provides an anion exchange membrane as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of hydrogen production by alkaline water electrolysis. The anion exchange membrane comprises a polyarylbiphenyl polymer matrix and LDH nanosheets dispersed in the matrix, the thickness of the LDH nanosheets is 5-20 nm, and the transverse size of the LDH nanosheets is 100-1000 nm. According to the anion exchange membrane disclosed by the invention, the specific alkali-resistant polyarylbiphenyl polymer is used as a substrate and is compounded with the LDH nanosheet with a specific size, so that the LDH nanosheet serving as an inorganic filler is well dispersed in a polymer matrix and plays a synergistic enhancement role, and the high-performance composite anion exchange membrane is obtained; the composite material has high ionic conductivity, low swelling rate and good mechanical properties, and can be widely applied to the field of hydrogen production by alkaline water electrolysis.

Title: Anion exchange membrane containing quaternary ammonium functional group and manufacturing method thereof
Abstract: The present invention relates to an anion exchange membrane including a quaternary ammonium base and a method for manufacturing the same. specifically, the present invention is to provide an anion exchange membrane having excellent ion conductivity and mechanical stability by impregnating and polymerizing a solution including a porous support and an acrylic electrolyte having a polyfunctional acrylic crosslinking agent and a quaternary ammonium base in the porous support, and a method for manufacturing the same.
Applicants: SANGMYUNG UNIV CHEONAN COUNCIL FOR INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

Title: Photo-curing anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a photocuring anion-exchange membrane and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of anion-exchange membranes and preparation thereof. The photoinitiator comprises the following components in parts by mass: 50-80 parts of an acrylate polymer matrix containing an epoxy group, 10-30 parts of an anion exchange group functional monomer, 1-5 parts of a photoinitiator, 2-10 parts of a cross-linking agent and 0.5-5 parts of an additive. The membrane shows excellent mechanical strength and chemical stability in hydrogen production through water electrolysis, the curing efficiency is improved by two times or more compared with a traditional process through a deuterated photo-initiation system of the membrane, the ionic conduction efficiency is remarkably enhanced through the synergistic effect of a three-dimensional cross-linked network and graphene filler, and the technical bottleneck that a traditional anion exchange membrane is prone to swelling and short in service life is solved.
Applicants: BEIJING YINENG HYDROGEN SOURCE TECH CO LTD

Title: High-molecular-weight hyperbranched polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention provides a high-molecular-weight hyperbranched polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of membrane materials. The high-molecular-weight hyperbranched polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane provided by the invention is obtained by carrying out self-polymerization on a branched monomer or carrying out copolymerization on the branched monomer, a biphenyl monomer and N-methyl-4-piperidone and then carrying out quaternization conversion. The free volume of the anion exchange membrane is larger than that of a linear polymer, so that the anion exchange membrane shows ultrahigh conductivity; due to a high-molecular-weight polymer main chain (Mn is greater than 100K), the polymer has excellent alkali-resistant stability and mechanical strength; meanwhile, the anion exchange membrane has low water absorption swelling rate and dimensional stability, is suitable for hydrogen production by electrolysis of water and alkaline fuel cells, and has wide application prospects.

Title: Plateau-oriented anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen and oxygen production system and method
Abstract: The invention relates to the field of hydrogen and oxygen production through water electrolysis, and discloses a plateau-oriented anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen and oxygen production system and method.The plateau-oriented anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen and oxygen production system comprises a liquid supply unit, an electrolytic bath unit, a gas-liquid separation and purification unit, a pressure control unit and a central control and coordination unit; the electrolytic cell unit is connected with the gas-liquid separation and purification unit, condensate water generated by the gas-liquid separation and purification unit flows back to the liquid supply unit, the pressure balance control unit is respectively connected with a hydrogen side and an oxygen side in the gas-liquid separation and purification unit, and the central control and coordination unit is connected with the electrolytic cell unit. The system can solve the technical problems of how to realize long-term high efficiency of the anion exchange membrane water electrolysis system in a plateau low-pressure environment, guarantee hydrogen safety and stably supply oxygen. And in addition, the system reliability and the environmental adaptability are remarkably improved, and the technical effect of double requirements of hydrogen and oxygen co-production in special scenes is met.

Title: Polyaryl quinine polymer, preparation method and anion exchange membrane prepared from polyaryl quinine polymer
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production and fuel cells, and particularly relates to a polyaryl quinine polymer, a preparation method and a prepared anion exchange membrane. According to the polyaryl quinine polymer and the anion exchange membrane, a skeleton structure of a full carbon chain is adopted, a more stable functional cation functional group quinine ring structure is introduced to serve as an anion conduction group, and modification of the polymer is achieved through strategies such as copolymerization with a hydrophobic unit, hyperbranched reaction and cross-linking; a polymer with an ultrahigh stable chemical structure is formed, and then the anion exchange membrane with ultrahigh stability is prepared.

Title: Method for preparing membrane electrode of anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell from transition metal sulfide Co-MoS2
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electrochemistry, and discloses a method for preparing a membrane electrode of an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell from transition metal sulfide Co-MoS2, which comprises the following steps of: firstly, preparing a Co-doped MoS2 catalyst by taking cobalt chloride hexahydrate, ammonium molybdate tetrahydrate and thiourea as raw materials through hydro-thermal synthesis, then stirring and mixing the Co-doped MoS2 catalyst with conductive carbon black, anion exchange liquid and the like, and preparing the membrane electrode of the anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell from the Co-doped MoS2 catalyst. According to the present invention, the transition metal sulfide is modified to prepare the slurry, and the slurry is sprayed on the surface of the anion exchange membrane, such that the catalyst suitable for the anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell is obtained, and the membrane electrode can be used for the anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell, and has good water electrolysis performance. The membrane electrode can provide the current density of 1A/cm <-2 > under the voltage of 2.0 V, can stably operate for 100 hours under the current density, and provides an effective strategy for developing a high-performance non-noble metal water electrolysis catalyst.
Applicants: ZHONGKE QINGYIDA YANCHENG TECH CO LTD

Title: Anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell for producing hydrogen by electrolyzing water
Abstract: The invention discloses a water electrolysis hydrogen production anion exchange membrane electrolytic bath which comprises a bath body, an alkali corrosion resisting anode electrode, an alkali corrosion resisting cathode electrode, an anion exchange membrane and a driving mechanism, the alkali corrosion resisting anode electrode, the alkali corrosion resisting cathode electrode, the anion exchange membrane and the driving mechanism are arranged in the bath body, and the driving mechanism comprises a double-shaft motor, a swing assembly and a reciprocating motion assembly. Wherein the swing assembly realizes the swing of the alkali-corrosion-resistant anode electrode, and the reciprocating motion assembly realizes the reciprocating motion of the alkali-corrosion-resistant cathode electrode. According to the application, the double-shaft motor drives the swing assembly and the reciprocating motion assembly to operate simultaneously, so that the alkali corrosion resisting anode electrode swings, the alkali corrosion resisting cathode electrode reciprocates, electrolyte near the electrodes flows and is disturbed, and the dynamic change breaks a concentration boundary layer of the electrolyte near the surfaces of the electrodes; the migration of ions in the electrolyte to the surface of the electrode and the diffusion of reaction products from the surface of the electrode are accelerated, so that the mass transfer rate is improved, and the electrolytic reaction can be carried out more efficiently.
Applicants: BEIJING YINENG HYDROGEN SOURCE TECH CO LTD

Title: Polypropylene-based cross-linked quaternized anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof in hydrogen production by electrolysis of water
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of anion exchange membranes for hydrogen production by electrolysis of water, and discloses a polypropylene-based cross-linked quaternized anion exchange membrane, a preparation method thereof and an application of the anion exchange membrane in hydrogen production by electrolysis of water. Polypropylene is used as a polymer main chain, and benzyl chloride active reaction sites are given to an intermediate film through radiation grafting; further, accurate cross-linking is realized among polymer chain segments through a Menshutkin reaction. Two different flexible cross-linking agents are selected to respectively form different cross-linked networks, so that the defects of weak mechanical property and poor dimensional stability of an uncross-linked film are effectively overcome; and meanwhile, coupling optimization of ionic conductivity, mechanical properties and dimensional stability of the membrane material is realized by precisely regulating and controlling the amination and crosslinking ratio. The anion exchange membrane material shows excellent comprehensive performance and good application potential in related electrochemical application due to the structural matching of the main chain and the side chain and the synergistic balance of multiple gains and multiple properties of the crosslinking effect.
Applicants: UNIV TIANJIN;;WUXI ADVANCED INTERNAL COMBUSTION POWER TECH INNOVATION CENTER

Title: Anion exchange membrane, preparation method thereof and water electrolysis hydrogen production device
Abstract: The invention provides an anion exchange membrane, a preparation method thereof and a water electrolysis hydrogen production device, and belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and the anion exchange membrane comprises a supporting layer and a homogeneous layer located on at least one side in the thickness direction of the supporting layer. The homogeneous layer comprises anion exchange resin, and the supporting layer comprises a porous base material and anion exchange resin filled in the porous base material. Wherein the anion exchange resin comprises a compound as shown in a formula I, and the material of the porous base material comprises at least one of polyether-ether-ketone, polyphenylene sulfide, polyphenylene sulfone, polyether sulfone, polypropylene, polyethylene, polyethylene glycol terephthalate, polytetrafluoroethylene, expanded polytetrafluoroethylene and a liquid crystal polymer. The anion-exchange membrane provided by the embodiment of the invention has high ionic conductivity and good pressure resistance, so that the anion-exchange membrane can meet the requirement of high pressure and realize long-term stable operation while ensuring the water electrolysis efficiency.
Applicants: HUIZHOU EVE HYDROGEN ENERGY CO LTD

Title: Ultramicroporous branched polyaryl piperidinyl anion exchange membrane material as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses an ultra-microporous branched polyaryl piperidinyl anion exchange membrane material as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the field of anion exchange membrane materials for producing hydrogen by electrolyzing water. According to the ultra-microporous branched polyaryl piperidinyl anion exchange membrane material, a four-functionality branching agent with a structure shown in a formula I is introduced into a polymer structural unit of polyterphenyl piperidone, and a polyaryl piperidinyl compound with a four-branch norbornene bis-benzocyclobutane structure is formed. By adopting the technical scheme, the structural rigidity of a polymer skeleton is improved, the formation of a large number of ultra-microporous structures is promoted, the ionic conductivity of the membrane material is effectively improved, and meanwhile, the problem of relatively poor dimensional stability caused by excessive water absorption of the membrane material is solved; the prepared anion exchange membrane has a wide application prospect in the field of hydrogen production by water electrolysis.
Applicants: NINGBO INST MATERIALS TECH & ENG CAS

Title: Low-energy-consumption high-flux anion exchange membrane electrolytic bath and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a low-energy-consumption and high-flux anion-exchange membrane electrolytic bath and a preparation method thereof, relates to the technical field of electrochemical energy conversion and storage, and particularly relates to a low-energy-consumption and high-flux anion-exchange membrane electrolytic bath and a preparation method thereof, and the electrolytic bath comprises an anode runner, a cathode runner and a core functional layer located between the anode runner and the cathode runner. The core functional layer is composed of a modified anion exchange membrane and a composite electrode structure, the modified membrane is subjected to graft copolymerization, crosslinking, doping and other treatment, and the hydrophilic-hydrophobic balance, the ion transmission energy barrier and the chemical stability are optimized; the composite electrode comprises a catalyst layer with an optimized pore structure and active sites and a gas diffusion layer with a gradient pore channel structure and favorable for gas-liquid mass transfer, and the catalyst layer and the gas diffusion layer synergistically improve ion transmission and mass transfer efficiency. The design effectively reduces the operation energy consumption of the electrolytic cell, improves the hydrogen production flux, and is suitable for the field of efficient hydrogen production.

Title: Polyaryl piperidine anion exchange resin, anion exchange membrane and preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention provides polyaryl piperidine anion exchange resin, an anion exchange membrane and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of hydrogen production through water electrolysis. According to the polyaryl piperidine anion exchange resin, the density of functional groups is further improved after side chains are grafted, and the ion exchange capacity and the ion conductivity are remarkably improved when the functional groups are correspondingly applied to an anion exchange membrane; a hydrophobic structure unit is introduced into a main chain, so that a hydrophilic-hydrophobic microphase separation structure is optimized, the swelling degree of the anion exchange membrane is reduced, and the chemical stability is improved; in addition, the molecular weight of a polymer main chain can be controlled by controlling the feeding proportion of the monomers, so that the mechanical property of the diaphragm can be improved.
Applicants: CHONGQING MANENSITE NEW MATERIAL TECH CO LTD

Title: Anion exchange membrane water electrolysis anode catalyst material and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of anode catalyst materials, in particular to an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis anode catalyst material and a preparation method thereof.The preparation method of the anion exchange membrane water electrolysis anode catalyst material comprises the following steps that firstly, an iron source, a nickel source and a double-template agent are mixed, and a mixed solution is obtained; 2, adding a precipitant into the mixed solution obtained in the step 1, carrying out a co-precipitation reaction, and controlling the pH value of a reaction system to be 8-12, the reaction temperature to be 60-100 DEG C and the reaction time to be 6-24 hours, so as to obtain a co-precipitation product; and 3, calcining the co-precipitation product in air or oxygen atmosphere, heating to 500-600 DEG C at a heating rate of 1-10 DEG C/min, keeping the temperature for 2-5 hours, and cooling to room temperature to obtain the anode catalyst material. According to the technical scheme, high catalytic activity, excellent mass transfer performance and high specific surface area are balanced.
Applicants: BEIJING YINENG HYDROGEN SOURCE TECH CO LTD

Title: Mesh electrode for alkaline electrolytic bath and anion exchange membrane electrolytic bath and preparation method of mesh electrode
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrogen production through water electrolysis, in particular to a mesh electrode for an alkaline electrolytic cell (ALK) and an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell (AEM) and a preparation method of the mesh electrode. A mesh electrode for an alkaline electrolytic cell and an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell is formed by weaving multi-element alloy wires, the expression of the components of the alloy wires is FeaCobNicCudTieTafHfgZrhAliMoj, and the atomic percent of the components meets the equation that a + b + c + d + e + f + g + h + i + j = 100 at%, and the content of each component is adjustable in a range of 0-55 at%. The number of knitting meshes of the electrode is 40-60, and the diameter of the alloy wire is 0.1-2.0 mm. The wire is prepared from pure elements (including at least four of Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Ti, Ta, Hf, Zr, Al and Mo) with the purity larger than or equal to 95 wt% through the smelting process, the annealing process and the dealloying process. The mesh electrode provided by the invention can be directly used for an ALK/AEM electrolytic cell, does not need structural adaptation or process adjustment, and has excellent catalytic activity and long-term operation stability.

Title: Anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production and waste heat recovery system
Abstract: The invention discloses an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production and waste heat recovery system. The system is composed of a water electrolysis hydrogen production system, a steam compression type refrigeration cycle system, a gas purification system and a waste heat recovery system. The water electrolysis hydrogen production system is used for electrolyzing water to produce hydrogen and oxygen; the steam compression type refrigeration cycle system comprises an evaporator, a compressor, a condenser and a throttle valve; the gas purification system is used for cooling and drying hydrogen to finally obtain hydrogen with qualified purity; cooling liquid in the waste heat recovery system absorbs heat released by the condenser, and high-temperature cooling liquid can be stored in the heat storage tank to be used for providing domestic hot water and heating and can enter the circulation heat exchanger through a pipeline to heat alkali liquor or pure water in a circulation loop. According to the invention, low-grade heat energy in the electrolysis process is converted into high-grade heat energy, and the high-grade heat energy is fully recycled, so that the electric energy consumption in the hydrogen purification process is reduced, and the adaptability of the anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production system under the variable load working condition is improved.
Applicants: SHAANXI QINGNENG POWER TECH CO LTD

Title: Norbornene-containing bis-benzocyclobutane polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane material as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses an anion exchange membrane material containing norbornene dibenzocyclobutane polyaryl piperidine as well as a preparation method and application of the anion exchange membrane material, and relates to the field of anion exchange membrane materials for hydrogen production by electrolysis of water. According to the invention, norbornene bis-benzocyclobutane is introduced into a polymer main chain of aromatic hydrocarbon and piperidone to form a distorted and difficult-to-rotate space structure. By adopting the technical scheme, the structural rigidity and larger free volume of a polymer skeleton are improved, the formation of a large number of microporous structures is promoted, the agglomeration of ion clusters is facilitated, more phase separation structures are formed, and the ionic conductivity of the membrane material is improved through the synergistic effect of the two, so that the membrane material is more stable in performance. And meanwhile, the problem of relatively poor dimensional stability caused by excessive water absorption of the membrane material is inhibited, and the prepared anion exchange membrane has a wide application prospect in the field of hydrogen production by water electrolysis.
Applicants: NINGBO INST MATERIALS TECH & ENG CAS

Title: Membrane electrode assembly of anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell and preparation method of membrane electrode assembly
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, in particular to a membrane electrode assembly of an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell and a preparation method of the membrane electrode assembly. Comprising the following steps: step 1, adding modified titanium dioxide, an epoxy group cross-linking agent and a modified polymer into toluene, and homogenizing; casting by using a phase inversion method, and carrying out cross-linking treatment at 75-85 DEG C for 6-8 hours to obtain an anion exchange membrane; step 2, respectively spraying cathode catalyst slurry and anode catalyst slurry on two sides of the anion exchange membrane, drying and curing to form a cathode catalyst layer and an anode catalyst layer; a cathode protection layer is attached to the surface of the cathode catalyst layer through vacuum adsorption, an anode protection layer is attached to the surface of the anode catalyst layer through vacuum adsorption, and rolling is conducted; therefore, the membrane electrode assembly of the anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell is obtained.
Applicants: BEIJING YINENG HYDROGEN SOURCE TECH CO LTD

Title: Anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to an anion exchange membrane as well as a preparation method and application thereof, the anion exchange membrane comprises ionic liquid functionalized inorganic hydrophilic particles and an ionic liquid modified polymer, and the ionic liquid functionalized inorganic hydrophilic particles and the ionic liquid modified polymer have synergistic interaction; the prepared anion exchange membrane has excellent comprehensive properties such as intrinsic hydroxyl conductivity, alkali-resistant stability and mechanical strength, can enable an alkaline water electrolysis bath to operate efficiently and stably, and meets the application requirements in alkaline electrolyzed water.
Applicants: QINGDAO GREEN DEVELOPMENT RESEARCH INST CO LTD

Title: Covalent organic framework composite polybiphenyl piperidyl anion exchange membrane and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a covalent organic framework composite polybiphenyl piperidyl anion exchange membrane and a preparation method thereof. The covalent organic framework composite polybiphenyl piperidyl anion exchange membrane is an organic membrane which is formed by taking quaternized polybiphenyl piperidyl QAPIP as a membrane matrix and taking a mixed methyl grafted COF-TpBpy framework or a functionalized ionic liquid impregnated COF-TpBpy framework as an ion channel. A modified COF-TpBpy framework ion channel is introduced into quaternized polybiphenyl piperidine to construct the novel covalent organic framework composite polybiphenyl piperidyl anion exchange membrane, an ion migration channel can be remarkably widened, a transmission path can be optimized, the ion transmission efficiency of a membrane material can be improved, and a technical scheme with higher efficiency is provided for the fields of hydrogen production through water electrolysis and the like.

Title: Branched anion exchange membrane material as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a branched anion exchange membrane material as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The material has a structure as shown in a formula 1, in the formula 1, xgt; 0, ygt; 0, 1-x-ygt; 0. The branched poly (fluorenyl-aryl-piperidine) anion exchange membrane material has excellent conductivity, and provides a high-performance and low-cost anion exchange membrane material for an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis technology, so that the industrialization process of a green hydrogen preparation technology is promoted.

Title: A PURE HYDROGEN GAS PRODUCTION SYSTEM AND METHOD
Abstract: The invention relates to a pure hydrogen gas production system (A) for use in hydrogen production technologies, including applications such as energy storage, fuel cells, and industrial chemical processes. The system (A) is characterized by including at least one top cover (10) that encloses the upper portion of the system and protects its internal components from external factors, and at least one bottom cover (20) that encloses the lower portion of the system, ensuring the stable and secure positioning of the electrolysis cell. It also features a water inlet (30) that allows the introduction of water containing potassium hydroxide into the system (A), at least one anode (60) functioning as the positive electrode, and at least one cathode (70) functioning as the negative electrode during the electrolysis process. Conductive plates (100) are included to ensure efficient transmission of electrical current to the electrolysis cell, along with at least one sealing element (101) positioned between the conductive plates (100) to ensure the liquid- tightness of the electrolysis cell. Furthermore, an anion exchange membrane (90) with high selectivity and permeability is positioned within the void (102) of the conductive plates (100). This membrane purifies the HHO gas generated by the electric current passing between the anode (60) and the cathode (70) during electrolysis, separating water molecules and extracting pure hydrogen gas.

Title: Anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production system and operation control method thereof
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of AEMWE electrolytic cell hydrogen production, and discloses an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production system and an operation control method thereof. According to the invention, an AEM electrolytic bath is provided, and an anode electrode of the AEM electrolytic bath adopts a nickel-iron layered double hydroxide catalyst taking nickel felt or foamed nickel as a carrier; establishing a current density-Faraday efficiency relation model of the AEM electrolytic cell; based on the current density-Faraday efficiency relation model, calculating the comprehensive Faraday efficiency under the fluctuation current input condition; and according to the comprehensive Faraday efficiency, operating parameters of the AEM electrolytic cell are adjusted, and the hydrogen production efficiency and the safety performance are optimized. Through a quantitative model and intelligent control, efficient and safe response of the hydrogen production system to renewable energy fluctuation is achieved, high-proportion absorption of renewable energy is achieved, the economical efficiency and reliability of green hydrogen preparation are improved, and a quantitative basis is provided for a dynamic operation strategy of the AEMWE hydrogen production system.

Title: Water Electrolyzers Employing Anion Exchange Membranes
Abstract: Water electrolyzers comprises an anode comprising a quantity of anode catalyst, a cathode comprising a quantity of cathode catalyst with an inlet for introducing a cathode reactant thereto, an anion-conducting polymer electrolyte membrane interposed between said anode and said cathode, and a source of electrical energy that applies a voltage between the anode and cathode. At least one of said anode catalyst or said cathode catalyst comprises a metal or metal alloy having a surface area of at least 12 m2/gm. Water electrolyzers preferably employ base metal catalysts and an anion-conducting polymeric membrane with a resistance below 0.3 ohm-cm2 and a base metal catalyst with a surface area of at least 12 m2/mg.

Title: WATER ELECTROLYZERS EMPLOYING ANION EXCHANGE MEMBRANES
Abstract: Water electrolyzers comprises an anode comprising a quantity of anode catalyst, a cathode comprising a quantity of cathode catalyst with an inlet for introducing a cathode reactant thereto, an anion-conducting polymer electrolyte membrane interposed between said anode and said cathode, and a source of electrical energy that applies a voltage between the anode and cathode. At least one of said anode catalyst or said cathode catalyst comprises a metal or metal alloy having a surface area of at least 12 m2/gm. Water electrolyzers preferably employ base metal catalysts and an anion-conducting polymeric membrane with a resistance below 0.3 ohm-cm2 and a base metal catalyst with a surface area of at least 12 m2/mg.

Title: FABRICATION OF MEMBRANE ELECTRODE ASSEMBLIES AND REVERSIBLE ELECTROCHEMICAL DEVICES
Abstract: Membrane assemblies for electrochemical devices are provided, along with methods and system for fabricating them. Membrane assemblies comprise anode layer(s) and cathode layer(s), separated by membranous separation layer(s) and all embedded in continuous polymerized ionomer material. In production, during continuous deposition of ionomer material on a substrate (e.g., by electrospinning or electrospraying), consecutive deposition stages of catalyst material and optionally binder material are performed. For example, anode particles, binder material and cathode particles may be deposited (e.g., by electrospraying or electrospinning, respectively) consecutively during the continuous deposition o the ionomer material. Self-refueling power-generating system are provided, which include reversible anion exchange membrane devices with disclosed membrane assemblies.

Title: Anode for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis, preparation method of anode and water electrolysis tank
Abstract: The invention relates to an anode for water electrolysis of an anion exchange membrane, a preparation method of the anode and a water electrolysis tank. The anode for water electrolysis of the anion exchange membrane comprises a substrate and an anode catalyst layer, the anode catalyst layer comprises an ionomer; in the structural formula of the ionomer, Ar is aryl, R1 and R2 are respectively and independently alkyl, and X <-> is monovalent anion. The thickness of the anode catalyst layer is only several microns, the anode catalyst layer and the anion exchange membrane with the cathode catalyst layer can be assembled into a membrane electrode, the membrane electrode has the structural characteristic of zero polar distance, stacking is more compact, the capacity of resisting external condition fluctuation is improved, and the response speed during large-current-density loading is increased. And the anode catalyst layer contains ionomers, so that the anode catalyst layer has relatively high bonding capacity, stripping and loss of the anode catalyst layer caused by liquid scouring and bubble precipitation during working can be prevented, and the operation stability is improved.
Applicants: HUIZHOU EVE FUEL CELL CO LTD

Title: Porous transport layer integrated electrode and anion exchange membrane water electrolysis device including the same
Abstract: The present invention relates to an electrode integrated with a porous transport layer and an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis device including the same, and more specifically, to an electrode integrated with a porous transport layer and an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis device including the same, wherein a porous electrode is manufactured with an active material that can be used for an electrode, so that a separate porous transport layer (ptl) is not required, and can be simultaneously utilized as an electrode and a porous transport layer (ptl). According to the present invention, unlike a conventional method, the electrode layer and the porous transport layer (ptl) are integrated, thereby simplifying a manufacturing process of the entire anion exchange membrane water electrolysis device and improving performance and durability.

Title: Crosslinking type polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a cross-linked polyarylpiperidine anion exchange membrane as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of anion exchange membranes. According to the anion exchange membrane, polyarylpiperidine is used as a framework, a crown ether structure and a cross-linked network are introduced, and the technical problem that the conductivity and dimensional stability of hydroxyl in an existing anion exchange membrane are difficult to balance is solved. The anion exchange membrane comprises a repetitive unit with a specific structure, and is prepared through Friedel-Crafts super acid catalytic polymerization, Menshutkin reaction functionalization and Michael addition reaction crosslinking. The anion-exchange membrane has excellent hydroxyl conductivity, dimensional stability, chemical stability and mechanical strength, the preparation method is easy to operate, the polymerization rate is high, the conversion rate is high, the temperature and oxygen of a reaction environment do not need to be strictly controlled, and the anion-exchange membrane is suitable for the field of hydrogen production through water electrolysis, especially suitable for an anion-exchange membrane water electrolysis system and has good application prospects. And the method has a wide industrial application prospect.

Title: Nitrogen-containing multipolymer and preparation method thereof, anion resin and anion exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention provides a nitrogen-containing multipolymer. The multipolymer comprises at least two of a chain segment I, a chain segment II and a chain segment III, the chain segment I is # imgabs0 #, wherein Ar1 is an aryl structural unit; the chain segment II is # imgabs 1 #, wherein Ar2 is an aryl structural unit; the chain segment III is # imgabs2, wherein Ar3 is an aryl structural unit. The multipolymer provided by the invention has excellent structural stability, and different types of chain segments contained in the multipolymer can be firmly connected, so that the anion exchange membrane prepared from the multipolymer has good flexibility and is not easy to break in the application process. Besides, the anion resin and the anion-exchange membrane prepared from the multipolymer provided by the invention are also beneficial to improving the alkali resistance of the materials, so that the membrane material can be kept stable and is not easy to degrade when the anion resin and the anion-exchange membrane are applied to the fields of hydrogen production by water electrolysis and the like.
Applicants: HUIZHOU EVE HYDROGEN ENERGY CO LTD

Title: Dicationic modified COF composite polybiphenyl piperidine anion exchange membrane and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to a dication modified COF composite polybiphenyl piperidyl anion exchange membrane and a preparation method thereof. The dication modified COF composite polybiphenyl piperidyl anion exchange membrane is an organic membrane formed by taking quaternized polybiphenyl piperidyl QAPIP as a membrane matrix and taking a mixed hexamethylene brominated bis (trimethylamine) functionalized ionic liquid impregnated COF framework as an ion channel with a dynamic site. A modified COF framework ion channel is introduced into quaternized polybiphenyl piperidine to construct the novel dication modified COF composite polybiphenyl piperidyl anion exchange membrane, so that an ion migration channel can be remarkably widened, a transmission path can be optimized, the ion transmission efficiency of a membrane material can be improved, and the service life of the membrane material can be prolonged. And a more efficient technical scheme is provided for the fields of electrolytic water hydrogen production electrolytic cells and the like.

Title: Ionic polymer based on flexible main chain, anion exchange membrane and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention provides an ionic polymer based on a flexible main chain, an anion exchange membrane and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the anion exchange membrane comprises the following steps: mixing 1, 7-dichloro-4-heptanone and a trimethylamine solution in a first organic solvent to obtain N1, N1, N1, N7, N7, N7-hexamethyl-4-oxoheptane-1, 7-ammonium dichloride; mixing the ionic polymer with a hydroxyl-containing all-carbon flexible polymer main chain and aromatic aldehyde and/or aromatic ketone in the presence of a second organic solvent and a catalyst to obtain an ionic polymer based on the flexible main chain; and mixing the ionic polymer based on the flexible main chain with a third organic solvent, drying the mixed solution to form a membrane, and soaking the membrane in an alkali solution to obtain the anion exchange membrane of which the anion is hydroxyl. The ionic polymer and/or anion exchange membrane based on the flexible main chain prepared by the invention has the characteristics of excellent mechanical properties, high ionic conductivity, low swelling ratio, high antioxidant stability, high alkali-resistant stability, high fuel cell performance and high water electrolysis performance.

Title: Side chain type polyaryl anion-exchange membrane, preparation method and application thereof and anion-exchange membrane electrolytic cell
Abstract: The invention relates to a side chain type polyaryl anion-exchange membrane, a preparation method and application thereof and an anion-exchange membrane electrolytic bath, and belongs to the technical field of hydrogen energy. The preparation method of the side chain type polyaryl anion exchange membrane comprises the following steps: reacting a side chain type polyaryl skeleton polymer with a quaternization reagent to obtain a side chain type polyaryl anion polymer; the side-chain type polyaryl anion polymer is subjected to membrane forming, and the side-chain type polyaryl anion exchange membrane is obtained. According to the invention, a heteroatom-free polyaryl structure is selected as a main chain, and a super-acid-catalyzed Friedel-Crafts reaction is adopted for polymerization, so that the high-molecular polymer is obtained; the cationic functional group is a piperidine cationic functional group with excellent alkali stability; the piperidine cation functional group is connected with the polyaryl main chain through a long alkyl chain. According to the invention, a long alkyl chain is adopted to combine a polyaryl skeleton with a piperidine cation functional group, and a hydrophilic/hydrophobic microphase separation structure is constructed in the membrane, so that the conductivity of hydroxyl ions is remarkably improved while the alkali stability and the size stability are improved.

Title: Anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and particularly relates to an anion exchange membrane as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The anion exchange membrane comprises ion resin and a modifier; the ion resin is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 5 to 10 parts of tribasic acid, 5 to 10 parts of penta-amine, 20 to 30 parts of hexaphenyl nitrite, 20 to 30 parts of aluminum oxide and 30 to 40 parts of pyridine; the modifier is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 5 to 10 parts of hexanediol, 10 to 15 parts of hydrobromic acid, 20 to 25 parts of acetonitrile, 40 to 45 parts of concentrated sulfuric acid, 1 to 3 parts of vinyl imidazole, 3 to 6 parts of normal hexane and 6 to 10 parts of methanol. The anion exchange membrane has the beneficial effects that the anion exchange membrane has relatively high conductivity, good stability, high mechanical strength and low swelling rate; and the commercialization process of the AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production technology can be greatly promoted when the method is applied to the water electrolysis hydrogen production aspect.
Applicants: HUANENG YIMIN COAL & ELECTRICITY CO LTD;;HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RES INST

Title: WATER ELECTROLYSIS CATALYSIS PROMOTER AND WATER ELECTROLYSIS DEVICE USING THE SAME
Abstract: The present invention relates to a catalysis promoter dissolved in an electrolyte of a water electrolysis device using an alkaline electrolyte and promoting the catalytic activity of an oxygen evolution electrode.

Title: Phenycenyl polymer, preparation method and application of ptycenyl polymer in anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water
Abstract: The invention provides a ptycenyl polymer, a preparation method and application of the ptycenyl polymer in anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water, the ptycenyl polymer is grafted with ptycene molecules with at least one part of polyfunctionality on a main chain, the structural formula of the ptycenyl polymer is # imgabs0 #, IP is a ptycene molecule, # imgabs1 # is an aromatic molecule, x is the grafting degree of the ptycene molecule, x is greater than or equal to 0.01 and less than or equal to 0.4, m is the functionality of the ptycene molecule, and n is greater than or equal to 0.01 and less than or equal to 0.4. And 3 < = m < = 9. The ptycenyl polymer is synthesized by adopting a fractional step method, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, carrying out super acid condensation reaction on polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon molecules and N-methyl-4-piperidone to form a prepolymer; and then adding ptycene molecules to carry out graft polymerization reaction. The ptycene polymer can be used as an anion-exchange membrane and/or catalyst layer resin in an anion-exchange membrane water electrolysis device, and solves the problems that the anion-exchange membrane in the prior art cannot give consideration to ionic conductivity, mechanical properties and alkali stability, the gas permeability of the resin is low, and a benzene ring easily adsorbs a catalyst to influence the activity of the catalyst.

Title: Hydrogen production electrolytic tank and water electrolysis device
Abstract: The utility model provides a hydrogen production electrolytic bath and a water electrolysis device. The hydrogen production electrolytic bath comprises an anion exchange membrane, a water storage tank and a water storage tank, the at least two diffusion layers are positioned on two opposite sides of the anion exchange membrane; and the catalyst is formed between the anion exchange membrane and the diffusion layer, the catalyst comprises a nano-chain microstructure, and the nano-chain microstructure is formed by stacking nano-particles. According to the hydrogen production electrolytic tank and the water electrolysis device, the catalytic efficiency can be improved, and the energy consumption can be reduced.
Applicants: SUZHOU JUNA NEW MATERIAL TECH CO LTD;;SHANGHAI JUNA NEW MATERIAL TECH CO LTD

Title: Double-conduction network composite anion exchange membrane, preparation method thereof and electrolysis device
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy materials, in particular to a double-conduction network composite anion exchange membrane, a preparation method thereof and an electrolyzer, and the double-conduction network composite anion exchange membrane comprises a quaternized polymer matrix; amino groups on the surface of the amino-functionalized graphene oxide NH2-GO are connected with quaternary ammonium groups of the quaternized polymer through covalent bonds; the NH2-GO is used for constructing an ion-electron double-conduction network in the membrane. According to the technical scheme, an ion (OH <->)-electron (e <->) double-conduction network is constructed through covalent bond connection of amino-functionalized graphene oxide (NH2-GO) and a quaternized polymer matrix, and meanwhile, CeO2 nanoparticles are added as a free radical scavenger, so that the ionic conductivity, the mechanical strength and the durability of the membrane are remarkably improved. Experimental results show that compared with a traditional physical blend membrane, the conductivity of the membrane can reach 117.7 mS/cm at room temperature, the tensile strength reaches 57 MPa, and the membrane shows excellent comprehensive performance.
Applicants: BEIJING YINENG HYDROGEN SOURCE TECH CO LTD

Title: Branched anion exchange membrane based on tetraphenyl ethylene as well as preparation method and application of branched anion exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention discloses a tetraphenylethylene-based branched anion exchange membrane and a preparation method and application thereof, tetraphenylethylene is used as a branching agent, the tetraphenylethylene, an aromatic monomer and piperidone are subjected to superacid catalytic polymerization to prepare polyaryl piperidine with a star-shaped branched structure, and then quaternary ammonium functionalization and post-treatment are performed to obtain the branched anion exchange membrane (AEM). The branched structure can reduce the stacking density of polymer chains in the membrane, form a high-proportion free volume to improve the water absorption rate, reduce the OH <-> transmission resistance and improve the ionic conductivity; the rigid aromatic branched skeleton can inhibit excessive water swelling of the membrane; the free volume fraction of the membrane can be optimized by regulating and controlling the molar percentage of tetraphenyl ethylene in the copolymerized aromatic monomer, the AEM with high ionic conductivity and dimensional stability is obtained, and the AEM can be applied to an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis cell.

Title: MEMBRANE ELECTRODE ASSEMBLY, ELECTROLYSIS CELL, ELECTROLYSIS DEVICE, AND METHOD FOR PRODUCING MEMBRANE ELECTRODE ASSEMBLY
Abstract: A membrane electrode assembly according to the present disclosure includes a first ion exchange membrane that has a first surface and a second surface located on a side opposite to the first surface, a second ion exchange membrane that has a third surface and a fourth surface located on a side opposite to the third surface, a cathode catalyst layer configured to be provided on the first surface, and an anode catalyst layer configured to be provided on the third surface. The first ion exchange membrane and the second ion exchange membrane are anion exchange membranes having hydroxide ion conductivity and are integrated by making the second surface and the fourth surface face each other.

Title: POLYNORBORNENE-BASED INTERPENETRATING POLYMER NETWORK CROSS-LINKED ANION EXCHANGE MEMBRANE, AND PREPARATION METHOD THEREFOR AND USE THEREOF
Abstract: Provided in the present invention are a polynorbornene-based interpenetrating polymer network cross-linked anion exchange membrane, and a preparation method therefor and the use thereof. In the present invention, the polynorbornene-based interpenetrating polymer network cross-linked anion exchange membrane is prepared from polynorbornene, allylphenol quaternary ammonium salt and polythiol under irradiation from an ultraviolet lamp. The polynorbornene-based interpenetrating polymer network cross-linked anion exchange membrane has a smooth and transparent surface and good conductivity, stability and mechanical properties, overcomes the common problem of balancing conductivity and stability of an AEM, and can be applied to alkaline fuel cells, and devices for alkaline water electrolysis, electrodialysis, waste acid recovery, carbon dioxide reduction, etc.
Applicants: BEIJING CLEANWAY MEMBRANE TEC CO LTD

Title: Main chain spiro-aminated polybenzimidazole, anion exchange membrane thereof, preparation method of ionomer solution and application of main chain spiro-aminated polybenzimidazole and anion exchange membrane of main chain spiro-aminated polybenzimidazole
Abstract: The invention discloses polybenzimidazole with a spirocyclic ammonium main chain, an anion exchange membrane of the polybenzimidazole and a preparation method and application of an ionomer solution, and belongs to the technical field of polymer ion exchange membranes and ionomers. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, carrying out condensation polymerization on aromatic tetramine, cyclohexane diacid and other dicarboxylic acid monomers at high temperature to obtain high-molecular-weight polybenzimidazole containing a cyclohexane structure; then, polybenzimidazole is subjected to a cyclization reaction to obtain polybenzimidazole with a main chain spirocyclic ammoniation, an ionomer solution is prepared, and the alkaline anion exchange membrane is prepared through a solution casting method. The polybenzimidazole anion exchange membrane with the main chain spiro-ammonium and the ionomer prepared according to the invention have outstanding oxidation-resistant stability, excellent solubility, high ionic conductivity and excellent comprehensive performance, and can be applied to the fields of hydrogen-oxygen fuel cells, alkaline water electrolysis, carbon dioxide conversion, energy storage cells, electrodialysis and other electrochemical devices.

Title: Cross-linked poly (biphenyl-piperidine) anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of anion exchange membranes for electrolyzed water, and particularly relates to a cross-linked poly (biphenyl-piperidine) anion exchange membrane as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The cross-linked poly (biphenyl-piperidine) anion exchange membrane has a structural formula as shown in a formula (I), wherein the ratio of x to y is (1-18): (99-82), and the ratio of x to z is (1-18): (99-82); and the crosslinking degree of the crosslinking type poly (biphenyl-piperidine) anion exchange membrane is 1%-18%. A cross-linked structure is introduced into the functionalized poly (biphenyl-piperidine) anion exchange membrane, so that the water absorption and the swelling degree are effectively reduced while the water electrolysis performance of the anion exchange membrane can be ensured, the mechanical strength of the anion exchange membrane is remarkably improved, and the service life of the anion exchange membrane in equipment is prolonged. # imgabs0 #
Applicants: CSSC HANDAN PERIC HYDROGEN ENERGY TECH CO LTD

Title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR WATER ELECTROLYSIS WITH ELECTRODES HAVING NICKEL-COBALT-PHOSPHOROUS-BASED COMPOUNDS
Abstract: Systems and methods are provided for water electrolysis. The system includes an electrolyte material configured for the exchange of anions, a first electrode including a nickel-cobalt-phosphorus-based compound, and a second electrode, wherein the first electrode and the second electrode are configured to exchange the anions through the electrolyte material.

Title: Fault classification method and system for anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electrolytic bath management, and discloses a fault classification method and system for an anion exchange membrane electrolytic bath, and the method comprises the steps: collecting an excitation response signal generated after an AC disturbance signal is applied to a to-be-classified anion exchange membrane electrolytic bath, and the cross concentration of hydrogen in oxygen; the alternating current disturbance signal is set to be formed by compounding a high-frequency sine wave and a low-frequency sine wave; obtaining a first ohmic resistance according to a high-frequency excitation response signal in the excitation response signals; obtaining charge transfer resistance according to a low-frequency excitation response signal in the excitation response signals and the first ohmic resistance; and based on a pre-trained fault diagnosis model and a pre-constructed fault rule base, analyzing the first ohmic resistance, the charge transfer resistance and the cross concentration to obtain a fault classification result. According to the method, the health condition of each specific assembly of the anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell is predicted, the application range is wide, and the fault classification result is more accurate.
Applicants: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

Title: Efficient anion exchange membrane and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses an efficient anion exchange membrane and a preparation method thereof. PPO is adopted as a skeleton, 1,2,4,5-tetramethylimidazole is adopted as a functional group, and a PTFE porous membrane is adopted as a support. According to the anion exchange membrane, the PTFE porous membrane is used as a support, so that the grafting quantity of an ion exchange group can be increased, and the substitution degree can reach 80%, and thus a higher water absorption rate and ionic conductivity are achieved. Meanwhile, due to the addition of the support, the mechanical property of themembrane is greatly enhanced. 1,2,4,5-tetramethylimidazole is selected as a functional group, the alkali stability is excellent, and the conductivity is only reduced from 85mScm<-1> to 80mScm<-1> after treatment is carried out for 150h under the conditions of 80 DEG C and 2M KOH. The method is simple to operate and low in production cost. The anion exchange membrane prepared by the method can be widely applied to the alkaline water electrolysis industry.
Applicants: TIANJIN MAINLAND HYDROGEN EQUIPMENT COMPANY LTD

Title: Cross-linked polystyrene anion exchange membrane and preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a cross-linked polystyrene anion exchange membrane as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the cross-linked polystyrene anion exchange membrane comprises the following steps: firstly, taking styrene and p-chloromethyl styrene as monomers, and obtaining a copolymer through bulk polymerization under the action of an initiator; the preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing a copolymer from polystyrene, then preparing a membrane casting solution from the copolymer and 1, 4-diazabicyclo [2.2. 2] octane, casting to form a membrane, then immersing the obtained membrane into a trimethylamine aqueous solution for complete quaternization, and finally treating in a KOH aqueous solution to obtain the cross-linked polystyrene anion exchange membrane. The invention provides an application of the cross-linked polystyrene anion exchange membrane in alkaline electrolyzed water. The anion exchange membrane is simple in synthesis process, reagents are cheap and easy to obtain, the contradiction between the OH <-> conductivity and the size stability of a traditional anion exchange membrane can be greatly balanced, and meanwhile the anion exchange membrane has high alkaline stability and shows excellent electrolytic performance in alkaline electrolyzed water.

Title: Anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrogen production through water electrolysis, in particular to an anion exchange membrane and a preparation method thereof.The anion exchange membrane comprises a copolymer, and the copolymer comprises a repetitive structure unit containing a specific aromatic three-dimensional twisted monomer; the novel aromatic three-dimensional twisted monomer is innovatively designed and applied, and the high-performance anion exchange membrane is prepared by carrying out super-acid catalytic polymerization on the novel aromatic three-dimensional twisted monomer and the polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon monomer. The introduction of the twisted monomer effectively optimizes the polymer chain spacing and the ion transmission channel, thereby significantly improving the ion transmission and water absorption performance and greatly enhancing the comprehensive performance of the membrane.

Title: Anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production system and method based on seawater
Abstract: The invention discloses a seawater-based anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production system which comprises an anion exchange membrane electrolytic bath unit, a hydrogen gravity type separation unit, a hydrogen washing unit, a hydrogen purification unit, an oxygen gravity type separation unit, an oxygen washing unit, an oxygen-liquid separation unit, a weak alkali liquid circulation unit, a heat exchange unit, a flash evaporation unit and a seawater desalination unit, a vacuum pump unit, a seawater filtering lightering unit and a fresh water storage and supply unit. Fresh water circulation between the flash evaporation unit and the heat exchange unit can be carried out, repeated utilization of fresh water is achieved, hot weak alkali liquid needing to be cooled can be used for heating circulating fresh water, then flash evaporation is carried out on hot fresh water, generated steam serves as a heat source to heat seawater of the seawater desalination unit, low-temperature desalination is carried out on the seawater in a negative pressure environment, and the seawater desalination efficiency is improved. The prepared fresh water can be used as raw material fresh water of the anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell unit.

Title: Polyaralkyl anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a polyaralkyl anion exchange membrane and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of hydrogen production through water electrolysis. A highly hydrophobic perfluoroalkyl side chain and a hydrophilic ureido side chain are introduced into a main chain, and an ion transmission channel is constructed by utilizing hydrophilic and hydrophobic thermodynamic incompatibility; and the formation of the ion channel facilitates the transmission of hydroxyl ions. A hydrogen bond network formed among introduced ureido also promotes efficient transmission of ions, so that the conductivity is improved. On the aspect of mechanical property, on one hand, the lower ion exchange capacity (IEC) can inhibit excessive swelling, and the mechanical property in a wet state is improved; on the other hand, a constructed hydrogen bond is introduced into ureido, so that the interaction force between polymer molecular chains is enhanced, the interchain entanglement is improved, and the anion exchange membrane is endowed with better mechanical properties. The invention effectively solves the problem of mutual restriction effect between high ionic conductivity and wet mechanical properties of the anion-exchange membrane in the existing anion-exchange membrane water electrolysis tank.

Title: COMPONENTS FOR WATER OXIDATION ALKALINE AND ALKALINE MEMBRANE ELECTROLYZERS
Abstract: Disclosed herein are aspects of a composition comprising one or more metal-oxide nanoparticles and porous catalyst layers, comprising an electrically conductive core a surface layer comprising one or more surface active catalysts; and wherein the one or more metal-oxide nanoparticles are electrocatalytic toward oxygen gas evolution in alkaline conditions, alkaline-ionomer conditions, or a combination thereof. Aspects of a method of making such compositions for water oxidation alkaline and alkaline membrane electrolyzers are also disclosed herein. Also disclosed herein is an alkaline-exchange-membrane ionomer-based, hybrid liquid-alkaline, alkaline-ionomer electrolyzer comprising an anode, wherein the anode comprises (i) an ionomer and (ii) the composition disclosed herein and a liquid alkaline electrolyzer comprising an anode, wherein the anode comprises one or more catalysts having the composition disclosed herein, wherein the composition is produced as a powder or as a continuous electrode architecture on metal porous transport layers.

Title: Composite anion exchange membrane and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a composite anion exchange membrane and a preparation method thereof. The membrane comprises a porous substrate and a covalent organic framework functional layer which grows in situ and is bonded on the porous substrate, the functional layer is provided with an ordered skeleton formed by periodically connecting aromatic units through dynamic covalent bonds, and a quaternary ammonium salt type anion exchange group is grafted on the skeleton. The preparation method mainly comprises the steps of performing in-situ polycondensation on a porous substrate to form a precursor, performing in-situ crystallization to construct an ordered skeleton, performing in-situ reduction to enhance stability, performing in-situ quaternization to graft functional groups and the like. According to the invention, through compounding of the porous substrate and the rigid ordered COF skeleton, high mechanical strength and low swelling characteristics are ingeniously combined with high ionic conductivity brought by regular pore channels and grafting groups, and the technical bottleneck that mechanical properties and electrochemical properties of a traditional anion exchange membrane are difficult to consider at the same time is successfully solved. The obtained membrane material shows excellent performance in water electrolysis application, and has a wide application prospect in the field of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production.

Title: SEAWATER ELECTROLYSIS SYSTEM AND MANUFACTURING METHOD THEREFOR
Abstract: The present invention relates to a seawater electrolysis system and a manufacturing method therefor and, specifically, to a seawater electrolysis system comprising a hydrophobic porous separation membrane and an anion exchange membrane, and to a manufacturing method therefor. The present invention relates to a seawater electrolysis system comprising: a first hydrophobic porous separation membrane; an anion exchange membrane; a second hydrophobic porous separation membrane; and an electrolyte, and further comprising: a cathode between the first hydrophobic porous separation membrane and the anion exchange membrane; and an anode between the anion exchange membrane and the second hydrophobic porous separation membrane.
Applicants: JEJU NATIONAL UNIV INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

Title: High-alkali-resistant anion exchange membrane with gradient pore structure and application of anion exchange membrane in hydrogen production by alkaline electrolysis of water
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of anion exchange membranes, in particular to a gradient pore structure high-alkali-resistance anion exchange membrane which is characterized in that brominated polyphenyl ether is used as a base material of the anion exchange membrane, the base material is dissolved in N-methyl pyrrolidone to form a membrane casting solution, and the membrane casting solution is mixed with a solvent to form the anion exchange membrane. Carrying out quaternization reaction on the membrane casting solution to obtain a quaternized brominated polyphenyl ether membrane casting solution; the anion exchange membrane adopts a gradient pore-foaming agent system to form a gradient pore structure, the gradient pore-foaming agent system comprises polyethylene glycol with different particle sizes, and the polyethylene glycol is selected from at least two of polyethylene glycol 2000, polyethylene glycol 4000 and polyethylene glycol 8000; the total thickness of the membrane is from 120 microns to 160 microns, and the porosity is from 35% to 42%. A continuous gradient pore channel structure of lower-layer macropores, middle-layer mesopores and upper-layer small pores is constructed by regulating and controlling the particle size, the adding amount and the pouring process of the pore-foaming agent. The structure can form a synergistic effect of a rapid mass transfer channel and an ion selective barrier.
Applicants: BEIJING YINENG HYDROGEN SOURCE TECH CO LTD

Title: MEMBRANE-ELECTRODE ASSEMBLY FOR A WATER ELECTROLYSER
Abstract: A membrane-electrode assembly for a water electrolyser is provided. The membrane- electrode assembly comprises a polymer electrolyte membrane with a first face and a second face; an anode catalyst layer on the first face of the membrane, the anode catalyst layer comprising an oxygen evolution reaction catalyst; and a porous web of polymer fibres in contact with the anode catalyst layer, the polymer fibres comprising a conductive metal additive.

Title: Poly (4-aryl) piperidine polymer, preparation method and anion exchange membrane prepared from poly (4-aryl) piperidine polymer
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production and fuel cells, particularly relates to a poly (4-aryl) piperidine polymer and a high-stability anion exchange membrane prepared from the poly (4-aryl) piperidine polymer, and further discloses a preparation method and application of the poly (4-aryl) piperidine polymer. According to the poly (4-aryl) piperidine polymer and the anion exchange membrane, a skeleton structure of a full-carbon main chain is adopted, a piperidine ring is far away from a rigid main chain skeleton to enhance the mobility of ions and improve the alkaline stability of quaternary ammonium salt cations, and modification of the polymer is realized through copolymerization with a hydrophobic unit; a polymer with an ultrahigh stable chemical structure is formed, and then the anion exchange membrane with ultrahigh stability is prepared.

Title: Piperidine anion exchange membrane containing anthracene and derivatives thereof, preparation method and application of alkaline membrane electrolysis water tank
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of alkaline anion exchange membranes, and discloses a piperidine anion exchange membrane containing anthracene and derivatives thereof, a preparation method of the piperidine anion exchange membrane and application of an alkaline membrane electrolysis water tank. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, synthesizing piperidine type trimonomer polymers containing anthracene and derivatives thereof in different proportions; then, carrying out quaternization on the polymers by directly taking piperidone of the polymers as functional sites to obtain a membrane material; and preparing the membrane. According to the invention, by introducing anthracene and derivative monomers thereof and utilizing a pi-pi accumulation effect, a functional group anchored on a main chain is induced to self-assemble, so that the formation of a microphase separation structure can be promoted, the water-resistant plasticizing capability of a hydrophobic phase is enhanced, and the swelling of a membrane is inhibited. By adjusting the proportion of the anthracene and the derivative monomer thereof to the p-terphenyl monomer, the rigidity of the polymer can be enhanced, the free volume of the polymer can be expanded, and the dimensional stability and the ion transport capacity of the polymer can be improved. The prepared membrane has good alkali stability and mechanical strength and can be applied to alkaline membrane electrolyzed water.

Title: Ion-ordered anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane electrode and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrogen production membrane electrodes, in particular to an ion ordered anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane electrode and a preparation method thereof. The invention discloses an ion ordered anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane electrode. The membrane electrode comprises an anion exchange membrane substrate; an anode catalyst coating layer; a cathode catalyst coating layer; and the anode catalyst coating layer and the cathode catalyst coating layer are coated with a plurality of anion nanorods. According to the invention, the two sides of the anion exchange membrane substrate are respectively coated with the anode catalyst coating layer and the cathode catalyst coating layer, and the two layers are both coated with the plurality of anion nanorods. The anion nanorod provides a high-speed channel for ion transmission in the membrane electrode, so that the anion conduction efficiency is greatly improved, and meanwhile, the mechanical property of the membrane is not influenced. And meanwhile, the active area of the catalyst layer is effectively increased, and the usage amount of the catalyst can be greatly reduced.
Applicants: CHANGZHOU QINGZHOU ENERGY TECH CO LTD

Title: Energy storage system based on anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production and Ni-H2 battery
Abstract: The invention provides an energy storage system based on an anion exchange membrane electrolysis water hydrogen production and Ni-H2 battery. The energy storage system comprises an AEM water electrolysis device and a Ni-H2 battery device, a cathode of the AEM water electrolysis device is connected with a cathode of the Ni-H2 battery device, and the Ni-H2 battery device is charged by the AEM water electrolysis device. According to the system, a closed loop (hydrogen production-storage-utilization) for hydrogen production and storage is realized, and the energy conversion efficiency is improved.
Applicants: CHINA CHEMICAL SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

Title: Cu2O and NiFe-LDH heterostructure electrocatalyst and integrated catalytic anion exchange membrane electrode as well as preparation method and application of Cu2O and NiFe-LDH heterostructure electrocatalyst and integrated catalytic anion exchange membrane electrode
Abstract: The invention discloses a Cu2O-coated NiFe-LDH heterostructure electrocatalyst, an integrated catalytic anion exchange membrane electrode and a preparation method and application of the Cu2O-coated NiFe-LDH heterostructure electrocatalyst and the integrated catalytic anion exchange membrane electrode. The preparation method of the electrocatalyst comprises the following steps: taking NaOH and CuCl2. H2O as raw materials, adding a formaldehyde solution, and synthesizing Cu2O nanoparticles through a self-exothermic reaction; the preparation method comprises the following steps: taking Ni (NO3) 2.6 H2O and Fe (NO3) 3.6 H2O as raw materials, and carrying out hydrothermal reaction to prepare NiFe-LDH nanosheets; and then Cu2O is added into a reaction system for in-situ growth, and the Cu2O-coated NiFe-LDH composite material is obtained. And loading the obtained composite material on a W-25T anion exchange membrane through an ultrasonic spraying method to obtain the integrated catalytic membrane electrode. The membrane electrode can be used as an anode and a cathode to be assembled into a symmetrical electrode for hydrogen production by alkaline electrolysis of water. The preparation method has the advantages of strong p-n heterojunction interface effect, fast charge transfer, good stability and the like.

Title: Alkenyl tertiary amine monomer for cross-linked anion exchange membrane and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses an alkylene tertiary amine monomer for a cross-linked anion exchange membrane as well as a preparation method and application of the alkylene tertiary amine monomer. The structure of the monomer is shown as a general formula: (R) (R) N-R, R and R are independently selected from alkyl, aryl, heterocyclic group or alkenyl respectively, R is a group containing at least one alkenyl, and at least two groups in R, R and R respectively contain at least one alkenyl. The preparation method comprises the following steps: halogenating tertiary alcohol amine to obtain halogenated tertiary amine, and reacting the halogenated tertiary amine with a Grignard reagent prepared from halogenated olefin to obtain a target monomer. The monomer molecule contains a plurality of alkenyl groups and tertiary amine groups, can be used as a precursor with polymerizable and ionizable functions, and is used for preparing an anion exchange membrane with a three-dimensional network cross-linked structure. The raw materials are easy to obtain, the synthesis route is simple, the product structure is adjustable, and the prepared anion exchange membrane has high ionic conductivity, excellent dimensional stability and alkali resistance and is suitable for electrochemical devices such as alkaline fuel cells and water electrolysis hydrogen production.
Applicants: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN;;SHANDOGN TONGLI NEW MAT CO LTD

Title: Preparation method of anion-exchange membrane electrolytic cell catalytic electrode, and product and application of anion-exchange membrane electrolytic cell catalytic electrode
Abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a catalytic electrode of an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell as well as a product and application of the catalytic electrode. On one hand, a non-noble metal material is used, so that the cost is reduced, and the method is simple and easy to operate; and on the other hand, the catalyst is grown on the substrate material in situ, so that the use of an ionomer is avoided, the process is simplified, and the self-supporting catalytic electrode has more excellent durability. Besides, the formed nanocone-nanoneedle multistage microstructure provides a larger active area for the electrode material, the material is more hydrophilic and aerophobic, and mass transfer in the reaction process is promoted. The multi-metal component introduced into the material also adjusts the electronic structure of the material, so that the catalytic performance is favorably improved.

Title: NiRuM/C catalyst for water electrolysis of anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application of NiRuM/C catalyst
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and particularly relates to a NiRuM/C catalyst for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis as well as a preparation method and application of the NiRuM/C catalyst. The NiRuM/C hydrogen evolution catalyst is prepared by adopting two ways: one way is a coprecipitation method: firstly coating a carbon carrier with amorphous nickel salt by utilizing coprecipitation, and then preparing the NiRuM/C catalyst by utilizing precipitation dissolution equilibrium movement; and 2, a group anchoring method: dispersing metal salts such as nickel, ruthenium and the like and the dopamine hydrochloride surface functionalized carbon material in a polar solvent, and preparing the NiRuM/C catalyst through coordination interaction and self-polymerization reaction of dopamine molecules. The invention provides two preparation ways of the NiRuM/C material with alkaline hydrogen evolution performance better than that of a platinum-based material, and the NiRuM/C material is applied to anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production, so that the problems of complex process, high price, low hydrogen production efficiency, poor durability and the like of the existing preparation technology are solved.

Title: FLUORENE-BASED POLYMER ANION-EXCHANGE MEMBRANE WATER-ELECTROLYSIS DEVICE AND CARBON-DIOXIDE CONVERSION DEVICE
