Abstract: The purpose of one embodiment is to provide an anion exchange membrane having improved performance by including a fluorene-based polymer with excellent ionic conductivity, physical/chemical stability, and durability. Another purpose of the embodiment is to provide an electrolysis device and a carbon dioxide conversion device having improved performance by including an anion exchange membrane with excellent ionic conductivity. A fluorene-based polymer having a structure represented by the chemical formula 1 is provided. In the chemical formula 1, l, m, and n represent the ratios of the monomers in the fluorene-based polymer, X is an integer from 1 to 12, and CY is one or more aromatic rings selected from the group consisting of a substituted or unsubstituted benzene ring, a substituted or unsubstituted naphthalene ring, a substituted or unsubstituted anthracene ring, a substituted or unsubstituted phenylene ring, a substituted or unsubstituted phenanthrene ring, a substituted or unsubstituted dihydrophenanthrene ring, a substituted or unsubstituted pyrene ring, a substituted or unsubstituted chrysene ring, a substituted or unsubstituted naphthacene ring, a substituted or unsubstituted picene ring, a substituted or unsubstituted pentaphene ring, and a substituted or unsubstituted hexacene ring.

Title: Cross-linked polybenzimidazole resin and preparation method and application of anion exchange membrane of cross-linked polybenzimidazole resin
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of high-performance polymer resin and ion exchange membranes thereof, and relates to a preparation method and application of cross-linked polybenzimidazole resin and an anion exchange membrane thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: carrying out copolymerization reaction on aromatic tetramine and dicarboxylic acid to obtain polybenzimidazole resin, and then reacting with a cross-linking agent to obtain cross-linked polybenzimidazole. The preparation method comprises the following steps: carrying out graft modification on polybenzimidazole, reacting with a cross-linking agent, paving the membrane, and carrying out alkali exchange to obtain the functionalized cross-linked polybenzimidazole anion exchange membrane. The cross-linked polybenzimidazole resin prepared by the preparation method disclosed by the invention can be applied to aerospace, automobiles and ships, transportation and other industries. The prepared cross-linked polybenzimidazole anion exchange membrane is excellent in mechanical property and alkali-resistant stability, good in ionic conductivity, low in cost and wide in application prospect in ion exchange membrane water electrolysis, fuel cells, membrane separation and the like.

Title: Pore filling type anion exchange membrane, preparation method thereof and water electrolysis hydrogen production device
Abstract: The invention discloses a pore filling type anion exchange membrane, a preparation method thereof and a water electrolysis hydrogen production device, and belongs to the technical field of ion exchange membranes. The pore filling type anion exchange membrane is prepared from a pretreated polyethylene porous diaphragm and biphenyl piperidone-styrene as shown in a formula 1 in pores of the polyethylene porous diaphragm through a thermal crosslinking reaction, n is larger than or equal to 1 and smaller than or equal to 1000, and x/(n-x) is larger than or equal to 0.1 and smaller than or equal to 1; the polyethylene porous diaphragm is pretreated by soaking in an alcohol solvent. The pore filling type anion exchange membrane is stable and compact, and has good stability and air tightness, relatively high conductivity and alkali resistance and excellent water electrolysis performance.

Title: Halogen-doped nickel-iron-based catalyst, preparation and application thereof in anion exchange membrane electrolysis hydrogen production technology
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of electro-catalysis, and relates to a halogen-doped nickel-iron-based catalyst, preparation and application of the halogen-doped nickel-iron-based catalyst in an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production technology. The preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving trivalent ferric salt without halogen atoms and halide in water, wherein the halide is sodium or potassium halide; the preparation method comprises the following steps: soaking a nickel matrix in a solution, reacting Fe < 3 + > and Ni in the solution to generate Ni < 2 + > and Fe < 2 + >, further reacting Fe < 2 + > and O2 to increase the pH value of the solution, and forming the halogen-doped ferronickel-based catalyst on the surface of the nickel matrix by Ni < 2 + >, Fe < 3 + >, halogen ions and OH <-> in the solution in the pH increasing process. The catalyst is a non-noble metal catalyst, the raw materials are low in cost, the reaction temperature of preparation is close to the room temperature, the preparation steps are simple, the catalyst activity is high, the catalyst is suitable for large-scale production, in addition, the catalyst has good charge transfer capacity, and the excellent electrolytic hydrogen production performance is shown after the catalyst is constructed into an anion exchange membrane electrolytic hydrogen production anode.

Title: Multi-main-chain copolymerized polyaryl anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention provides a multi-main-chain copolymerized polyaryl anion exchange membrane as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and the preparation method of the multi-main-chain copolymerized polyaryl anion exchange membrane comprises the following steps: carrying out polycondensation on an aromatic compound, N-methylpiperidone and 3-quinuclidinone hydrochloride under the catalysis of superacid to obtain a polymer intermediate; carrying out quaternization reaction on the polymer intermediate, end-halogenated perfluoro long-chain alkane and methyl iodide, and introducing a hydrophobic side chain to obtain membrane powder; and finally, dissolving the film powder and coating to form the film. The 3-quinuclidone is introduced to participate in copolymerization, so that the molecular weight and the alkali resistance of a main chain of the polymer are effectively improved; meanwhile, by introducing a perfluoroalkane hydrophobic side chain, a hydrophilic-hydrophobic phase separation structure is constructed, and an effective ion transmission channel is formed. The obtained multi-main-chain copolymerized polyaryl anion exchange membrane has the advantages of low swelling ratio, high mechanical strength, high chemical stability, strong alkali resistance, low membrane resistance and the like, and can be widely applied to the fields of hydrogen production by water electrolysis and the like.
Applicants: SUQIAN SHIDAI ENERGY STORAGE TECH CO LTD

Title: Differential pressure type anion exchange membrane water electrolysis automation system and hydrogen production method
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and discloses a differential pressure type anion exchange membrane water electrolysis automation system and a hydrogen production method. The system comprises an electrolytic bath, a water replenishing unit, a condensing unit, a collecting unit and a controller, and oxygen generated by the electrolytic bath is discharged out after passing through a raw material water tank and an oxygen-water separator in the water replenishing unit under normal pressure; hydrogen generated by the electrolytic cell is subjected to secondary treatment through a hydrogen separator and a hydrogen-water separator in the collecting unit, then is pressurized by a back pressure valve in the collecting unit and then is output, and a differential pressure type system on the two sides of hydrogen and oxygen is formed; the raw material water tank in the water replenishing unit can realize automatic feeding, and the starting and stopping of the circulating pump and the electrolytic bath in the water replenishing unit are controlled by the liquid level in the raw material water tank, so that the full-automatic feeding, circulating and electrolysis control is realized, the intelligent degree of hydrogen production by water electrolysis is greatly improved, the risk of manual regulation and control is reduced, and meanwhile, the miniaturization effect of hydrogen production equipment is achieved.
Applicants: BEIJING ZHONGGUEFENG INDUSTRY TECH DEVELOPMENT LIMITED COMPANY

Title: Anion exchange membrane based on isopropyl piperidone and biphenyl and preparation method of membrane electrode
Abstract: The invention relates to an anion exchange membrane based on isopropyl piperidone and biphenyl and a preparation method of a membrane electrode, the preparation method comprises the following steps: respectively dissolving an aromatic monomer and IPD in a first solvent, and mixing to obtain a mixed solution, the aromatic monomer being BP or TP; dropwise adding an acidic initiator into the mixed solution for reaction at the reaction temperature of-5 DEG C to 0 DEG C to obtain a nitrogen heterocyclic ring polymer intermediate; adding a quaternization reagent into the nitrogen-containing heterocyclic ring polymer intermediate to realize quaternization modification of nitrogen atoms to obtain a quaternization ionomer; and forming a film to obtain the AEM film. The preparation method of the membrane electrode comprises the following steps: respectively forming a cathode catalyst layer and an anode catalyst layer on two opposite sides of an AEM membrane through ultrasonic spraying to obtain the MEA. The AEM membrane and the MEA obtained according to the invention have the characteristics of excellent stability and high water electrolysis performance, can significantly improve the efficiency and durability of AEMWE, and are suitable for the fields of hydrogen production by water electrolysis and the like.

Title: Composite catalyst for hydrogen evolution of anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell and preparation method of composite catalyst
Abstract: The invention relates to a composite catalyst for hydrogen evolution of an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell and a preparation method of the composite catalyst, and belongs to the technical field of electrocatalysts. A transition metal M1-M4 precursor and a Pt precursor are impregnated and adsorbed to a carbon carrier loaded with a rare earth oxide, then the carbon carrier is placed in an inert atmosphere for annealing, the carbon-loaded platinum-based high-entropy cluster/rare earth oxide nanoparticle composite catalyst PtM1M2M3M4/ReOX/C is prepared, and M1-M4 is any combination of transition metal Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn, W or Mo. By utilizing the characteristic that the rare earth oxide can promote water decomposition and anchor clusters under the alkaline condition, the prepared catalyst can remarkably improve the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) electrocatalytic activity and long-term stability under the alkaline condition, shows excellent performance in an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell and keeps long-term stable operation under the industrial-grade current density.

Title: Anion exchange membrane water electrolyser catalyst, preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of anion exchange membrane water electrolyser catalysts, and discloses a preparation method and application of a high-activity AEMWE catalyst. According to the method, metal foam is used as a conductive substrate, a cluster-shaped staggered FeCo-MOG nanoparticle array grows in situ through a solvothermal method, noble metal nanoclusters are anchored on the surface of the FeCo-MOG nanoparticle array, and then low-temperature solid-phase chemical deposition modification is performed to obtain the noble metal-FeCoP (or FeCoS and FeCoSe) composite catalyst rich in defect structure. According to the method, a spraying process and a binder are not needed, chemical bonding integration of the catalyst layer and the diffusion layer is achieved, and the interface stability and conductivity are remarkably improved; by constructing a noble metal-phosphorus (or sulfur, selenium) heterojunction, an electronic structure and a mass transfer path are synergistically optimized, and the catalyst has high catalytic activity and long-term stability. Meanwhile, the loading capacity of the precious metal is extremely low, the method is suitable for industrial macro-quantity preparation, and the industrial current density can reach 1.0 A cm <-2 > only by 1.78 V (V vs.RHE).

Title: Side-chain quinine-based polymer, preparation method and application of side-chain quinine-based polymer in preparation of anion exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention provides a side-chain quinine-based polymer, a preparation method and application of the side-chain quinine-based polymer in preparation of an anion exchange membrane, and belongs to the technical field of fuel cells and hydrogen production by electrolysis of water. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, synthesizing a quinine-based polymer with good alkali resistance from an aromatic monomer, a functional monomer and a quinine monomer through a super-acid catalytic condensation reaction, and secondly, preparing a side-chain quinine-based polymer based on the synthesized quinine-based polymer; and finally, carrying out film casting by taking the side-chain quinine polymer as a main chain polymer, and obtaining the high-performance all-carbon-chain anion exchange membrane in a modification mode of grafting a side chain. The alkaline anion exchange membrane prepared by the invention has excellent chemical stability, ionic conductivity, mechanical property and comprehensive performance, and can be applied to the fields of alkaline fuel cells, water electrolysis, energy storage cells, carbon dioxide conversion, electrodialysis and other electrochemical devices.

Title: Nickel-iron oxygen evolution gas diffusion electrode for anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water and rapid construction method of nickel-iron oxygen evolution gas diffusion electrode
Abstract: The invention provides a ferronickel oxygen evolution gas diffusion electrode for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis and a rapid construction method of the ferronickel oxygen evolution gas diffusion electrode. The rapid construction method of the electrode comprises the following steps: placing pretreated foamed ferronickel in a hydrochloric acid aqueous solution for electrochemical etching, and then washing and drying to obtain the ferronickel oxygen evolution gas diffusion electrode for anion exchange membrane electrolysis water. According to the invention, the anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water ferronickel oxygen evolution gas diffusion electrode is rapidly constructed within several minutes by adopting a one-step method. According to the method, porous foamed ferronickel is used as a gas diffusion layer, in an ultralow-concentration hydrochloric acid solution, an anode electric field is constructed on an electrode/electrolyte interface, the chloride ion adsorption effect is enhanced, an acid environment is coupled, the surface of the foamed ferronickel is directly etched, and the ferronickel-based catalyst with the high specific surface area is synthesized on a substrate in situ. The preparation method is rapid, controllable, simple, low in cost and mild in synthesis condition, and the catalyst has excellent catalytic activity and stability.
Applicants: UNIV SHANDONG;;SUZHOU RESEARCH INSTITUTE SHANDONG UNIV

Title: HYDROGEN EVOLUTION REACTION CATALYSTS, ELECTRODES AND ELECTROLYZERS BASED THEREON AND METHODS OF FABRICATION THEREOF
Abstract: The invention provides, in some aspects, methods for fabricating an electrode comprising a nickel/molybdenum (NiMo) hydrogen evolution reaction catalyst on a carbon support, e.g., for use as a cathode in an electrolyzer. A catalyst of the type described above can be prepared by co-precipitation of nickel and molybdenum oxide species on the carbon support followed by its reduction through heat treatment in the presence of nitrogen. Such a catalyst can alternatively be prepared through the thermal degradation of metal-organic complexes of nickel and molybdenum in the presence of the carbon support. Further aspects of the invention comprise a cathode, e.g., for an anion exchange membrane electrolyzer, comprising a nickel/ molybdenum hydrogen evolution reaction catalyst as described above. Still further aspects of the invention comprise an anion exchange membrane electrolyzer with a cathode as described above.

Title: Preparation method and application of membrane electrode for anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water
Abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a membrane electrode for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis, which comprises the following steps: dissolving a nickel source, an iron source and a magnesium source in deionized water, and adopting an ultrasonic coprecipitation method to obtain a Ni-Fe-Mg LDH material; preparing an anode electrode material from the Ni-Fe-Mg LDH material, conductive carbon black, a dispersing agent and a binding agent; the preparation method comprises the following steps: synthesizing ultrathin Ti3C2Tx nanosheet modified foamed nickel through a stripping etching method, marking the ultrathin Ti3C2Tx nanosheet modified foamed nickel as MXene (at) NF, and carrying out constant-current electrodeposition by taking the MXene (at) NF as a cathode to obtain a cathode electrode material; the anode electrode material and the cathode electrode material are prepared into an anode electrode and a cathode electrode, and then the anode electrode, the cathode electrode, an anion exchange membrane and a current collector are subjected to hot press molding to obtain the membrane electrode. The prepared membrane electrode adopts a non-noble metal catalyst, is low in cost and easy to prepare, shows excellent electrochemical performance in a water electrolysis test, and can be compared favorably with a membrane electrode prepared from a noble metal catalyst.
Applicants: HUAQING GUANGDONG NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

Title: High-durability anion exchange membrane water electrolysis catalyst layer manufacturing method thereof and water electrolysis electrode and water electrolysis device including the same
Abstract: The present invention relates to a highly durable anion exchange membrane water electrolysis catalyst layer, a manufacturing method thereof, and a water electrolysis electrode and a water electrolysis device comprising the same, and more specifically, to a water electrolysis catalyst layer, a manufacturing method thereof, a water electrolysis electrode and a water electrolysis device comprising the same, wherein the water electrolysis catalyst layer coated with polydopamine is provided to prevent the separation of a hydrogen catalyst layer, and the durability and energy conversion efficiency of the water electrolysis device are increased through strong adhesive force with a mass transfer layer.

Title: Testing device and testing method for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane electrode
Abstract: The invention relates to the field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and provides a testing device and a testing method of an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane electrode, and the testing device comprises an electrolytic tank unit which comprises a cathode area and an anode area and is used for electrolyzing electrolyte; the gas-liquid separation unit comprises a cathode gas-liquid separation unit and an anode gas-liquid separation unit, the cathode gas-liquid separation unit is communicated with the cathode region of the electrolytic tank, and the anode gas-liquid separation unit is communicated with the anode region of the electrolytic tank; the collection unit is communicated with a gas outlet of the gas-liquid separation unit and is used for collecting the gas generated by the electrolytic tank unit; the electrolyte unit is used for providing electrolyte with various concentrations and/or pH values for the electrolytic tank unit; and the computer control system is in communication connection with the electrolytic tank unit, the gas-liquid separation unit, the electrolyte unit, the collection unit and the power supply. The device has the advantages of intelligent regulation and control of the electrolyte concentration and pH value for testing, real-time monitoring and regulation and control, high testing efficiency, good accuracy, strong stability and strong adaptability.
Applicants: HONGJI CHUANGNENG TECH GUANGZHOU CO LTD

Title: IMPROVING THE MECHANICAL PROPERTIES OF ELECTROCATALYTICALLY ACTIVE COMPOSITES
Abstract: The invention is concerned with electrocatalytically active or activatable laminates, and the production and use thereof as anion exchange membrane (AEM) in alkaline water electrolysis. One object of the invention was that of providing a laminate with minimum swelling when used as AEM in alkaline water electrolysis. This is achieved with a textile fabric which is used as reinforcement. An essential aspect of the invention is that of coordination of the fibre material with the membrane material: A fibre material having chemical similarity to the membrane material is used. The chemical similarity mentioned consists in the repeat units of the polymeric fibre material and the ionomer, each of which has at least two phenylene groups.

Title: Catalyst electrode for water electrolysis or fuel-cell with anion exchange membrane and preparation method the same
Abstract: Disclosed is a catalyst for a hydrogen generation reaction or a hydrogen oxidation reaction, which can be used under basic conditions and has significantly improved kinetic properties compared to existing commercial platinum catalysts. The present invention provides a catalyst for electrochemical hydrogen reaction under basic conditions in which 2 to 20 rutheniums are supported in an ensemble form on the surface of a molybdenum carbide-carbon nanocomposite support, a manufacturing method thereof, an anion exchange membrane-based water electrolysis cell including the catalyst, and a ruthenium-based catalyst electrode that can be used as an electrode for a fuel cell.
Applicants: LOTTE CHEMICAL CORP;;KOREA ADVANCED INST SCI & TECH

Title: Anion exchange membrane electrolysis device
Abstract: The utility model discloses an anion exchange membrane electrolysis device, and relates to the technical field of electrolysis devices. The device comprises a tank body, a diaphragm is fixed in the center in the tank body, a cathode is fixed on one side of the tank body, and an anode is fixed on one side of the tank body far away from the cathode; fixing plates are fixed at the tops of the cathode and the anode; a placing plate is movably connected to the top of the fixing plate; threaded holes are formed in the surfaces of the placing plate and the fixing plate; a support is fixed to the upper surface of the placing plate. A positioning plate is fixed to the top of the support. Under the action of the transmission plate, the cleaning device is driven by the motor and linked with the transmission plate, so that the cleaning device can reciprocate, comprehensively clean a cathode diaphragm and an anode diaphragm and wash scale on the surfaces of the diaphragms in a large area, and the placing plate can be flexibly mounted and dismounted on the fixing plate, so that the cleaning device is convenient to use. Therefore, the cleaning device can be mounted or dismounted according to the use condition, and can flexibly operate in the space between the cathode and the anode without influencing the normal use of the device.
Applicants: ANHUI PENRUN ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

Title: CO2 corrosion resistant high-stability anion exchange membrane and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a CO2 corrosion resistant high-stability anion exchange membrane and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of electrochemical materials. The anion exchange membrane comprises a surface compact layer and an inner support layer, the surface compact layer is a PAEN nanofiber layer, and phosphonate groups and a free radical scavenger are doped in the PAEN nanofiber layer; and the inner supporting layer is a porous PAEN base material. Through gradient pore structure design, phenothiazine free radical scavenger adding and a roll-to-roll continuous process, the technical effects that the membrane conductivity is larger than or equal to 80 mS/cm, the alkali-resistant life is larger than or equal to 3000 hours, and the CO2 permeability is smaller than or equal to 1 * 10 <-6 > cm < 3 >/cm < 2 >. S are achieved, the performance of an AEM electrolytic cell in a pure water environment is remarkably improved, the service life of the AEM electrolytic cell in the pure water environment is remarkably prolonged, and key material support is provided for large-scale production of green hydrogen.
Applicants: HUANENG YIMIN COAL & ELECTRICITY CO LTD;;HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RES INST

Title: Application of ruthenium-based pyrochlore in hydrogen production of alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell
Abstract: The invention relates to an application of ruthenium-based pyrochlore in hydrogen production of an alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolytic bath, which comprises the following steps: providing ruthenium-based pyrochlore Pb2M2-xRuxO7, in which M is Fe, Co, Ni, Cu or Zn, 0 lt; xlt; 2; ruthenium-based pyrochlore and the first mixed solution are mixed and then subjected to ball milling, and first slurry is obtained; removing the first mixed solution in the first slurry to obtain ball-milled ruthenium-based pyrochlore; mixing and dissolving the ball-milled ruthenium-based pyrochlore and carbon powder in a second mixed solution, and adding a dispersing agent for barreling to obtain second slurry; and ultrasonically spraying the second slurry on an anion exchange membrane to serve as an oxygen evolution anode. According to the invention, the ruthenium-based pyrochlore Pb2Ru2O7 is subjected to B-site 3d transition metal doping, so that not only is the use amount of noble metal Ru reduced and the cost of the catalyst reduced, but also the reaction energy barrier of electrolyzed water is jointly reduced under the synergistic effect of Ru and 3d transition metal, and the oxygen evolution activity is further improved.

Title: Hybrid water electrolysis system
Abstract: An integrated water electrolysis system comprises: a high concentration electrolyte tank; a low concentration electrolyte tank which receives an electrolyte of a first concentration from the high concentration electrolyte tank and dilutes the same with an electrolyte of a second concentration; an alkali water electrolysis stack which receives the electrolyte of the first concentration from the high concentration electrolyte tank; an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis stack which receives the electrolyte of the second concentration from the low concentration electrolyte tank and generates hydrogen; and a dryer which removes moisture of first hydrogen generated in the alkali water electrolysis stack and second hydrogen generated in the anion exchange membrane water electrolysis stack to discharge dry hydrogen. The integrated water electrolysis system can provide a water electrolysis system capable of using both an alkali water electrolysis method capable of producing a large amount of hydrogen at a low price and an anion exchange membrane method capable of producing high-purity hydrogen at a relatively low cost using a non-noble metal catalyst.
Applicants: HD HYUNDAI HEAVY INDUSTRIES CO LTD

Title: Anion exchange membrane electrolysis water/seawater hydrogen production catalyst, preparation method, electrolytic bath and electrolysis method
Abstract: The invention discloses an anion exchange membrane electrolysis water/seawater hydrogen production catalyst, a preparation method, an electrolytic bath and an electrolysis method. The preparation method of the catalyst comprises the following steps: S1, carrying out ultrasonic cleaning and vacuum drying on foamed nickel to obtain pretreated foamed nickel; s2, immersing the pretreated foamed nickel into the deposition liquid, performing deposition preparation by adopting a cathode cyclic voltammetry deposition method under a three-electrode system, taking out and cleaning the deposited foamed nickel, and performing vacuum drying to obtain nickel-cobalt-manganese hydrotalcite; s3, putting the obtained nickel-cobalt-manganese hydrotalcite into a reaction kettle filled with a selenylation solution, putting the reaction kettle into a drying oven, carrying out heat preservation reaction, naturally cooling to room temperature after the reaction is finished, washing, and carrying out vacuum drying to obtain a nickel-cobalt-manganese selenide precursor; and S4, putting the obtained nickel cobalt manganese selenide precursor into a plasma cleaning machine, and treating the front surface and the back surface with plasma to obtain the nickel cobalt manganese selenide. The catalyst not only has excellent seawater electrolysis hydrogen evolution catalytic activity, but also has excellent oxygen evolution catalytic activity.

Title: Preparation method and application of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen evolution catalyst
Abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen evolution catalyst. The preparation method comprises the following steps: respectively dissolving a soluble nickel salt and a soluble cobalt salt in deionized water, mixing the two solutions, and carrying out ultrasonic treatment to prepare a precursor reaction solution; adding 85% phosphoric acid solution and 98% sulfuric acid solution into the precursor reaction solution, and shearing; putting the obtained solution into a polytetrafluoroethylene reaction kettle, reacting under a high-temperature condition, and centrifuging, cleaning and drying to obtain a catalyst precursor after the reaction; and calcining the catalyst precursor in a nitrogen atmosphere to obtain the anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen evolution catalyst. The method has the advantages that a hydrothermal calcination synthesis method is adopted, phosphorus and sulfur are introduced in the preparation process, the non-noble metal AEM water electrolysis hydrogen evolution catalyst is synthesized, the electron conduction capacity of the catalyst is remarkably improved, and the catalytic activity and stability of the catalyst are improved.
Applicants: NANTONG HEFAN ENERGY TECH CO LTD

Title: Composite self-supporting anode for anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell and preparation method of composite self-supporting anode
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrogen production through water electrolysis, in particular to a composite self-supporting anode for an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell and a preparation method of the composite self-supporting anode. The composite self-supporting anode for the anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell comprises a self-supporting substrate, an oxygen evolution catalytic layer and an electronic insulation platinum-based hydrogen elimination layer which are sequentially stacked, the oxygen evolution catalytic layer is loaded on the self-supporting substrate, and the electronic insulation platinum-based hydrogen elimination layer is loaded on the oxygen evolution catalytic layer. According to the composite self-supporting anode for the anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell, an electronic path between a dehydrogenation catalyst and an anode conductive substrate is thoroughly blocked, the risk that the dehydrogenation catalyst becomes a new hydrogen source is fundamentally avoided, and stable control over the hydrogen concentration in oxygen and collaborative improvement of the electrolytic efficiency are achieved; and meanwhile, the three-layer structure has a synergistic effect, the dual functions of low hydrogen content in oxygen and efficient oxygen evolution are considered, the mechanical strength is high, the compatibility is high, and a traditional anode can be directly replaced without greatly transforming an electrolytic cell.

Title: Anion exchange membrane electrolytic bath and hydrogen-oxygen generator
Abstract: The utility model provides an end plate, anion exchange membrane electrolyzer and oxyhydrogen generator, the end plate comprises: an end plate body, the end plate body is provided with a first overflow hole along its thickness direction, the end plate body is an insulator; the annular lining is arranged in the first overflowing hole in a sleeved mode. The end plate body is the plate-shaped insulator made of the insulating material, and the end plate body is insulated, so that an insulating plate positioned on one side of the end plate body in the electrolytic cell can be removed, the weight of the electrolytic cell can be reduced, the assembling efficiency of the electrolytic cell can be improved, and the production cost of the electrolytic cell can be reduced; the annular lining is an annular structural part made of corrosion-resistant materials, the annular lining is arranged in the first overflowing hole in a sleeved mode, electrolyte can enter the electrolytic bath through an inner hole of the annular lining, and therefore the end plate body can not make direct contact with the electrolyte, and the service life of the end plate body can be prolonged.
Applicants: HUIZHOU EVE HYDROGEN ENERGY CO LTD

Title: Ether oxygen bond-free type polymer anion-exchange membrane and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses an ether oxygen bond-free type polymer anion-exchange membrane and a preparation method thereof and belongs to the technical field of alkaline anion-exchange membranes. The ether oxygen bond-free type polymer anion-exchange membrane is characterized in that firstly, an ether oxygen bond-free aryl polymer with good solubility and stability is synthesized, then with amino groups of the polymer serving as grafting sites, the polymer is subjected to functionalized grafting to obtain a membrane material, and the membrane material is made into the membrane. The prepared membrane has good alkaline stability and high ion conductivity and can be applied to alkaline polymer electrolytic cells.

Title: ELECTROLYTE MEMBRANE AND CATALYST-COATED ELECTROLYTE MEMBRANE
Abstract: The present disclosure provides an electrolyte membrane (anion exchange membrane) and a catalyst-coated electrolyte membrane having low voltage, exceptional water electrolysis performance, and exceptional mechanical strength in an anion-exchange-membrane-type water electrolysis test. The problem is solved by an electrolyte membrane that satisfies relationship (1), where Xdry (MPa) is the breaking stress under dry conditions, and Xwet (MPa) is the breaking stress under wet conditions.
