Title: ANODE ELECTRODE FOR ANION EXCHANGE MEMBRANE WATER ELECTROLYSIS DEVICE AND MANUFACTURING METHOD THEREOF
Abstract: To provide an anode electrode capable of improving electrolytic performance of an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis device.SOLUTION: An anode electrode has (A) a conductive porous medium and (B) a catalyst layer having a fluorine-based resin and a catalyst and crimped to the porous medium. A contact surface of the catalyst layer with respect to the anion-exchange film is preferably smoothed. The smoothness may be expressed as an arithmetic mean roughness of less than 1.0 μm. The catalyst layer may cover all one surface of the porous medium and provides pores having a pore size of 30 nm or less.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

Title: ELECTROLYTE REGENERATION
Abstract: A system for regenerating electrolyte from an electrochemical cell comprises: a directing means for receiving electrolyte from an electrochemical cell, the directing means having a first outlet and a second outlet; a sensor or sample port positioned between the electrochemical cell and the first and second outlets via which the presence of a contaminant in the electrolyte may be measured; and a purification stage for receiving electrolyte from the second outlet and producing regenerated electrolyte, the purification stage comprising an ion exchange chamber. When a contaminant is detected, the directing means directs at least a portion of the electrolyte through the second outlet to the purification stage. The system is particularly suitable for use with an AEM electrolyser.

Title: Crosslinking type polyaryl anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention provides a cross-linked polyaryl anion exchange membrane and a preparation method and application thereof.The preparation method includes the steps that an aromatic compound and a nitrogen heterocyclic ketone compound are condensed to obtain a polymer intermediate, a terminal alkenyl structure cross-linking site is introduced in the quaternization process, ethyl acetoacetate is additionally added in the membrane scraping process, and the cross-linked polyaryl anion exchange membrane is obtained. And completing crosslinking in a hydroxyl ion replacement process to obtain the anion exchange membrane with high crosslinking degree. The participation of ethyl acetoacetate can make up for the defect of low crosslinking degree in the alkenyl free radical reaction process, and the crosslinking in the hydroxyl ion replacement stage is beneficial to the construction of a stable high-crosslinking-degree two-dimensional membrane structure; after alkali soaking, ethyl acetoacetate is hydrolyzed, and attached hydrophilic groups can effectively increase the hydrophilicity of the ion exchange membrane and reduce the membrane resistance. The cross-linked polyaryl anion exchange membrane has the advantages of low swelling coefficient, excellent mechanical property, high conductivity, stable chemical property, strong alkali resistance and low membrane resistance, and can be widely applied to the fields of hydrogen production by water electrolysis and the like.
Applicants: SUQIAN SHIDAI ENERGY STORAGE TECH CO LTD

Title: Testing device for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane electrode
Abstract: The utility model relates to the field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and provides a testing device of a membrane electrode for water electrolysis hydrogen production of an anion exchange membrane, which comprises an electrolytic tank unit comprising a cathode area and an anode area and used for electrolyzing electrolyte; the gas-liquid separation unit comprises a cathode gas-liquid separation unit and an anode gas-liquid separation unit, the cathode gas-liquid separation unit is communicated with the cathode region of the electrolytic tank, and the anode gas-liquid separation unit is communicated with the anode region of the electrolytic tank; the electrolyte unit is used for providing electrolyte with various concentrations and/or pH values for the electrolytic tank unit; and the computer control system is in communication connection with the electrolytic tank unit, the gas-liquid separation unit and the electrolyte unit. The device has the advantages of intelligent regulation and control of the electrolyte concentration and pH value for testing, real-time monitoring and regulation and control, high testing efficiency, good accuracy, strong stability and strong adaptability.
Applicants: HONGJI CHUANGNENG TECH GUANGZHOU CO LTD

Title: Double-gear-based anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell capable of adjusting operating power
Abstract: The invention discloses a double-gear-based anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell capable of adjusting operating power, which comprises a gear slider mechanism and a plurality of small electrolysis chambers between a cathode current collecting end plate and an anode current collecting end plate, and bipolar plates of the small electrolysis chambers are fixedly connected with current collecting blocks; the gear sliding block mechanism comprises a first connecting plate provided with a first rack, the first connecting plate is slidably connected with a first mounting seat, the first mounting seat is fixedly provided with a first stepping motor used for driving a first driving bevel gear, and the first driving bevel gear drives a first driven gear coaxially arranged with the first driven bevel gear to rotate along the first rack; the first mounting seat is fixedly connected with a second connecting plate provided with a second rack, the first connecting plate is slidably connected with a second mounting seat, and the second mounting seat is fixedly provided with a conductive sliding block making contact with the current collecting block and a second stepping motor used for driving the second driving bevel gear; and the second driving bevel gear drives a second driven gear coaxially arranged with the second driven bevel gear to rotate along a second rack, so that the coupling property of the electrolytic cell and new energy power generation is improved.
Applicants: SHAANXI QINGNENG POWER TECH CO LTD

Title: Differential pressure type anion exchange membrane water electrolysis automation system
Abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and discloses a differential pressure type anion exchange membrane water electrolysis automation system. The system comprises an electrolytic bath, a water replenishing unit, a condensing unit, a collecting unit and a controller, and oxygen generated by the electrolytic bath is discharged out after passing through a raw material water tank and an oxygen-water separator in the water replenishing unit under normal pressure; hydrogen generated by the electrolytic cell is subjected to secondary treatment through a hydrogen separator and a hydrogen-water separator in the collecting unit, then is pressurized by a back pressure valve in the collecting unit and then is output, and a differential pressure type system on the two sides of hydrogen and oxygen is formed; the raw material water tank in the water replenishing unit can realize automatic feeding, and the starting and stopping of the circulating pump and the electrolytic bath in the water replenishing unit are controlled by the liquid level in the raw material water tank, so that the full-automatic feeding, circulating and electrolysis control is realized, the intelligent degree of hydrogen production by water electrolysis is greatly improved, the risk of manual regulation and control is reduced, and meanwhile, the miniaturization effect of hydrogen production equipment is achieved.

Title: Water electrolysis hydrogen production purification system and hydrogen production equipment
Abstract: The invention relates to a water electrolysis hydrogen production purification system and hydrogen production equipment. The system comprises an anion exchange membrane electrolytic tank unit and a hydrogen purification unit, the anion exchange membrane electrolytic tank unit is used for electrolyzing deionized water to generate hydrogen; the hydrogen purification unit is connected with a cathode outlet of the anion exchange membrane electrolytic tank unit and is used for deeply purifying the hydrogen; wherein the anion exchange membrane electrolytic tank unit comprises a membrane electrode and a cathode diffusion layer; the cathode side of the membrane electrode is in close contact with the cathode diffusion layer; and the cathode diffusion layer has an asymmetric gradient aperture and hydrogen selective separation function and is used for performing in-situ selective separation and primary purification on the hydrogen. The integration level of the hydrogen production purification system can be improved, and the operation and maintenance cost can be reduced.
Applicants: GUANGDONG NEW ENERGY STORAGE NATIONAL RESEARCH INST CO LTD

Title: Anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production device
Abstract: The utility model discloses an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production device which comprises a box body, an electric cabinet box arranged in the box body, a radiator, a constant-temperature water tank, a hydrogen pressure lifting valve block device, a water pump, a deionizer, a fan, an electrolytic bath, a temperature sensor I, a temperature sensor II, a pressure sensor I, a pressure sensor II and a working panel, the electric cabinet box is arranged on the right side of the box body, the electrolytic bath and the radiator are arranged on the front side and the rear side of the box body, the fan is arranged under the radiator, the constant-temperature water tank is arranged between the radiator and the electrolytic bath, and the hydrogen pressure lifting valve block device is arranged on the left side of the constant-temperature water tank. The working panel is arranged on the front surface of the box body and is electrically connected with the electric cabinet box; the temperature sensor and the pressure sensor designed by the utility model can be used for detecting the temperature of the constant-temperature water tank, monitoring the water outlet pressure and the water inlet pressure, and monitoring the water outlet temperature and the air outlet pressure of the electrolytic bath.
Applicants: SHENZHEN WENSHI HYDROGEN ENERGY TECH CO LTD

Title: Self-crosslinking poly (aryl piperidine) anion exchange membrane material as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of high-performance anion exchange membranes for hydrogen production by electrolysis of water, and particularly discloses a self-crosslinking poly (aryl piperidine) anion exchange membrane material as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The poly (aryl piperidine) polymer is selected as a main chain without an ether bond, the cyclic piperidinium is selected as a cationic group, the chemical stability of the membrane material can be effectively improved, the free volume of the interior of the membrane material is increased by introducing a meta-terphenyl monomer with a bent conformation into a polymer structural unit, ion transmission is facilitated, and the membrane material has a good application prospect. And a self-crosslinking network is introduced to further promote the formation of an ionic conduction high-speed channel, and meanwhile, the excessive swelling of the membrane is limited, so that the ionic conductivity and mechanical stability of the membrane are improved. The prepared anion exchange membrane can be applied to hydrogen production through water electrolysis.

Title: Membrane electrode for AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a membrane electrode for AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production and a preparation method thereof.The membrane electrode for AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production comprises an anion exchange membrane, an anode catalyst layer and a cathode catalyst layer are arranged on the two opposite side faces of the anion exchange membrane respectively, an anode protection layer is arranged on the side, away from the anion exchange membrane, of the anode catalyst layer, and a cathode protection layer is arranged on the side, away from the anion exchange membrane, of the cathode catalyst layer; a cathode protection layer is arranged on one side, far away from the anion exchange membrane, of the cathode catalyst layer; and the anode protection layer, the anode catalyst layer, the anion exchange membrane, the cathode catalyst layer and the cathode protection layer are sequentially connected to form an integral structure. The membrane electrode has the characteristics of low impedance and high catalytic activity, and can obviously improve the efficiency of hydrogen production by electrolyzing water when being used in an AEM electrolytic cell, and the preparation method has the advantages of simple steps and easily available raw materials, and can be used for large-scale industrial production.
Applicants: HUIZHOU EVE HYDROGEN ENERGY CO LTD

Title: Non-noble metal gas diffusion anode, preparation thereof and application of non-noble metal gas diffusion anode in anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production
Abstract: The invention relates to a non-noble metal gas diffusion anode for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production and a preparation method of the non-noble metal gas diffusion anode. The gas diffusion anode is composed of a hydrophilic conductive substrate such as nickel felt or foamed nickel and a catalytic layer, and the catalytic layer takes nickel-based non-noble metal alloy and sulfide, nitride or phosphide of nickel-based or alloy as catalytic active components. High-energy polymers such as quaternized polystyrene, quaternized modified polynorbornene, polytetrafluoroethylene, polyvinylidene fluoride or perfluorosulfonic acid resin are used as binders, and a catalyst layer is formed on a substrate through a certain process, so that the gas diffusion anode is formed. The non-noble metal gas diffusion anode for hydrogen production through water electrolysis of the anion exchange membrane provided by the invention takes the non-noble metal as an active component, has the obvious advantages of high current density and strong stability compared with the similar technology, and can be applied to various anion exchange membrane water electrolysis electrochemical oxidation reactors or electrolytic tanks as anodes.

Title: Preparation method of modified polyphenyl ether anion exchange membrane with multiple ion transport sites
Abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a modified polyphenyl ether anion exchange membrane with multiple ion transport sites, and aims to solve the technical problems of low ionic conductivity and insufficient dimensional stability of the existing anion exchange membrane. The core innovation is as follows: grafting modification is performed on polyphenyl ether (PPO) by adopting an imidazole grafting agent with brominated sites, and a large number of quaternary ammonium cation groups are firstly constructed through reaction of imidazole groups and brominated polyphenyl ether (BPPO); the subsequently introduced cross-linking agent has dual reaction activity, not only can be subjected to cross-linking reaction with a BPPO long chain to form a network structure, but also can be further subjected to quaternization reaction with bromination sites of imidazole groups, and a large number of quaternary ammonium cation groups are additionally generated through a'grafting pre-modification and cross-linking dual reaction 'synergistic mechanism. The ionic conductivity of the prepared anion exchange membrane can reach 88.6 mS/cm to 138 mS/cm at the temperature of 80 DEG C, the membrane thickness is uniform (114-148 microns), the process is simple, industrial amplification is easy, and the anion exchange membrane is suitable for electrochemical devices such as water electrolysis hydrogen production, fuel cells and the like.

Title: Seawater electrolysis hydrogen production device based on zero-gap membrane electrode
Abstract: The invention belongs to the related technical field of electrolytic hydrogen production, and discloses a seawater electrolysis hydrogen production device based on a zero-gap membrane electrode, the seawater electrolysis hydrogen production device comprises a membrane electrode, the membrane electrode comprises a cathode catalyst layer, an anion exchange membrane and an anode catalyst layer which are arranged in sequence, the cathode catalyst layer and the anode catalyst layer are respectively and integrally formed on the surface of the anion exchange membrane, so that the membrane electrode is of an integral structure, and the membrane electrode is in contact with an electrolyte to perform an electrolytic reaction. The cathode catalyst layer and the anode catalyst layer are respectively and integrally formed on the surface of the anion exchange membrane to form a membrane electrode close to zero clearance, and the zero-clearance membrane electrode structure can effectively reduce the internal resistance and ohmic polarization of an electrolytic cell, so that the energy consumption of an electrolytic hydrogen production reaction is reduced.

Title: Preparation method and application of self-supporting catalytic electrode of anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell
Abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a self-supporting catalytic electrode of an anion-exchange membrane electrolytic bath, foamed nickel is used as a substrate, non-noble metals such as iron, cerium and the like and non-metals such as sulfur, phosphorus and the like are selected as raw materials, and a catalyst is grown on the substrate in situ by means of chemical impregnation, hydrothermal synthesis and chemical vapor deposition technologies. The composite material is applied to seawater electrolysis, high seawater electrolysis activity is kept, meanwhile, good electrolysis stability is achieved, excellent chlorine corrosion resistance is shown, and the composite material has excellent structure and chemical stability. Moreover, the anode material supports large-scale preparation and has great industrial application potential.

Title: Anion exchange membrane water electrolysis electrochemical testing device
Abstract: The utility model discloses a water electrolysis electrochemical testing device for an anion exchange membrane. The water electrolysis electrochemical testing device comprises a reaction galvanic pile, the double-channel liquid pump system is used for conveying the reaction solution in the communication liquid tank to the reaction electric pile; the double-channel temperature control system is used for heating the reaction electric pile and the reaction solution; the communicating liquid tank is used for storing reaction liquid and mixing liquid at the cathode and anode outlets while avoiding mutual mixing of gas; the gas flow detection device is used for detecting the reaction yield; and the single chip microcomputer is used for controlling the double-channel liquid pump system and the double-channel temperature control system. The testing device has the advantages that due to the integrated design, the safety and the moving portability of the testing device are ensured; the optimized structural design greatly reduces the occupied space of the equipment, and the expandability of the instrument is high.

Title: A SYSTEM FOR PRODUCING CLEAN HYDROGEN AND CLEAN HYDROGEN DERIVED PRODUCTS USING WATER ELECTROLYSIS AND TIME CORRELATED RENEWABLE POWER
Abstract: A system for producing clean hydrogen and clean hydrogen derived products using water electrolysis and time correlated renewable power whereby the operation of the electrolysis is optimized for using time correlated renewable power amongst other factors. The system includes a hydrogen production unit that uses an electrolyzer to produce hydrogen from water and electricity, where the electricity is delivered via a connection to the electrical grid and/or behind the meter renewables and whereby a control unit manages the production of hydrogen based on the attributes of the renewable power, including time correlation and other factors. The hydrogen produced from time correlated renewables may be used directly to decarbonize industrial, transportation, or other applications or the hydrogen may be used to produce hydrogen derived products such as ammonia, methanol, transportation fuels (such as sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), diesel, gasoline), LPG, chemicals, or other low carbon products that use hydrogen as an input for the production process.

Title: Prussian blue analogue self-supporting anode for anion exchange membrane water electrolyser and preparation method of Prussian blue analogue self-supporting anode
Abstract: The invention discloses a Prussian blue analogue self-supporting anode for an anion exchange membrane water electrolyser, and a preparation method of the Prussian blue analogue self-supporting anode comprises the following steps: reacting pretreated foamed nickel (NF) with a metal salt solution, and then carrying out sulfuration treatment and nitrogen reduction treatment to prepare a metal sulfide nano array material rich in defects; and carrying out coordination reaction on the Prussian blue, citric acid and potassium ferricyanide to obtain the Fe-coordinated Prussian blue material CoFePBA-at-NiCo2S4/NF. The obtained self-supporting anode has excellent catalytic activity and stability, and the related preparation method is simple, mild in reaction condition, low in cost and suitable for application and popularization.

Title: Preparation method and application of anti-reverse current self-supporting electrode for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production
Abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of an electrode, in particular to a preparation method and application of an anti-reverse current self-supporting electrode for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production. The self-supporting (NiCoFe) 9S8 electrode is constructed by adopting a directional solid-phase synthesis strategy to overcome the challenge of performance degradation of the electrolytic cell. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, depositing a precursor solution of FeS2 and CoCl2 on a nickel felt substrate, and then carrying out annealing treatment to obtain uniformly grown (NiCoFe) 9S8; the method not only ensures uniform distribution of multiple metal components, but also constructs firm chemical bonding and efficient charge transfer between the catalyst layer and the conductive substrate through solid-phase interface reaction, and effectively avoids interface impedance caused by introduction of an additional binder. Therefore, high-current-density water electrolysis hydrogen production under intermittent fluctuation power supply is realized. In 1M KOH, the cell voltage is almost not attenuated when the electrode stably operates for 2000h at 500mAcm <-2 >.

Title: Gas diffusion cathode for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production as well as preparation and application of gas diffusion cathode
Abstract: The invention relates to a gas diffusion cathode for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production and a preparation method of the gas diffusion cathode. The gas diffusion cathode is composed of a hydrophobic conductive substrate such as carbon paper or carbon cloth and the like and a catalytic layer, and the catalytic layer takes nickel-based non-noble metal powder and at least one of alloys or derivatives of the nickel-based non-noble metal powder and the alloys as catalytic active components. One or more of carbon powder, carbon nanotubes, carbon nanofibers, graphene, nano graphite powder and the like are used as conductive agents, and polytetrafluoroethylene, polyvinylidene fluoride or perfluorosulfonic acid resin is used as binding agents, so that the gas diffusion cathode is formed. According to the gas diffusion cathode for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production, nickel-based non-noble metal active components are deposited on a conductive substrate of a porous composite structure, the preparation process is simple, an electrode with a uniform catalyst can be obtained, and compared with the similar technology, the gas diffusion cathode has the obvious advantages of high catalyst utilization rate and high current density; the cathode is applied to various water electrolysis electrochemical reduction reactors or electrolytic tanks.

Title: Megawatt anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production integrated system
Abstract: The utility model relates to a megawatt anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production integrated system which comprises an electrolytic bath subsystem comprising a plurality of large standard AEM electrolytic baths and is used for water electrolysis hydrogen production. The electrolyte circulation subsystem is used for providing electrolyte and maintaining circulation; the oxygen treatment subsystem is used for drying and dehydrogenating oxygen; the drying and purifying subsystem is used for drying, deoxidizing and purifying the hydrogen; the purging subsystem is used for purging the residual gas; the power supply and distribution subsystem is used for supplying power; the heat dissipation subsystem is used for cooling and heat dissipation; and the centralized control subsystem is used for controlling the whole integrated system. According to the utility model, the centralized control subsystem is adopted to realize remote control and real-time monitoring on the whole integrated system, so that the whole integrated system is in an optimal operation state, and the efficiency and the dynamic response rate are effectively improved; according to the utility model, the purging system is adopted to purge residual gas, so that the safety of the system is improved; and the low-concentration alkaline liquid is adopted, and hydrogen is removed from oxygen, so that the environmental protection property is effectively improved.
Applicants: SHENZHEN WENSHI HYDROGEN ENERGY TECH CO LTD

Title: Multifunctional catalyst VSA-CoNX and method for realizing coupled hydrogen production by using same
Abstract: The invention discloses a multifunctional catalyst VSA-CoNX and a method for realizing coupled hydrogen production by using the catalyst. According to the invention, the multifunctional catalyst VSA-CoNX with high stability and high performance is prepared by constructing V-doped VSA-CoNX, and the catalyst can realize hydrogen production by coupling multiple anion exchange membrane electrolytic cells. Particularly, when VSA-CoNX is used as an anode and a cathode, and hydrogen is produced by coupling a hydrazine assembled anion exchange membrane water electrolysis (AEMWE) electrolytic bath at ampere-level current density (1A cm <-2 >), only 0.21 V ultra-low voltage is needed, which means that the hydrazine assisted AEMWE is used for producing the same amount of hydrogen, only 11.17% of energy consumption of traditional water electrolysis is needed, only 0.506 kWhNm <-3 > H2 is needed, and the hydrogen production efficiency is greatly improved. Therefore, the hydrogen production cost is greatly reduced to 0.11 dollars per kilogram. Therefore, the multifunctional catalyst VSA-CoNX disclosed by the invention can be used for remarkably reducing the hydrogen production cost. In addition, experiments prove that the degradation rate of the hydrazine-containing electrolyte can exceed 95% within two hours, which shows that the hydrazine-containing electrolyte also has excellent wastewater degradation capacity.

Title: ANION EXCHANGE MEMBRANE WITH EXCELLENT PHASE SEPARATION PROPERTIES, ION CONDUCTIVITY, AND ALKALINE DURABILITY USING RADIAL POLYMER, METHOD FOR MANUFACTURING SAME, AND MEMBRANE ELECTRODE ASSEMBLY FOR WATER ELECTROLYSIS COMPRISING SAME
Abstract: The present invention relates to an anion exchange membrane with excellent phase separation properties, ion conductivity, and alkaline durability using a radial polymer, a method for manufacturing same, and a membrane electrode assembly for water electrolysis comprising same, wherein the radial polymer comprises a copolymer prepared by Friedel-Crafts polymerization between arylene-based monomers and carbonyl compounds containing head group units in the presence of a super-acid catalyst.
Applicants: TORAY ADVANCED MAT KOREA INC;;UNIV NAT INCHEON RES & BUSINESS FOUND

Title: Control method of megawatt anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production system
Abstract: The invention provides a control method of a megawatt-level anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production system, which comprises the following steps of: controlling a slave station to carry out inspection control on the system through a master station, and obtaining an inspection result; when the master station judges that the system meets the starting condition according to the inspection result, the system is controlled to run through the slave station, and running data of the system is displayed in real time through a human-computer interaction interface; in the inspection and system operation process, the main station judges whether abnormity exists or not in real time, if yes, the main station controls a preset indicator lamp to conduct corresponding reminding in time, and corresponding fault processing is conducted. The master station is globally monitored, the slave stations quickly respond to instructions of the master station, and data acquisition and operation control are performed on the system, so that the whole system is in an optimal operation state, and the hydrogen production efficiency is effectively improved; according to the invention, the master station judges the operation state of the system in real time, gives an alarm in time and carries out corresponding fault processing when abnormity exists, and the operation safety of the system is effectively improved.
Applicants: SHENZHEN WENSHI HYDROGEN ENERGY TECH CO LTD

Title: Branched quinine-based polymer, preparation method and application of branched quinine-based polymer in anion exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention discloses a branched quinine-based polymer, a preparation method and application of the branched quinine-based polymer in an anion exchange membrane, and belongs to the technical field of hydrogen energy utilization and high polymer material preparation. The branched quinine-based polymer comprises a quinine ring structural unit, an aromatic structural unit, a crosslinking structural unit and a functional structural unit R1, and is applied to preparation of an anion exchange membrane. The technical limitation of single performance optimization of an existing anion exchange membrane is broken through, a high-steric-hindrance quinine cation group and a planar three-dimensional/stereoscopic four-dimensional branched cross-linked structure are subjected to molecular-level organic combination, triple technical cooperation of an ether-bond-free polymer skeleton, a quinine steric hindrance effect and branched structure free volume regulation and control is realized, and the high-performance anion exchange membrane is prepared. The industrial common problem that alkali resistance, ionic conductivity and mechanical strength of an existing membrane material are difficult to consider at the same time is solved from the molecular structure design level; the alkali-resistant stable operation time and the conductivity retention rate achieve qualitative breakthrough, the comprehensive performance is excellent, and the composite material is widely applied to hydrogen energy conversion devices such as alkaline fuel cells and alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production.

Title: Six-arm star-shaped branched polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane, preparation method and application
Abstract: The invention discloses a six-arm star-shaped branched polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane, a preparation method and application, and belongs to the field of alkaline fuel cells and electrolyzed water. The preparation method comprises the following steps: introducing tri (4-carbazole-9-yl phenyl) amine with six branching sites into a polymer main chain as a branching unit, and carrying out Friedel-Crafts alkylation copolymerization on the branched unit, p-terphenyl and N-methyl-4-piperidone under the catalysis of superacid to prepare a six-arm star-shaped branched polymer main chain; and performing quaternization on a piperidine ring in the main chain through a Michaku reaction to obtain the target anion exchange membrane. According to the star-shaped branched structure disclosed by the invention, the free volume in the membrane is obviously increased, and a micro-phase separation structure with larger size and stronger connectivity is induced to be formed; the anion exchange membrane has high hydroxyl conductivity, excellent alkali stability, good mechanical performance and outstanding fuel cell and water electrolysis performance, and has wide application prospects in the field of electrochemical energy devices.

Title: Polyaryl methyl piperidine polymer, preparation method and anion exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production and fuel cells, particularly relates to preparation of a polyaryl methyl piperidine polymer and a high-stability anion exchange membrane prepared from the polyaryl methyl piperidine polymer, and further discloses a preparation method and application of the polyaryl methyl piperidine polymer. According to the polyaryl methyl piperidine polymer, a full-carbon-chain skeleton structure is adopted, a functional group, namely carbonyl, connected with an electron-rich benzene ring is migrated from a piperidine-containing ring to the fourth site or/and other sites of the piperidine ring, and polymerization of the aldehyde group and aromatic hydrocarbon is used for replacing traditional polymerization of ketone group and aromatic hydrocarbon, so that the polyaryl methyl piperidine polymer is obtained. The piperidine ring is suspended outside the aryl main chain in the polymer, the rigid structure of the piperidine ring is reserved, and the anion transmission rate and chemical stability are further improved. According to the polymer structure, modification of the polymer is realized by using strategies such as copolymerization with a hydrophobic unit, hyperbranched and the like, and the polymer with an ultrahigh stable chemical structure is formed.

Title: Hybrid cross-linked structure high ion conduction anion exchange membrane and application thereof in hydrogen production by alkaline electrolysis of water
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of anion exchange membranes, in particular to a hybrid cross-linked structure high ion conduction anion exchange membrane and application thereof in alkaline electrolytic water hydrogen production, PEEK is dissolved in 98% concentrated sulfuric acid, stirring is performed for 1 h at 50 DEG C until complete dissolution, 1, 4-dibromobutane is added, the molar ratio of PEEK to 1, 4-dibromobutane is 1: 1.2-1.5, stirring is performed for 1 h at the temperature of 50 DEG C, stirring is performed for 1 h at the temperature of 50 DEG C until complete dissolution is achieved, and the hybrid cross-linked structure high ion conduction anion exchange membrane is obtained. Raising the temperature to 60 DEG C and reacting for 8 hours; and after the reaction is finished, pouring the reaction system into deionized water, precipitating, filtering to obtain a faint yellow solid, repeatedly washing with deionized water until the filtrate is neutral, and carrying out vacuum drying at 60 DEG C for 12 hours to obtain the QPEEK with the quaternization degree of 1.2-1.5 mmol/g. The amino-functionalized nano silicon dioxide can form hydrogen-bond interaction with a substrate quaternary ammonium group, so that the organic-inorganic interface compatibility is improved, the interface resistance is reduced, the ion transmission path is optimized, the ion conduction efficiency of the membrane is remarkably improved, and the core requirement of hydrogen production by alkaline electrolysis of water on rapid ion migration is met.
Applicants: BEIJING YINENG HYDROGEN SOURCE TECH CO LTD

Title: Solid electrolyte membrane for hydrogen production by alkaline electrolyzed water and preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to a solid electrolyte membrane for hydrogen production from alkaline electrolyzed water and a preparation method and application thereof, the solid electrolyte membrane comprises an anion exchange membrane and coatings arranged on the two sides of the anion exchange membrane, and a'coating-anion exchange membrane-coating 'sandwich composite structure is formed; the coating includes a mixture of a thermoplastic resin and hydrophilic inorganic nanoparticles. The preparation method comprises the following steps: respectively preparing coating slurry and anion exchange membrane slurry; coating the coating slurry on a transfer printing substrate, and drying to obtain a transfer printing substrate/coating; coating the coating slurry and the anion exchange membrane slurry on a transfer printing substrate in sequence, and drying to obtain a transfer printing substrate/coating/anion exchange membrane; and thermal transfer printing. Compared with the prior art, swelling deformation and damage of the anion exchange membrane can be effectively prevented, the mechanical property and stability of the anion exchange membrane are improved, and meanwhile the problem that the air tightness of the composite membrane is limited is solved.

Title: STRUCTURAL DESIGN OF AN ELECTROCHEMICAL CELL
Abstract: The present invention relates to an electrochemical cell (0) comprising an anode (1), a cathode (2) and an anion-conducting membrane (3) located between the anode (1) and the cathode (2). The invention also relates to the use of the cell (0) in a method for preparing hydrogen (H2) and oxygen (O2) by electrochemically splitting water (H2O). Moreover, the invention relates to an electrolyser (6, 8) comprising a multiplicity of the cells (0), and to a method for producing the electrolyser (6, 8). The aim of the invention is to provide an electrochemical cell (0) by means of which anion-exchange-membrane-based water splitting can be carried out on an industrial scale. The aim is also for the cell to be inexpensive in terms of production and to allow for the energy-efficient preparation of hydrogen and oxygen. The aim is achieved in that at least part of the anode is in the form of a first textile fabric comprising catalytically active textile line structures, and in that the first textile fabric directly contacts the membrane.

Title: Megawatt anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production integration system and integration method
Abstract: The invention relates to a megawatt anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production integrated system and method, and the system comprises an electrolytic bath subsystem which comprises a plurality of large standard AEM electrolytic baths and is used for water electrolysis hydrogen production; the electrolyte circulation subsystem is used for providing electrolyte and maintaining circulation; the oxygen treatment subsystem is used for drying and dehydrogenating oxygen; the drying and purifying subsystem is used for drying, deoxidizing and purifying the hydrogen; the purging subsystem is used for purging the residual gas; the power supply and distribution subsystem is used for supplying power; the heat dissipation subsystem is used for cooling and heat dissipation; and the centralized control subsystem is used for controlling the whole integrated system. The centralized control subsystem is adopted to realize remote control and real-time monitoring on the whole integrated system, so that the whole integrated system is in an optimal operation state, and the efficiency and the dynamic response rate are effectively improved; the residual gas is purged by adopting the purging system, so that the system safety is improved; the low-concentration alkaline liquid is adopted, hydrogen is removed from oxygen, and the environmental protection property is effectively improved.
Applicants: SHENZHEN WENSHI HYDROGEN ENERGY TECH CO LTD

Title: Novel anion exchange membrane photoelectrocatalytic water decomposition hydrogen production reactor and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of solar energy photoelectrocatalysis water decomposition hydrogen production, and discloses a novel anion exchange membrane photoelectrocatalysis water decomposition hydrogen production reactor and a preparation method thereof. An end plate, a cathode current collector, a cathode runner plate, a FeCoNi cathode, an anion exchange membrane, an anode current collector, an alpha-Fe2O3 photo-anode, quartz glass and an anode runner plate are sequentially attached to the reactor from back to front; a runner of the cathode plate is formed in the middle of the anode current collector; the FeCoNi cathode is directly and tightly attached to the alpha-Fe2O3 photo-anode through the anion exchange membrane; an optical window is formed in the middle of the anode runner plate, and the quartz glass is attached to the inner side of the optical window. The number of bubbles can be reduced and the diameter of the bubbles can be reduced by utilizing fluid shear force through the electrolyte flow adjusting function of the reactor. The invention provides a unique reactor design thought for improving the photoelectrochemical performance under high concentration.

Title: METHOD FOR MANUFACTURING AN ELECTROCATALYST, ELECTROCATALYST, ELECTRODE FOR AN ELECTROCHEMICAL CELL, ION EXCHANGE MEMBRANE, METHOD FOR MANUFACTURING AN ION EXCHANGE MEMBRANE, WATER ELECTROLYZER AND METHOD FOR MANUFACTURING A WATER ELECTROLYZER
Abstract: The invention relates to a method for manufacturing an electrocatalyst in the form of an HER catalyst for a water electrolyzer, wherein the HER catalyst is synthesised from an aqueous solution of a molybdenum salt with the addition of an aromatic amine and an acid.The invention further relates to a method for manufacturing an electrocatalyst in the form of an OER catalyst for a water electrolyzer, electrocatalysts in the form of HER and OER catalysts, an electrode for electrochemical cells, an ion exchange membrane for an electrochemical reactor, a method for manufacturing an ion exchange membrane for an electrochemical reactor, a water electrolyzer, a method for manufacturing a catalytically active catalyst layer and a method for manufacturing a water electrolyzer.
Applicants: CUTTING EDGE NANOMATERIALS CENMAT UG HAFTUNGSBESCHRAENKT

Title: Anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production control method and system based on data-driven model predictive control
Abstract: The invention provides an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production control method and system based on data-driven model predictive control, and the method comprises the steps: collecting operation data, and constructing a system non-mechanism model through a BP neural network algorithm; predicting output parameters of the AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production system according to the system non-mechanism model; inputting the output reference value y (t) into a system non-mechanism model and a controller; the x (t) is optimized through an optimization model constructed through an NSGA-II algorithm; the delta x (t) is applied to an AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production system, and actual output and predicted output are obtained; comparing to obtain an error value, and performing feedback correction on the controller; and updating the system non-mechanism model and the prediction model. According to the method, the non-mechanism model and the prediction model of the system are dynamically updated, the dynamic change of the AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production system can be reflected in real time, the control model is dynamically updated, and the precision of the control model is effectively improved.
Applicants: SHENZHEN WENSHI HYDROGEN ENERGY TECH CO LTD

Title: Membrane electrode for producing hydrogen by electrolyzing water, preparation method of membrane electrode and electrolytic bath
Abstract: The invention provides a water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane electrode, a preparation method thereof and an electrolytic bath, and belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, the water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane electrode comprises a composite anode layer, an anion exchange membrane and a composite cathode layer, and the composite anode layer comprises an anode substrate layer, a first gas diffusion layer and an anode catalyst layer. The anion exchange membrane is arranged on the side, provided with the anode catalyst layer, of the composite anode layer, the composite cathode layer is arranged on the side, away from the composite anode layer, of the anion exchange membrane, and the composite cathode layer comprises a cathode substrate layer, a second gas diffusion layer and a cathode catalyst layer. According to the water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane electrode provided by the embodiment of the invention, interface resistance among at least part of components can be eliminated, so that ion transmission and gas diffusion are smoother, and the electrolysis efficiency is improved.
Applicants: HUIZHOU EVE HYDROGEN ENERGY CO LTD

Title: Membrane electrode for producing hydrogen by electrolyzing water and electrolytic bath
Abstract: The invention provides a water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane electrode and an electrolytic bath, and belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, the water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane electrode comprises an anion exchange membrane, a cathode catalyst layer and an anode catalyst layer, the cathode catalyst layer is arranged on one side of the anion exchange membrane, and the cathode catalyst layer comprises a first cathode catalyst and a second cathode catalyst; the anode catalyst layer is arranged on the side, away from the cathode catalyst layer, of the anion exchange membrane, and the anode catalyst layer comprises a first anode catalyst and a second anode catalyst. Wherein the first cathode catalyst, the second cathode catalyst, the first anode catalyst and the second anode catalyst are all non-noble metal catalysts, the first cathode catalyst is different from the second cathode catalyst, and the first anode catalyst is different from the second anode catalyst. The water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane electrode provided by the embodiment of the invention can ensure good catalytic activity and stability while reducing the cost.
Applicants: HUIZHOU EVE HYDROGEN ENERGY CO LTD

Title: Anion exchange membrane oxygen evolution reaction catalyst and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses an anion exchange membrane oxygen evolution reaction catalyst and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: preparing a water/isopropanol binary mixed solution containing nickel salt, ferric salt and ammonium fluoride as a solution A; preparing a water/isopropanol binary mixed solution containing potassium hydroxide and potassium carbonate as a solution B; and dropwise adding the solution B into the solution A at a constant speed under the conditions of normal pressure, 25 DEG C and stirring, curing, and then carrying out solid-liquid separation, washing and drying to obtain the NiFe-based layered double hydroxide oxygen evolution catalyst. Controllable coprecipitation at normal pressure and low temperature is achieved through the synergistic effect of the water/isopropanol binary solvent, NH4F regulation and control and the KOH/K2CO3 compound alkali source, and the obtained catalyst is loose in morphology, rich in active sites and excellent in charge transmission performance. The method is simple in process, easy in parameter control and clear in amplification path, and the prepared catalyst is used for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis anode oxygen evolution reaction and has low overpotential and high stability.

Title: Cross-linked all-carbon skeleton polymer, anion exchange membrane and preparation method
Abstract: The invention provides a cross-linked all-carbon skeleton polymer, an anion exchange membrane and a preparation method, and relates to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, the cross-linked all-carbon skeleton polymer comprises a first unit and a counter ion unit; the first unit comprises a group obtained after a ketone precursor reacts and a plurality of groups obtained after a benzene precursor reacts; the ketone precursors comprise a first ketone precursor for providing positive ions after reaction and a second ketone precursor for providing negative ions after reaction; a group after the reaction of the second ketone precursor comprises a structure with phenyl and trifluoromethyl, and a benzene ring in the structure with phenyl is bonded with trifluoromethyl and is bonded with a group after the reaction of the benzene precursor; the plurality of groups after the reaction of the benzene-based precursor are also bonded by the groups after the reaction of the first ketone-based precursor. As a result, the anion exchange membrane based on the crosslinked all-carbon skeleton polymer has a low degree of swelling and high mechanical properties.
Applicants: NINGBO ZHONGKE HYDROGEN FILM TECH CO LTD

Title: Anion exchange polymer and application thereof in water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane electrode
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of anion exchange membranes, and particularly relates to an anion exchange polymer and application thereof in a membrane electrode for producing hydrogen by electrolyzing water. According to the polymer provided by the invention, heteroaryl is introduced into a polyarylalkylene molecular structure, so that a hydrophilic/hydrophobic microphase separation structure in an anion exchange membrane material is improved, and meanwhile, the ion transmission property can be improved by forming a hydrogen bond network with water. The prepared anion exchange membrane is high in ionic conductivity, high in mechanical strength and good in stability, and can meet the application requirements of galvanic pile assembly in the production process. After a membrane electrode prepared from the polymer and the anion exchange membrane is assembled into an electrolytic cell, the electrolytic efficiency under the pure water condition can be remarkably improved.

Title: Self-adjusting microenvironment membrane electrode for pure water electrolysis hydrogen production and preparation method of self-adjusting microenvironment membrane electrode
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of hydrogen production through water electrolysis, and relates to a self-adjusting microenvironment membrane electrode for hydrogen production through pure water electrolysis and a preparation method of the self-adjusting microenvironment membrane electrode. Comprising an anion exchange membrane; the anode catalyst layer is positioned on one side of the anion exchange membrane; the cathode catalyst layer is positioned on the other side of the anion exchange membrane; the anode catalyst layer is a porous composite layer formed by mixing a hybrid ionomer and an oxygen evolution catalyst, the hybrid ionomer is formed by compounding a polymer matrix and an inorganic nanofiller, a side chain of the polymer matrix contains a hydrophilic group, and the surface of the inorganic nanofiller has a hydroxyl group or an amido group; the anode catalyst layer has a gradient pore structure in the thickness direction, the gradient pore structure comprises a first pore region close to the anion exchange membrane and a second pore region far away from the anion exchange membrane, and the hydrophilicity of the first pore region is higher than that of the second pore region. The alkaline stability and water-gas transmission balance of an interface microenvironment can be autonomously maintained under pure water feeding, the electrolysis voltage is remarkably reduced, and the operation life is prolonged.

Title: Method and system for in-situ monitoring, regulation and control of thermal field of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production device
Abstract: The invention discloses an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production device thermal field in-situ monitoring and regulation method and system, and belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and the system comprises an electrolytic bath, a temperature detection unit, a data acquisition and temperature control unit, a temperature regulation unit and an electrolyte supply unit. According to the invention, the temperature sensor is embedded between the gas-liquid diffusion layer of the cathode of the membrane electrode and the bipolar plate, so that in-situ detection of the real working temperature of the membrane electrode in the electrolysis process is realized, and errors caused by the traditional characterization by electrolyte temperature are avoided. The temperature obtained through in-situ measurement serves as a feedback variable, a thermal field closed-loop regulation and control system is constructed, dynamic control over the membrane electrode temperature is achieved by adjusting the electrolyte heat supply state, the membrane electrode temperature is stabilized in the optimal operation interval, and therefore the operation cost and the device stability are both considered. The method is suitable for a water electrolysis hydrogen production system under the condition of pure water electrolyte, and has a good engineering application prospect.

Title: METHOD FOR PRODUCING WATER ELECTROLYSIS CATALYST COMPRISING TRANSITION METAL CHALCOGENIDE
Abstract: The present invention discloses a catalyst electrode for water electrolysis, comprising: a metal foam; and a composite transition metal chalcogenide heterostructure formed on the metal foam. The catalyst electrode for water electrolysis can exhibit improved electrochemical catalytic activity in both hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) and oxygen evolution reaction (OER) in water electrolysis reaction, can efficiently produce hydrogen with lower energy supply than existing noble metal electrodes, and can be used in both anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer and solar cell-water electrolysis system.

Title: Membrane electrode for AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production
Abstract: The utility model discloses a membrane electrode for AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production, which comprises an anion exchange membrane, an anode catalyst layer and a cathode catalyst layer are respectively arranged on two opposite side surfaces of the anion exchange membrane, an anode protective layer is arranged on one side of the anode catalyst layer far away from the anion exchange membrane, and a cathode protective layer is arranged on the other side of the cathode catalyst layer far away from the anion exchange membrane. A cathode protection layer is arranged on one side, far away from the anion exchange membrane, of the cathode catalyst layer; the anode protection layer, the anode catalyst layer, the anion exchange membrane, the cathode catalyst layer and the cathode protection layer are sequentially connected into an integral structure; and the peripheral sizes of the anode protection layer and the cathode protection layer are greater than those of the anion exchange membrane, the anode catalyst layer and the cathode catalyst layer. The membrane electrode has the characteristics of low impedance and high catalytic activity, and can obviously improve the water electrolysis hydrogen production efficiency when being used in an AEM electrolytic cell.
Applicants: HUIZHOU EVE HYDROGEN ENERGY CO LTD

Title: Water electrolysis hydrogen production device and membrane electrode assembly and exchange membrane thereof
Abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a water electrolysis hydrogen production device and a membrane electrode assembly and an exchange membrane thereof. The water electrolysis hydrogen production device comprises an anode end plate, an anode current collector, a membrane electrode assembly, a cathode current collector and a cathode end plate. The membrane electrode assembly comprises an anode diffusion layer, an anode catalyst layer, an exchange membrane, a cathode catalyst layer and a cathode diffusion layer, the exchange membrane comprises an ion solvation membrane and an anion exchange membrane, the ion solvation membrane is arranged between the anode catalyst layer and the anion exchange membrane, and the thickness of the exchange membrane is 80-120 microns. According to the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the problems that an existing single-layer anion exchange membrane is relatively low in chemical stability, easy to thin and crack and the like are solved.
Applicants: XIAMEN JIHE WEILAI ENERGY CO LTD

Title: High-stability membrane electrode and preparation method thereof, and water electrolyser applying high-stability membrane electrode
Abstract: The invention provides a high-stability membrane electrode, a preparation method of the high-stability membrane electrode and a water electrolyser applying the high-stability membrane electrode. The high-stability membrane electrode comprises an anode gas diffusion layer, an anode catalyst layer, an anion exchange membrane, a cathode catalyst layer and a cathode gas diffusion layer which are sequentially stacked, wherein the anode catalyst layer is prepared by the following steps: S1, mixing a nickel ferrite catalyst, polytetrafluoroethylene, an anion exchange membrane ionomer and a solvent, and uniformly stirring to prepare nickel ferrite catalyst slurry; and S2, coating the anode gas diffusion layer with the nickel ferrite catalyst slurry, performing drying to obtain a membrane electrode intermediate, placing the membrane electrode intermediate in inert gas, and performing heat preservation at the heat preservation temperature of 300-500 DEG C for 5-60 minutes to obtain an anode catalyst layer. The membrane electrode provided by the invention is good in structural stability and excellent in water electrolysis catalytic performance, a water electrolysis bath applying the membrane electrode can keep long-time operation, and the hydrogen production efficiency is high.
Applicants: HUIZHOU EVE HYDROGEN ENERGY CO LTD

Title: Hydrophobic chain segment-containing multi-block dibenzofuran polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane and application thereof
Abstract: The invention provides a multi-block dibenzofuran polyaryl piperidine polymer. The multi-block dibenzofuran polyaryl piperidine polymer comprises a structural unit as shown in a formula (I) which is described in the specification. The anion exchange membrane polymeric material prepared from the multi-block dibenzofuran polyaryl piperidine polymer has excellent anion transmission capacity, good mechanical strength and excellent alkali-resistant stability under the alkaline condition, and can be used as an excellent membrane device of a water electrolysis hydrogen production reaction device; and the method has certain practical application potential. The preparation method disclosed by the invention is very simple and short in preparation process. The invention provides a preparation method and strategy for preparing the anion exchange membrane in a green way by adopting the solid acid and the solid superacid catalyst for the first time, the solid acid and the solid superacid catalyst used in the invention are easy to separate and recover and can be repeatedly used, and the technical route is green and environment-friendly. # imgabs0 #

Title: Method for activation pretreatment of water electrolysis electrodes
Abstract: The present invention relates to a pretreatment activation method for improving the performance of a water electrolysis electrode using pure water as an electrolyte and using an anion exchange membrane. By acting as an oxidation electrode or a reduction electrode, or by injecting a potassium hydroxide solution into a water electrolysis electrode included in a membrane electrode assembly, and then applying the potassium hydroxide solution while gradually increasing the voltage, the hydroxide ion transmittance of the water electrolysis electrode can be increased to improve the performance of the electrode, and the pretreatment time can be shortened.
Applicants: GWANGJU INST SCIENCE & TECH;;DEUTSCH ZENTR LUFT & RAUMFAHRT

Title: CATALYST ELECTRODES FOR ELECTROLYZER AND ITS MANUFACTURING METHODS
Abstract: The present invention discloses a catalyst electrode for an electrolytic cell, comprising: a metal foam; and a composite transition metal chalcogen compound formed on the metal foam. the catalyst electrode for an electrolytic cell of the present invention can exhibit improved electrochemical catalytic activity in both a hydrogen generation reaction (her) and an oxygen generation reaction (oer) during a water decomposition reaction, can efficiently produce hydrogen with lower energy supply than an existing noble metal electrode, and can be used in both an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis tank and a solar cell-water electrolysis system.
Applicants: KUMOH NAT INST TECHNOLOGY IND ACAD COOP FOUND;;GHS CO LTD

Title: Oxygen evolution catalyst for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production as well as preparation method and application of oxygen evolution catalyst
Abstract: The invention provides an oxygen evolution catalyst for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production as well as a preparation method and application of the oxygen evolution catalyst. The oxygen evolution catalyst is prepared from the following raw materials: ferric salt, nickel salt and an interlayer modifier, the interlayer modifier is urea. According to the invention, specific types of interlayer catalysts are adopted, so that the oxygen evolution catalyst has high specific surface area and more catalytic active sites, and the catalytic activity and stability of the oxygen evolution catalyst are improved.

Title: Magnetic field assisted water electrolysis hydrogen production device
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, in particular to a magnetic field assisted water electrolysis hydrogen production device which comprises an anode plate and a cathode plate, spiral flow channels are formed in the opposite faces of the anode plate and the cathode plate, the lower end of the anode plate is fixedly connected with a connecting plate, and the lower end of the cathode plate is fixedly connected with a transverse plate. The transverse plate is movably connected with the connecting plate; a limiting mechanism is separated from a limiting hole by pulling a pull ring, an anode plate and a cathode plate are separated, meanwhile, a liquid guide mechanism slides out, electrolyte left in a spiral flow channel is guided and discharged, the electrolyte is prevented from falling onto the surface of an electromagnetic coil, and an old catalyst and an anion exchange membrane are taken down, so that the service life of the catalyst is prolonged. And after a new catalyst and the anion exchange membrane are mounted on the anode plate, the anode plate is pushed to be in contact with the cathode plate, so that the limiting mechanism is clamped into the limiting hole again, and the operation is convenient and efficient.

Title: Method of controlling hydrogen/oxygen producing system and hydrogen/oxygen producing system
Abstract: A method of controlling a hydrogen/oxygen producing system is a method of controlling a hydrogen/oxygen producing system including a water electrolysis apparatus that electrolyzes liquid water by applying current to an anode and a cathode, and a hydrogen gas pressurizing part that pressurizes hydrogen at downstream of the water electrolysis apparatus by applying current to a pressurizing part anode and a pressurizing part cathode. A controller controls current applied to the water electrolysis apparatus and current applied to the hydrogen gas pressurizing part. When the hydrogen/oxygen producing system is stopped, the controller performs first decompression processing such that a decompression speed of the pressurizing part cathode of the hydrogen gas pressurizing part does not exceed a basic decompression speed and performs second decompression processing such that a decompression speed of the anode of the water electrolysis apparatus does not exceed the decompression speed of the pressurizing part cathode.

Title: Membrane electrode for water electrolysis, preparation method of membrane electrode and water electrolysis tank
Abstract: The invention relates to a membrane electrode for water electrolysis, a preparation method of the membrane electrode and a water electrolysis tank. The membrane electrode for water electrolysis comprises a cathode catalyst layer and an anion exchange membrane layer which are stacked, the cathode catalyst layer comprises an AEM ionomer, and the anion exchange membrane layer comprises an anion exchange membrane. The anion-exchange membrane is applied to a membrane electrode material for water electrolysis, the distance between the cathode and the anode of the electrode is shortened, and compared with an alkaline water electrolysis device in the prior art, under the same scale, a galvanic pile is small in size and light in weight. The AEM ionomer is added into the cathode catalyst layer, so that the bonding capacity of the cathode catalyst layer is improved, the possibility that the cathode catalyst layer is scoured by gas or liquid to peel off during water electrolysis is reduced, the operation stability of the electrode is improved, and the service life of the electrode is prolonged.
Applicants: HUIZHOU EVE FUEL CELL CO LTD

Title: Membrane electrode assembly and method for producing hydrogen by electrolysis
Abstract: The invention discloses a membrane electrode assembly and a method for producing hydrogen through electrolysis. The membrane electrode assembly comprises a first electrode and a second electrode, a second electrode; the anion exchange membrane is clamped between the first electrode and the second electrode, and the first electrode comprises a first metal net; the first catalyst layer covers the first metal net; a second metal mesh; the first metal net covers the anion exchange membrane, the second metal net covers the second metal net, the first metal net is located between the anion exchange membrane and the second metal net, the thickness of the second metal net is larger than that of the first metal net, the thickness of the first catalyst layer is larger than that of the second catalyst layer, and the second catalyst layer is made of iron, cobalt, manganese, zinc, niobium, molybdenum, ruthenium, platinum, gold or aluminum. And the second catalyst layer is in a crystalline state.

Title: Preparation method and application of self-supporting nickel-based double-metal hydroxide oxygen evolution electrode
Abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a self-supporting nickel-based double-metal hydroxide oxygen evolution electrode, and belongs to the field of water electrolysis hydrogen production. According to the method, the nickel-based double-metal hydroxide oxygen evolution electrode directly and vertically grown on a nickel fiber felt substrate is obtained through a simple one-step impregnation method. The electrode prepared by the method is applied to the water electrolysis oxygen evolution reaction under the catalytic alkaline condition. Wherein the obtained nickel-based double-metal hydroxide is in a nanoflower shape extending outwards from the center, the particle diameter of the nanoflower is 500 nm to 5 [mu] m, and the thickness of the nickel-based double-metal hydroxide is 5 to 10 [mu] m; the thickness of the nickel fiber felt ranges from 0.25 mm to 0.4 mm. As a three-dimensional skeleton of foamed nickel easily punctures an anionic membrane, the performance and long-term operation life of alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water (AEMWE) are influenced. Therefore, the nickel fiber felt is adopted as the substrate, and the problems can be effectively solved. In addition, the invention has wide utilization value in renewable fuel cells, photoelectrocatalysis, alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water and electrolytic hydrogen generator devices.

Title: Electrolyte regeneration
Abstract: A system for regenerating electrolyte from an electrochemical cell, comprising; a directing means for receiving electrolyte from an electrochemical cell, the directing means having a first and a second outlet; a sensor or sample port positioned between the electrochemical cell and the first and second outlets via which contaminants in the electrolyte may be measured; and a purification stage for receiving electrolyte from the second outlet and producing regenerated electrolyte, the stage comprising an ion exchange chamber; wherein when a contaminant is detected, at least a portion of the electrolyte is directed by the directing means through the second outlet to the purification stage. A method for regenerating an electrolyte from an electrochemical cell is also defined. The system may comprise the electrochemical cell from which the electrolyte is regenerated, and this may comprise an electrolyser or stack of electrolysers wherein the system comprises means for combining the electrolyte streams into a single stream. The electrolyser may be an anion exchange membrane (AEM). The sensor may comprise at least one of a pH and a conductivity sensor. The ion exchange chamber may comprise a cation or an anion exchange resin and may comprise two or more sub-chambers.

Title: Apparatus for the electrolytic production of hydrogen, oxygen, and alkalinized seawater
Abstract: The invention generally relates an apparatus for generation of hydrogen and oxygen gases by utilizing seawater. The invention also relates to a method of making hydrogen and oxygen gas by utilizing anion exchange membranes and seawater. This abstract is intended as a scanning tool for purposes of searching in the particular art and is not intended to be limiting of the present invention.

Title: Nano-alloy catalyst for anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water and preparation method of membrane electrode of nano-alloy catalyst
Abstract: The invention discloses a nano-alloy catalyst for anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water and a preparation method of a membrane electrode of the nano-alloy catalyst, when any one of manganese salt, cerium salt, chromium salt, cobalt salt, lanthanum salt, ruthenium salt and iridium salt is not added, NiFe binary alloy powder is obtained, the content of Ni is 90%-100%, and the content of Fe is 0%-10%; when any one of manganese salt, cerium salt, chromium salt, cobalt salt, lanthanum salt, ruthenium salt and iridium salt is added, NiFe ternary alloy powder is obtained, the content of Ni is 76%-96%, the content of Fe is 4%, and the content of the third element is 0%-20%. The nano-alloy catalyst material for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis prepared according to the invention is good in corrosion resistance and high in stability, the total water splitting efficiency is further improved, the synthesis method is simple, the used metal salt is low in cost, the metal salt can be uniformly loaded on a substrate carrier through spraying, and industrial application of total water splitting under high current density is easy to realize.

Title: Nitrogen-doped carbon-coated nickel ruthenium nano-catalyst, preparation method thereof and anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell
Abstract: The invention relates to the field of hydrogen evolution catalysts, and discloses a nitrogen-doped carbon-coated nickel ruthenium nano-catalyst, a preparation method thereof and an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell. The catalyst contains nitrogen-doped carbon-coated nickel ruthenium nanoparticles, wherein the nitrogen-doped carbon-coated nickel ruthenium nanoparticles contain a nickel ruthenium core and a nitrogen-doped graphitized carbon layer shell coating the surface of the nickel ruthenium core; in an X-ray diffraction pattern of the catalyst, diffraction peaks exist in the range that 2 theta is 24 degrees to 27 degrees, 40 degrees to 42.5 degrees, 43 degrees to 45 degrees, 46 degrees to 49 degrees, 50 degrees to 53 degrees, 60 degrees to 64 degrees and 75 degrees to 77 degrees; or diffraction peaks exist in the range that 2 theta is 24 degrees to 27 degrees, 43 degrees to 45 degrees, 50 degrees to 53 degrees and 75 degrees to 77 degrees; based on the total weight of the catalyst, the content of ruthenium is 0.1-20wt%. The catalyst is higher in catalytic activity and stability and low in ruthenium element content, and the preparation cost of the catalyst can be reduced.

Title: Water electrolysis hydrogen production device and membrane electrode assembly and exchange membrane thereof
Abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a water electrolysis hydrogen production device and a membrane electrode assembly and an exchange membrane thereof. The water electrolysis hydrogen production device comprises an anode end plate, an anode current collector, a membrane electrode assembly, a cathode current collector and a cathode end plate. The membrane electrode assembly comprises an anode diffusion layer, an anode catalyst layer, an exchange membrane, a cathode catalyst layer and a cathode diffusion layer, the exchange membrane comprises a first anion exchange membrane and a second anion exchange membrane, and the thickness of the exchange membrane is 60-170 [mu] m. Title: METHOD FOR MANUFACTURING WATER ELECTROLYSIS CATALYST
Abstract: The present invention relates to a copper-nickel-iron double layer hydroxide nanoprism, a manufacturing method thereof, and a use thereof as a water electrolysis catalyst. The present invention discloses a catalytic electrode for water electrolysis, the catalytic electrode comprising: a metal foam; and a composite transition metal chalcogenide heterostructure formed on the metal foam. This catalytic electrode for water electrolysis can exhibit improved electrochemical catalytic activity for both a hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) and an oxygen evolution reaction (OER) in a water electrolysis reaction, can efficiently produce hydrogen with a lower energy supply than conventional noble metal electrodes, and can be used in both anion exchange membrane water electrolyzers and solar cell-water electrolysis systems. The present invention relates to a nanosphere hybrid structure containing nickel cobalt selenide and molybdenum selenide, and a use thereof as a water electrolysis catalyst. The present invention relates to a water electrolysis catalyst in which zinc cobalt sulfide and molybdenum disulfide are hetero-bonded, and a manufacturing method thereof.

Title: Seawater electrolysis catalyst with molybdate passivation layer as well as preparation method and application of seawater electrolysis catalyst
Abstract: The invention provides a preparation method of a seawater electrolysis catalyst with a molybdate passivation layer, which comprises the following steps: loading a molybdenum-based material on a substrate to form a pre-catalyst; and placing the pre-catalyst as an anode in an electrolyte, and forming a molybdate passivation layer in situ on the surface of the pre-catalyst by using an anodic oxidation reaction to obtain the seawater electrolysis catalyst with the molybdate passivation layer. The molybdate passivation layer generated in situ through the anodic oxidation reaction can generate a chloride ion repulsion effect, so that the molybdate passivation layer has high selectivity and stability in the seawater electrolysis process. The invention further provides a seawater electrolysis catalyst with the molybdate passivation layer and application of the seawater electrolysis catalyst in seawater electrolysis hydrogen production reaction, an alkaline electrolytic bath and an alkaline anion exchange membrane device.

Title: ANION EXHANGE MEMBRANE WATER ELETROLYZER AND METHOD THEREOF
Abstract: The present invention relates to an anion exchange membrane electrolysis device comprises: an anion exchange membrane; and, as an electrode material on the anion exchange membrane, a multi-component material of a transition metal series. Accordingly, the present invention can operate a full reaction cell capable of producing actual pure hydrogen and a stack of MEAs by applying a membrane electrode assembly (MEA) using an OER catalyst and an HER catalyst of a transition metal series. Meanwhile, the present invention corresponds to a corporate project conducted as part of the Gangseo Special Zone Product Innovation Support Project of the Ministry of Science and ICT (supporting department) and the Kumoh National Institute of Technology Gangseo Special Zone Promotion Team (supporting organization), and the research project name is Development of a Non-Precious Metal Catalyst Unit Cell for Alkaline Membrane Electrolysis. The organization is SHS, and the total research period is 2021. 05. 01 - 2022. 01. 31. The present invention relates to an anion exchange membrane electrolysis device capable of operating a full reaction cell capable of producing pure hydrogen and a stack of MEAs by applying a membrane electrode assembly (MEA) using an OER catalyst and an HER catalyst of a transition metal series that replace precious metals.
Applicants: KUMOH NAT INST TECHNOLOGY IND ACAD COOP FOUND;;YANG BEE LYONG

Title: Preparation method of Ni2P/MoOx/Fe2P nanorod electrocatalyst
Abstract: The invention belongs to the field of nano material preparation, and discloses a nickel-molybdenum-iron compound growing on foamed nickel and a preparation method and application of an anion exchange membrane. The difunctional electrocatalyst Ni2P/MoOx/Fe2P with an amorphous MoOx and crystal Ni2P/Fe2P heterogeneous structure is prepared through a hydrothermal-etching-phosphating method. Ni2P/MoOx/Fe2P is used as a cathode and an anode, an overall water decomposition (OWS) performance test is carried out in an electrolyte containing 1M of KOH, and the required voltage is only 1.815 V when the current density reaches the large current density of 250mA cm < 2 >. This is attributed to sufficient active sites, abundant phase interfaces and a unique nanorod array structure in the nickel-molybdenum-iron compound.
