The material still has excellent stability under the ultrahigh constant current density of 500 mA cm < 2 >. The PVA/PDDA-OH <-> membrane with anion selectivity is prepared through physical crosslinking of PVA and PDDA, and the PVA/PDDA-OH <-> membrane has good OH <-> conductivity. The anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer assembled by using the Ni2P/MoOx/Fe2P catalyst and PVA/PDDA-OH <-> stably operates for 250 hours under the current density of 1 A cm <-2 >, the hydrogen production Faraday efficiency is about 94.8% through calculation, and the potential of the anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer in the actual application of large-current hydrogen production is highlighted.
Applicants: FOSHAN GAOKE HECHUANG TECH CO LTD

Title: Magnetic field assisted anionic membrane electrolysis hydrogen production device and hydrogen production method
Abstract: The invention discloses a magnetic field assisted anionic membrane electrolysis hydrogen production device and a hydrogen production method. The magnetic field assisted anion membrane electrolysis hydrogen production device comprises an anion exchange membrane, an anode for oxygen evolution reaction, a cathode for hydrogen evolution reaction and an end plate, and the cathode and the anode are both made of magnetic nickel-grade catalysts; two sides of the anion exchange membrane are respectively assembled with the cathode and the anode to form a gas diffusion layer and a membrane electrode; two end plates are arranged on the two sides of the membrane electrode respectively, and two permanent magnets are arranged on the outer sides of the two end plates in parallel and apply magnetic fields to the cathode and the anode respectively. According to the method, a mature magnetic nickel-grade catalyst and an anion exchange membrane are respectively used as a working electrode and a diaphragm, and a magnetic field is applied under the condition of high current density, so that on one hand, the nucleation and desorption rate of bubbles under the condition that charged gas accelerates the high current density under the action of Lorentz force is optimized; on the other hand, the spin polarization of the magnetic nickel-based catalyst is optimized, so that the energy conversion efficiency is improved, and the hydrogen production energy consumption is reduced.
Applicants: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;;UNIV ZHEJIANG

Title: Slurry for catalyst layer of water electrolysis electrode and manufacturing method thereof
Abstract: The present invention relates to slurry for a catalyst layer of a water electrolysis electrode and a manufacturing method thereof and, more specifically, to slurry for a catalyst layer of a water electrolysis electrode and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the slurry for a catalyst layer of a water electrolysis electrode includes anion exchange membranes and a nafion ionomer to prevent desorption of the catalyst layer, thereby suppressing an initial deterioration phenomenon of the water electrolysis electrode.

Title: Alkali-swelling-resistant and high OH-conduction bifunctional composite anion exchange membrane and application thereof in alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production system
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of chemical catalysts, in particular to an anti-alkali-swelling high-OH-conduction difunctional composite anion exchange membrane and application thereof in an alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production system, and the anti-alkali-swelling high-OH-conduction difunctional composite anion exchange membrane comprises the following components in parts by weight: 100 parts of quaternized polyether-ether-ketone QPEEK, 5-10 parts of hydroxyapatite HAP, 3-6 parts of quaternized graphene quantum dots Q-GQDs and a solvent N, N-dimethyl formamide. 400 parts of N, N-dimethyl acetyl DMAc; through the double-filler synergistic effect of HAP and Q-GQDs, the swelling problem of the membrane is effectively solved. HAP is used as an inorganic rigid filler, and forms a strong interface bonding force with a QPEEK matrix after being subjected to special pretreatment, so that the relaxation movement of a QPEEK molecular chain in alkali liquor is limited, and the deformation of a membrane structure is inhibited; the Q-GQDs can be uniformly fused into a matrix due to the nanoscale size, so that the interface defect caused by filler agglomeration is avoided, and the anti-swelling stability of the membrane is not influenced. Compared with a pure QPEEK film, the composite film disclosed by the invention has the advantages that the long-term swelling rate in a strong-alkalinity and high-temperature environment is greatly reduced, and the long-term stability of the film structure is ensured.
Applicants: BEIJING YINENG HYDROGEN SOURCE TECH CO LTD

Title: Water electrolysis device and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to a water electrolysis device. The water electrolysis device comprises an oxygen evolution assembly, a hydrogen evolution assembly and a porous diaphragm arranged between the oxygen evolution assembly and the hydrogen evolution assembly; the oxygen evolution assembly comprises an anion exchange membrane, and a first hydrolysis catalyst layer and an oxygen evolution catalyst layer which are respectively loaded on two sides of the anion exchange membrane; the hydrogen evolution assembly comprises a proton exchange membrane, and a second hydrolysis catalyst layer and a hydrogen evolution catalyst layer which are respectively loaded on the two sides of the proton exchange membrane, and the first hydrolysis catalyst layer and the second hydrolysis catalyst layer are respectively arranged on the two sides of the porous diaphragm; the water electrolysis device further comprises a water tank, pure water is arranged in the water tank, and the lower end of the porous diaphragm extends into the pure water. The activation overpotential of the electrolyzed water and the content of precious metal iridium can be effectively reduced, and the ohmic resistance of the bipolar membrane electrolyzed water is reduced in a capillary liquid inlet mode; and high-efficiency and low-cost water electrolysis is realized.
Applicants: WUHAN WUT HYPOWER TECH CO LTD

Title: Composite alkaline ionic membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to a composite alkaline ionic membrane as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The composite alkaline ionic membrane is obtained by carrying out anion exchange on a composite membrane consisting of a quaternized anion exchange membrane type polymer and an ion solvated polymer nanofiber membrane, the quaternized anion exchange membrane type polymer is distributed on the surface and in pores of the ion solvated polymer nanofiber membrane, and the quaternized anion exchange membrane type polymer and the ion solvated polymer nanofiber membrane are combined through a covalent bond; the preparation method comprises the following steps: coating the surface of an ion solvated polymer nanofiber membrane with an anion exchange membrane type polymer solution, filling pores in the membrane with the anion exchange membrane type polymer solution, and then sequentially carrying out a cross-linking reaction, a quaternization reaction and an anion exchange reaction to prepare the composite alkaline ionic membrane; the alkaline ionic membrane is applied to alkaline electrolysis of water for hydrogen production, alkaline fuel cells, carbon dioxide conversion or electrochemical synthesis of ammonia. The composite alkaline ionic membrane disclosed by the invention has excellent ionic conductivity and mechanical strength; the preparation method is simple and feasible; the application range is wide.

Title: Anion-exchange membrane water electrolysis cathode electrode material under high current density and macro preparation method and application of anion-exchange membrane water electrolysis cathode electrode material
Abstract: The invention provides an AEMWE cathode electrode material. The AEMWE cathode electrode material comprises a conductive foam substrate and a NiPS nanosheet array compounded on the surface of the conductive foam substrate, one or more monatomic noble metals are anchored on the NiPS nanosheet. According to the preparation method of the AEMWE cathode electrode material, the foam metal is used as a substrate, a complicated spraying process and an expensive binder are not needed, the defect-rich NiPS nanosheet anchored one or more monatomic catalysts are prepared only through a chemical solution method, the content of precious metal is effectively reduced, strong coordination of precious metal-Ni bonds can be achieved, and the performance of the cathode electrode material is improved. Stronger interface charge transfer and excellent stability are provided, the hydrogen evolution reaction performance is enhanced, and the complexity of a membrane electrode preparation process can be effectively reduced. The invention breaks through the limitation of amplification and macroscopic manufacturing methods, and provides a simple method for preparing one or more monatomic load type HER integrated electrode materials suitable for industrial amplification production.

Title: Preparation method of continuous gradient catalyst layer on water electrolysis anode side of anion exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of a continuous gradient catalyst layer on an anode side for water electrolysis of an anion exchange membrane, which comprises the following steps of: (1) preparing anode catalyst layer slurry: respectively preparing gradient slurry on a near membrane side and a near PTL side of the catalyst layer and a middle transition layer, each slurry comprises catalyst particles, an ionomer dispersion liquid and a mixed solvent of isopropanol and water, and a stable dispersion liquid system is formed through a uniform mixer and ultrasonic oscillation; (2) carrying out pretreatment on the porous transmission layer to obtain a sprayable substrate; (3) preparing a gradient catalyst layer: taking the porous transmission layer as a substrate, spraying the catalyst layer on one side of the porous transmission layer, and spraying low-mass-fraction ionomer slurry on the side close to PTL; spraying high-mass-fraction ionomer slurry on the side close to the membrane; a transition layer is sprayed in the middle, and heat treatment is conducted after spraying is finished; and (4) assembling and testing the membrane electrode.

Title: Preparation method of bipolar membrane for hydrogen production by electrolysis of water
Abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a bipolar membrane for hydrogen production through electrolysis of water, and relates to the field of hydrogen production through electrolysis of water. In the process of preparing a bipolar composite membrane, a metal thin material with a microcosmic porous cavity structure is added to a middle layer, on one hand, water can have better smoothness when being introduced into the middle of the bipolar composite membrane through the cavity structure; on the other hand, due to the porous structure, hydrogen ions and hydroxyl ions dissociated under the action of an electric field when water passes through can penetrate through the middle metal sheet, and transmission paths are provided for the hydrogen ions to go to the proton exchange membrane and the hydroxyl ions to go to the anion exchange membrane. In the process of hydrogen production through water electrolysis, only water needs to be introduced in the middle, meanwhile, the proton exchange membrane serves as a cathode, the anion exchange membrane serves as an anode, no catalyst exists in the middle, and meanwhile water splitting and hydrogen conversion are completed only under low voltage.
Applicants: SHANGHAI QINGQI SHIDAI TECH CO LTD

Title: Non-carbon-based low-cost oxygen evolution catalyst and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a non-carbon-based low-cost oxygen evolution catalyst and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production. According to the preparation method, firstly, a Co3O4/TiN catalyst with excellent performance and stability is synthesized, and then the CoP-coated TiO2 catalyst is prepared through a vapor deposition selective phosphating method on the basis of the Co3O4/TiN catalyst. The prepared CoP-coated TiO2 catalyst has good performance and stability, and can be applied to an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production battery.

Title: Cationic polymer containing condensed ring structure as well as preparation method and application of cationic polymer
Abstract: The invention discloses a cationic polymer containing a condensed ring structure as well as a preparation method and application of the cationic polymer, and an anion exchange membrane based on the cationic polymer is prepared by utilizing the cationic polymer with a main chain containing the condensed ring structure. According to the invention, condensed ring structure elements are introduced into the main chain of the cationic polymer, and pi-pi interaction between condensed ring structures is utilized, so that interaction force between formed polymer chains is increased, and water absorption and swelling of the cationic polymer are inhibited; therefore, the swelling resistance and the dimensional stability of the anion exchange membrane prepared from the cationic polymer are improved; besides, the molecular weight of the cationic polymer is improved and other monomers are copolymerized by utilizing relatively high reaction activity of the condensed ring structure monomer, so that the performance of the cationic polymer is regulated and controlled, and the anion exchange membrane prepared from the cationic polymer has excellent comprehensive performance; the application in the fields of anion exchange membrane fuel cells and water electrolysis is facilitated.
Applicants: UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY;;ANQING JUSHI TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

Title: Preparation method and application of membrane electrode based on anode catalyst coating film
Abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a membrane electrode based on an anode catalyst coating film, and belongs to the technical field of membrane electrode preparation and alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) dispersing an anode catalyst, a binder and an ionomer into a solvent, and carrying out ultrasonic treatment to prepare a catalyst dispersion liquid; (2) adsorbing the anion exchange membrane on a heating plate, and heating the heating plate to a set temperature; spraying the catalyst dispersion liquid on an anion exchange membrane to obtain an anion exchange membrane for adsorbing an anode catalyst; (3) clamping the anion exchange membrane for adsorbing the anode catalyst between two pieces of Teflon cloth, and placing the Teflon cloth between two graphite plates for hot pressing to obtain an anode catalyst coated membrane electrode; according to the preparation method and application of the membrane electrode based on the anode catalyst coating membrane, the problem of substrate interface separation in the traditional catalyst coating substrate technology is effectively solved, so that the ohmic impedance is reduced, and the mass transfer efficiency is improved.
Applicants: NANJING DAQO ZHONGKE HYDROGEN ENERGY TECH CO LTD

Title: Cobalt manganese oxide catalyst-nonporous anion exchange membrane composite system stable in high-temperature alkaline environment
Abstract: The invention relates to the related field of alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production, in particular to a cobalt manganese oxide catalyst-nonporous anion exchange membrane composite system stable in high-temperature alkaline environment, which comprises a cobalt manganese oxide nanosheet and a quaternized polyarylene ether nitrile nonporous membrane, the metal molar ratio of Co to Mn of the cobalt manganese oxide is 1: 1-3: 1, and the metal molar ratio of the cobalt manganese oxide nanosheet to the quaternized polyarylene ether nitrile nonporous membrane is 1: 1-3: 1. After acid etching, the oxygen vacancy concentration is 0.2-0.5 mmol/g, and the specific surface area is 120-180m < 2 >/g; the quaternization degree of the non-porous membrane is 70-90%, the conductivity at 80 DEG C is greater than or equal to 100mS/cm, and the swelling rate in 10MKOH is 1t; 5%. According to oxygen vacancies (0.2-0.5 mmol/g) and high specific surface area (120-180 m < 2 >/g) formed after cobalt manganese oxide in the composite system is subjected to acid etching, the number of catalytic active sites is remarkably increased, an electronic structure (for example, the ratio of Co < 3 + > is increased) is optimized, the OER overpotential is as low as 210-230 mV under 10 mA/cm < 2 >, the Tafel slope is smaller than or equal to 38 mV/dec, and the charge transfer resistance is smaller than or equal to 20 omega, which are far superior to those of an unetched catalyst and a traditional system; and the water electrolysis oxygen evolution reaction rate is accelerated.
Applicants: BEIJING YINENG HYDROGEN SOURCE TECH CO LTD

Title: Mixed water electrolysis hydrogen production system and method with multiple types of electrolytic cells cooperatively operated
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrogen production, in particular to a mixed water electrolysis hydrogen production system and method with multiple types of electrolytic cells cooperatively operated. The mixed electrolysis unit is composed of an alkaline electrolytic cell array and an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell array, and the two arrays are connected into a hydrogen purification system in parallel through a multi-channel gas-liquid separator; the intelligent power supply module is electrically connected with the electrolysis unit, has a dynamic voltage regulation function, outputs a voltage range of 20-100V, and is integrated with a harmonic suppression circuit; the multi-dimensional sensing network comprises a distributed temperature sensor array embedded in an electrolytic bath pole plate, a multi-phase pressure detection unit of an electrolyte circulating pipeline and a laser gas analyzer of a hydrogen production pipeline; according to the scheme, the novel hydrogen production system capable of achieving efficient cooperation of multiple types of electrolytic cells and dynamically optimizing current distribution is provided, and the technical problem that wide-range load adaptability and operation energy efficiency are difficult to achieve at the same time is fundamentally solved.
Applicants: BEIJING YINENG HYDROGEN SOURCE TECH CO LTD

Title: WATER ELECTROLYSIS STACK
Abstract: To improve water electrolysis efficiency.SOLUTION: The water electrolysis stack includes a plurality of anion exchange membrane type cells that are electrically connected to each other in series and perform water electrolysis, and a manifold structure having a first manifold for supplying an electrolytic solution to the plurality of cells and a second manifold for discharging the electrolytic solution from the plurality of cells, wherein an inner wall surface of one or both of the first manifold and the second manifold has a higher insulating property than the electrolytic solution.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

Title: High-stability integrated oxygen evolution catalyst for anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell as well as preparation method and application of high-stability integrated oxygen evolution catalyst
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electrocatalysts, in particular to a high-stability integrated oxygen evolution catalyst for an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell and a preparation method and application of the high-stability integrated oxygen evolution catalyst. The problems that in an existing anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell, the OER overpotential is high, a catalyst layer is prone to falling off under the ampere-level current density, the preparation method is complex, and large-scale preparation is difficult are solved. The method comprises the following steps: 1) adding ferric nitrate into isopropanol, and violently stirring and dissolving to obtain a solution A; thiourea is added into deionized water to be dissolved, and a solution B is obtained; adding the solution B into the solution A under violent stirring to obtain a uniform solution C; and 2) putting the metal porous material substrate subjected to ultrasonic cleaning with ethanol and a hydrochloric acid solution into the solution C for dipping, then taking out the metal porous material substrate, washing the metal porous material substrate with a large amount of deionized water, and drying the metal porous material substrate to obtain the integrated oxygen evolution catalyst. The prepared oxygen evolution catalyst not only has high oxygen evolution catalytic activity, but also is tightly combined with a substrate, and long-term stable operation with ampere-level current density can be realized.

Title: Alkaline membrane electrode type electrolytic bath for hydrogen production by alkaline electrolysis of water and preparation method of alkaline membrane electrode type electrolytic bath
Abstract: The invention provides an alkaline membrane electrode type electrolytic cell for hydrogen production by alkaline electrolysis of water and a preparation method of the alkaline membrane electrode type electrolytic cell. The alkaline membrane electrode type electrolytic cell provided by the invention has relatively low cell voltage in hydrogen production by alkaline electrolysis of water. The alkaline membrane electrode type electrolytic bath comprises an electrolysis unit and end plates arranged on the two sides of the electrolysis unit, the electrolysis unit comprises a small electrolysis chamber, and the small electrolysis chamber comprises a bipolar plate, an anode diffusion layer, a membrane electrode, a cathode diffusion layer and a bipolar plate which are sequentially stacked; wherein the membrane electrode comprises a diaphragm as well as an anode catalyst layer and a cathode catalyst layer which are respectively loaded on two side surfaces of the diaphragm; the diaphragm is a porous diaphragm or an alkaline anion exchange membrane; the thickness of the bipolar plate ranges from 1 mm to 3 mm, the thicknesses of the anode diffusion layer and the cathode diffusion layer range from 0.02 mm to 4 mm respectively, and the mesh number of the anode diffusion layer and the mesh number of the cathode diffusion layer range from 50 meshes to 500 meshes respectively.
Applicants: CHN ENERGY INVEST GROUP CO LTD;;NAT INST CLEAN & LOW CARBON ENERGY

Title: PREPARATION OF POLYMERS FOR AEM WATER ELECTROLYSIS WITH REDUCED TENDENCY TO SWELL
Abstract: The invention is concerned with the preparation of anion-conducting polymers intended for use in alkaline membrane water electrolysis. Specifically, the intention is to reduce the tendency of anion-conducting polymers to swell in alkaline aqueous solutions, without severely impairing the specific anion conductivity of these polymers. This is achieved by adding a further reactant to the reaction mixture. In total, the polymer is prepared from three reactants, namely from 4,4-bis(4-hydroxy-3,5-dimethylphenyl)-1-methylpiperidine (formula I), from 4,4'-difluorobenzophenone (formula II), and from 4,4'- dihydroxybenzophenone (formula III) or from bis(4-hydroxy-3,5-dimethylphenyl)methanone (formula IV).

Title: METHOD FOR PRODUCING CATALYST
Abstract: The invention relates to a method for producing a catalyst, in particular for use in water electrolysis. The catalyst prepared from nickel, iron and/or cobalt precursors via hydrothermal synthesis is utilised in the membrane electrode assembly for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis.
Applicants: PETROLIAM NASIONAL BERHAD PETRONAS;;UNIV KEBANGSAAN MALAYSIA

Title: PRODUCTION OF ELECTROCATALYTICALLY ACTIVE LAYERED BODIES WITH ANION CONDUCTIVITY
Abstract: The invention relates, inter alia, to an electrocatalytically active layered body, to the production thereof and to the use thereof as an anion exchange membrane in alkaline water electrolysis. The problem addressed was that of producing a catalytically active anion exchange membrane on an industrial scale without distortion. Said anion exchange membrane is intended to be stable under alkaline conditions, to have good conductivity for hydroxide ions and to make it possible to carry out alkaline membrane water electrolysis with high efficiency. Production is intended to be carried out without the use of fluoropolymers, and as far as possible CMR substances should not be used. In the method described here, a layer of an ionomer which has a conductivity for OH− is applied to a catalytically active substrate. The ionomer layer forms the later membrane and the substrate forms the catalyst layer. An essential aspect of the method is that the catalytically active substrate, which is coated with the ionomer, is provided with dissolvable structure-forming agents. These substances can be leached or washed out of the catalyst layer, thereby leaving pores. The invention also relates to a not yet leached-out or washed-out precursor of the layered body.

Title: CATALYST COATED IONICALLY CONDUCTIVE MEMBRANE COMPRISING CONDUCTIVE POLYMER FOR WATER ELECTROLYSIS
Abstract: Catalyst-coated ionically conductive membranes are described. The catalyst-coated ionically conductive membranes comprise an ionically conductive membrane, an anode catalyst coating layer on a first surface of the ionically conductive membrane, or, a cathode catalyst coating layer on a second surface of the ionically conductive membrane, or both wherein the anode catalyst coating layer, or the cathode catalyst coating layer, or both comprises a conductive polymer. Membrane electrode assemblies and electrolysis systems incorporating the catalyst-coated ionically conductive membranes are also described.

Title: Self-repairing type oxygen evolution catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electro-catalysis water decomposition, in particular to a self-repairing type oxygen evolution catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof. According to the preparation method, the NiCoFe-based (NiCoFe-Bi) oxygen evolution catalyst containing the borate radical intercalation layer is prepared by adopting a simple electro-deposition method. When being applied to an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis (AEMWE) tank for electrocatalytic water decomposition, the NiCoFe-Bi catalyst is efficient and stable through the leaching-redeposition self-repairing process of a Fe catalytic active center in cooperation with use of a KOH self-repairing electrolyte containing Fe < 2 + > ions and borate ions. The OER catalyst provided by the invention has the advantages of low cost, high activity and ultra-long-term stability, the preparation method is simple, and powerful support is provided for the development of electro-catalytic water decomposition.

Title: Water electrolysis hydrogen production system
Abstract: The invention provides a water electrolysis hydrogen production system. According to the water electrolysis hydrogen production system, in the circulating movement process of the conductor flexible belt, the multiple auxiliary electrodes are driven by the conductor flexible belt to sequentially enter the electrolyte in the hydrogen evolution container and the electrolyte in the oxygen evolution container, and therefore hydrogen and oxygen are generated in the separated hydrogen evolution container and the oxygen evolution container in the mode that the hydrogen evolution container and the oxygen evolution container are separated from each other but not mixed; the hydrogen with very high purity can be obtained without post-treatment, so that the hydrogen is convenient to collect, transport and store. Besides, a proton exchange membrane and an anion exchange membrane can be omitted in the water electrolysis hydrogen production system, so that the membrane-free water electrolysis hydrogen production system is formed, and the cost of the water electrolysis hydrogen production system is reduced. Moreover, in the system for producing hydrogen by electrolyzing water, the system can continuously work to produce hydrogen under the conditions of no loss of active substances, sufficient electrolyte supplementation and continuous electrification, so that the requirement of large-scale industrial production is ensured.

Title: Method and system for producing hydrogen through seawater electrolysis
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of new energy, and discloses a seawater electrolytic hydrogen production method, which directly performs electrolytic hydrogen production without desalting seawater, and comprises the following specific steps: forming three independent areas, including a cathode area, an anode area and an intermediate area, by a proton exchange membrane and an anion exchange membrane, introducing seawater into the intermediate area, pure water or low-concentration saline water is introduced into the cathode region and the anode region, electrodes are arranged in the cathode region and the anode region, electrolysis is carried out by applying direct current, seawater is continuously introduced into the middle region, hydrogen is generated and collected in the cathode region, and oxygen is generated and collected in the anode region.

Title: Self-supporting oxygen evolution electrode and preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a self-supporting oxygen evolution electrode and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production. The electrode is obtained by combining a hydrothermal method and an electro-deposition method; according to the electrode, a manganese-doped basic cobalt carbonate nanowire vertically grows on the surface of foamed nickel, and the periphery of the nanowire is wrapped with a plurality of lamellar nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide nanosheets to form a whole nanorod. The nanorods are uniform in size, the length of the nanorods is 2-3 microns, the diameter of the nanorods is 100-500 nm, and the nanorods vertically grow on the surface of the foamed nickel; the electrode has relatively high catalytic activity and stability, and after foamed nickel is used as a conductive substrate, the electrode can still stably run for a long time in a strong alkaline medium under relatively high electrolytic current; the electrode is applied to water electrolysis hydrogen production and oxygen evolution reaction under the catalytic alkaline condition. The invention can be applied to renewable fuel cells, photoelectrocatalysis, alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water (AEMWE) and electrolytic hydrogen generator devices.

Title: Membrane electrode and preparation method and application based on screen printing technology
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electrochemical energy conversion, in particular to a membrane electrode and a preparation method and application based on a screen printing technology. According to the preparation method of the membrane electrode based on the screen printing technology provided by the invention, the catalyst slurry is uniformly coated on the surface of the anion exchange membrane through the steps of slurry preparation, printing plate fixation, slurry pouring and scraping printing, drying and curing and the like, the dosage and distribution of the catalyst are accurately controlled, the operation is simple and convenient, the production efficiency is high, and the applicable materials are wide; according to the present invention, the efficient continuous operation can be achieved through the simple repeated operation, the method is easily converted into the industrial automatic production, the prepared membrane electrode comprises the anion exchange membrane with the two side surfaces, the anion exchange membrane is respectively provided with the cathode catalyst layer and the anode catalyst layer, the total thickness of the membrane electrode is 0.02-0.2 mm, the high electrolysis efficiency is achieved on the basis of the thin electrode thickness, and the production efficiency is improved. The catalyst has the advantages of uniform distribution, high utilization rate, strong interface bonding force with the anion exchange membrane, low electrode attenuation rate, stable performance and high durability.

Title: Polyarylether sulphone membrane material containing sixteen flexible quaternary ammonium cation structures as well as preparation method and application of polyarylether sulphone membrane material
Abstract: The invention belongs to the field of high-performance anion exchange membranes for hydrogen production by water electrolysis and preparation thereof, and particularly discloses a polyarylether sulfone membrane material containing sixteen flexible quaternary ammonium cation structures as well as a preparation method and application of the polyarylether sulfone membrane material. The aggregation degree of ions is improved by introducing sixteen quaternary ammonium cations into a polymer structural unit, meanwhile, the movement capacity of the ions is improved by introducing a flexible side chain structure, the charge induction effect between the ions and a skeleton structure is reduced, and the ionic conductivity and chemical resistance stability of the membrane material are effectively improved; the prepared anion exchange membrane can be applied to hydrogen production through water electrolysis.
Applicants: UNIV CHANGZHOU;;SHANDONG XINGSHUN NEW MAT CO LTD

Title: Rapid preparation method and application of NiFe-LDH nickel-based electrode
Abstract: The invention discloses a rapid preparation method and application of a NiFe-LDH nickel-based electrode, and belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production and anion exchange membrane water electrolysis, the preparation method comprises the following steps: S1, at normal temperature and normal pressure, immersing a cleaned nickel-based substrate material in a ferric iron (Fe < 3 + >) etching solution for chemical etching, standing for a proper time for full reaction, and taking out the nickel-based substrate material; taking out and drying; s2, immersing the material obtained in the step S1 into a strong alkaline solution for soaking treatment, standing for a proper time to enable the material to fully react, and then taking out and drying; and S3, assembling the electrode material prepared in the step S2 into a membrane electrode, and loading the membrane electrode into an anion exchange membrane electrolysis water tank single battery for testing, so that the electric energy can be stably converted into hydrogen energy when the anion exchange membrane electrolysis water tank single battery works. According to the technical scheme, the electrolyzed water anode electrode can be rapidly prepared in a low-cost, environment-friendly and large-batch mode, the defect that an electrode preparation method in the same field at present is tedious is overcome, and commercialized development of the alkaline membrane electrolyzed water hydrogen production technology is expected to be promoted.
Applicants: BEIJING FUTURE HYDROGEN ENERGY TECH CO LTD

Title: HIGHLY ALKALI-STABLE POLY(ARYLENE ALKYLENE PIPERIDINIUM) CATIONIC POLYMERS AND PREPARATION METHODS AND APPLICATIONS
Abstract: The present invention relates to the field of cationic polymers, and in particular, to highly alkali-stable poly(arylene alkylene piperidinium) cationic polymers and preparation methods and applications. The preparation method for the highly alkali-stable poly(arylene alkylene piperidinium) cationic polymers includes the following steps: performing catalytic polycondensation on 1-R6-piperidine-3-carboxaldehyde or a salt or hydrate thereof and an aromatic compound to obtain a polymer having a piperidine moiety; and then further subjecting the polymer to a quaternization reaction to obtain the poly(arylene alkylene piperidinium) cationic polymer. The anion exchange membranes prepared from the piperidinium-based cationic polymers have ultra-high alkaline stability and excellent mechanical properties and ionic conductivities, and can be applied to the fields of electrochemical energy conversion such as fuel cells, hydrogen production by water electrolysis, electrochemical reduction of carbon dioxide, flow batteries, and fields of separation such as electrodialysis and water treatment.

Title: OXYHYDROXIDE NON-METAL-DOPED ELECTROCATALYST, METHOD FOR MANUFACTURING SAME, AND WATER ELECTROLYSIS BATTERY OR AIR BATTERY COMPRISING SAME
Abstract: One embodiment of the present invention provides an electrocatalyst comprising a hybrid composite including MXene and layered double hydroxide (LDH), wherein the hybrid composite is partially doped with fluorine. The electrocatalyst of the present invention can be used as a catalyst material of a positive electrode in a metal air battery or an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis system, and has excellent electrochemical performance and stability.

Title: Water electrolysis membrane electrode, preparation method thereof and electrolytic bath
Abstract: The invention provides a water electrolysis membrane electrode, a preparation method thereof and an electrolytic bath. The water electrolysis membrane electrode comprises an anode porous transmission layer, an anode catalyst layer, an anion exchange membrane, a cathode catalyst layer and a cathode porous transmission layer which are sequentially stacked; the cathode catalyst layer comprises a third sub-catalyst layer and a fourth sub-catalyst layer which are stacked, and the third sub-catalyst layer is located on the side, facing the anion exchange membrane, of the fourth sub-catalyst layer; wherein the contact angle of the first sub-catalyst layer is larger than that of the second sub-catalyst layer, and the contact angle of the third sub-catalyst layer is smaller than that of the fourth sub-catalyst layer. Layered structures are respectively arranged in the anode catalyst layer and the cathode catalyst layer, so that a directional gas-liquid transmission channel pointing to the anode porous transmission layer and the cathode porous transmission layer can be constructed in the water electrolysis membrane electrode, rapid transmission of reactants and products can be ensured, concentration polarization under large current is greatly inhibited, and the water electrolysis membrane electrode has the advantages of simple structure, low cost and the like. Therefore, the ideal performance of the water electrolysis membrane electrode is ensured when the water electrolysis membrane electrode operates under high current density.
Applicants: HUIZHOU EVE HYDROGEN ENERGY CO LTD

Title: Carbon-coated nickel ruthenium nano-catalyst, preparation method thereof and anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell
Abstract: The invention relates to the field of nano materials, and discloses a carbon-coated nickel ruthenium nano catalyst, a preparation method thereof and an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell. The carbon-coated nickel-ruthenium nano-catalyst contains carbon-coated nickel-ruthenium nano-particles, and each carbon-coated nickel-ruthenium nano-particle contains a nickel-ruthenium inner core and a graphitized carbon layer shell coated on the surface of the nickel-ruthenium inner core; in the carbon-coated nickel ruthenium nano-catalyst, the weight ratio of a nickel element to a ruthenium element is (0.2-30): 1. Compared with the existing carbon-coated nickel nano-catalyst and carbon-coated ruthenium nano-catalyst, the carbon-coated nickel-ruthenium nano-catalyst provided by the invention has the advantages that the carbon coating tightness is high, and better catalytic performance and higher stability can be obtained. The method provided by the invention is simple in process and easy for large-scale production, and preferably, the solvent in the preparation process is a water phase, so that the method is green and environment-friendly.
Applicants: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;;SINOPEC CORP RES INST PETROLEUM PROCESSING

Title: Bipolar membrane enhanced electrolytic water hydrogen production electrolytic cell
Abstract: A bipolar membrane enhanced electrolytic cell for hydrogen production by water electrolysis relates to the technical field of hydrogen production by water electrolysis and comprises an integrated base, and a bipolar membrane electrolysis module, a waterway circulation module, a heat dissipation module and a purification and drying module are arranged on the integrated base; the bipolar membrane electrolysis module comprises an electrolysis tank, and the electrolysis tank is welded on the integrated base; a partition vertical plate is welded in the electrolysis tank, and an electric field generator is fixed on the partition vertical plate; a communicating opening is formed in the partition vertical plate, and a front-section electrolysis pipe and a rear-section electrolysis pipe are fixedly arranged on the two sides of the communicating opening; a cation outlet is formed in the front-section electrolysis tube, and a cation exchange membrane is fixed in the cation outlet; a horizontal interface film is also fixedly arranged in the front-section electrolytic tube; an anion discharge port is formed in the rear-section electrolysis tube, and an anion exchange membrane is fixed in the anion discharge port; and a vertical interfacial film is also fixedly arranged in the rear-section electrolytic tube. The invention solves the problems of high energy consumption, low purity, difficult heat dissipation, high water consumption, numerous and complicated system, rigid control, safety risk and the like in hydrogen production by electrolysis of water.
Applicants: SHANDONG HAIQING ENERGY TECH CO LTD

Title: BOP SEPARATE TYPE BOP APPLIED WATER ELECTROLYSIS DEVICE
Abstract: A detachable BOP-applied water electrolysis device is provided. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the detachable BOP-applied water electrolysis device comprises: a water electrolysis tank which includes a cathode chamber and an anode chamber in which oxygen and hydrogen are respectively generated by electrolysis, and an anion exchange membrane which is between the cathode chamber and the anode chamber to allow anions to be exchanged; a cathode gas-liquid separator and an anode gas-liquid separator which each separate the oxygen or hydrogen generated in the cathode chamber and the anode chamber from the electrolyte; a pair of pressure gauges which measure the pressures of oxygen and hydrogen discharged from the cathode gas-liquid separator and the anode gas-liquid separator; a pressure control unit which detects the pressure difference between the pair of pressure gauges and controls the pressure difference to be kept at a constant level; and an inclined liquid pipe which is installed in an inclined form between the cathode gas-liquid separator and the anode gas-liquid separator. According to the present invention, it is possible to prevent hydrogen and oxygen remaining in an electrolyte from mixing, and thus, ignition during an electrolysis process can be prevented.
Applicants: JISUNG Q AND TECH CO LTD

Title: Catalyst-coated polymer electrolyte membranes and methods for their manufacture
Abstract: A method for the manufacture of catalyst-coated polymer electrolyte membranes (CCMs) for water electrolysis is described. The CCMs may comprise a proton exchange membrane (PEM) or an anion exchange membrane (AEM) with an anode layer and/or a cathode catalyst layer applied to a face of the membrane. The method comprises the steps of forming a polymer electrolyte membrane on a first catalyst layer 2 comprising a platinum-containing catalyst on a carbon support material 1 and a catalyst layer ion-conducting polymer. The catalytic layer 2 may comprise a hydrogen evolution catalyst (HER) and/or an oxygen evolution catalyst (OER). The first catalyst layer 2 has an expected effective platinum surface area in the range of and including 5-200 cm2Pt/cm2 and a carbon content in the range of and including 30-60 wt%.

Title: NICKEL SULPHIDE SUPPORTED ON MOF-BASED ELECTROCATALYST FOR LARGER ACTIVE AREA AEM WATER ELECTROLYSER
Abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel sulphide supported on MOF-based electrocatalyst for electrochemical water splitting. The present disclosure also relates to a method for the synthesis of nickel sulphide supported on MOF-based electrocatalyst for electrochemical water splitting. The present disclosure has an application in large active surface area AEM electrochemical water splitting. The electrocatalyst of the present disclosure has an excellent performance (>1 Acm-2 of current densities) at larger areas of active electrodes (>10 cm2) and for a longer period of operation (>100h) at elevated temperatures that are attractive to industries.

Title: AEM electrolytic bath
Abstract: The invention provides an AEM electrolytic bath which comprises a cathode end plate, a cathode insulating layer, an electrolysis unit, an anode insulating layer and an anode end plate which are sequentially arranged in the same direction. Each small electrolysis chamber comprises a cathode plate, a cathode sealing ring, a cathode gas diffusion layer, an anion exchange membrane, an anode gas diffusion layer and an anode plate which are sequentially arranged in the same direction, the cathode plate and the anode plate at the series connection part between the small electrolysis chambers are combined to form a bipolar plate, the cathode plate comprises a cathode surface, and the anode plate comprises an anode surface; the bipolar plate comprises a cathode surface and an anode surface; a concave area and an outer frame area are arranged on the cathode surface and the anode surface, the outer frame area is arranged around the concave area, a plurality of raised lines are arranged in the concave area, a diversion trench is formed between the raised lines, confluence trenches are arranged in the concave area at two ends of the diversion trench, and the confluence trenches are communicated with the diversion trench. According to the scheme, the uniform diffusion of the electrolyte in the AEM electrolytic cell is realized.
Applicants: SUZHOU JUNA NEW MATERIAL TECH CO LTD;;SHANGHAI JUNA NEW MATERIAL TECH CO LTD

Title: AEM electrolytic bath
Abstract: The invention provides an AEM electrolytic bath which comprises a cathode end plate, a cathode insulating layer, an electrolysis unit, an anode insulating layer and an anode end plate which are sequentially arranged in the same direction, and the electrolysis unit comprises small electrolysis chambers arranged in series; from the cathode insulating layer to the anode insulating layer, each small electrolysis chamber comprises a cathode plate, a cathode sealing ring, a cathode gas diffusion layer, an anion exchange membrane, an anode gas diffusion layer, an anode sealing ring and an anode plate which are sequentially arranged, and the cathode plate and the anode plate at the series connection part between the small electrolysis chambers are combined to form a bipolar plate; the cathode plate comprises a cathode surface, the anode plate comprises an anode surface, the bipolar plate comprises a cathode surface and an anode surface, the cathode surface and the anode surface are provided with a concave area and an outer frame area, the outer frame area surrounds the concave area, the concave area is respectively provided with two confluence runners, and a branch runner is arranged between the two confluence runners; and the two ends of the branch flow channel are communicated with the confluence flow channel. According to the scheme, uniform diffusion of the electrolyte is realized.
Applicants: SHANGHAI JUNA NEW MATERIAL TECH CO LTD

Title: Membrane electrode, preparation method thereof and electrolytic bath
Abstract: The invention provides a membrane electrode, a preparation method thereof and an electrolytic bath, and belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and the membrane electrode comprises an anode catalytic diffusion layer, an anion exchange membrane, a conductive polymer layer and a cathode catalytic diffusion layer. The anode catalytic diffusion layer comprises a porous metal diffusion layer and an anode catalytic layer formed on one side of the porous metal diffusion layer, the anion exchange membrane is arranged on the side, provided with the anode catalytic layer, of the anode catalytic diffusion layer, and the conductive polymer is arranged on the side, away from the anode catalytic diffusion layer, of the anion exchange membrane; the cathode catalytic diffusion layer comprises a cathode gas diffusion layer and a cathode catalytic layer arranged on one side of the cathode gas diffusion layer, and the cathode catalytic layer is located between the conductive polymer layer and the cathode gas diffusion layer. According to the membrane electrode provided by the embodiment of the invention, the dynamic response performance of the membrane electrode can be improved, the rapid power regulation capability and durability under a fluctuating power supply are improved, and the service life is prolonged.
Applicants: HUIZHOU EVE HYDROGEN ENERGY CO LTD

Title: METHOD OF SYNTHESIZING A 1,6-DIAZABICYCLO[4.4.4]TETRADECAN-1,6-IUM CATIONIC STRUCTURE, USE OF SAID CATIONIC STRUCTURE IN ELECTROCHEMICAL APPLICATIONS, AND POLYMERS COMPRISING SAID CATIONIC STRUCTURE
Abstract: A method of synthesizing 1,6-diazabicyclo[4.4.4]tetradecan-1,6-ium (in-DBD) cationic structure, a method of integrating in-DBD cationic structure into a polymer, and the use of in-DBD polymers in electrochemical applications such as an anion exchange membrane (AEM) are described. The configuration of in-DBD allows a cationic charge to be carried by a proton stabilized inside an aliphatic cage formed by its three-dimensional structure and anchored between two nitrogen atoms via a symmetrical intra-bridgehead hydrogen bond. With the synthesis method of in-DBD and its application in various scenarios, an organic cation-hydroxide is realized that persists at critically low hydration levels and high temperatures (<10% RH at 80 °C) and shows orders of magnitude higher hydroxide stability than conventional cations.

Title: POROUS TRANSPORT MEMBRANE AND MANUFACTURING METHOD THEREOF
Abstract: The present invention provides a porous transport membrane and a manufacturing method thereof. The porous transport membrane has an excellent ability to transport gaseous and liquid substances and a large contact area with a catalyst layer, and thus can greatly improve performance when applied to an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis system.

Title: Alkaline electrolytic water hydrogen production device, electrolytic bath thereof and membrane electrode assembly of electrolytic bath
Abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides an alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production device, an electrolytic bath thereof and a membrane electrode assembly of the electrolytic bath. The device is suitable for hydrogen production under the pressure difference environment of anode oxygen normal pressure and cathode hydrogen back pressure. The electrolytic bath comprises an anode end plate, an anode current collector, a membrane assembly, a cathode current collector and a cathode end plate. A water inlet is formed in the anode end plate and is used for injecting an electrolyte stock solution from one side of the anode side of the electrolytic cell. The membrane electrode assembly comprises an anode diffusion layer, an anode catalyst layer, an exchange membrane, a cathode catalyst layer and a cathode diffusion layer, the exchange membrane comprises a first thin film and a second thin film which are in contact, the first thin film is an alkaline ionic membrane, and the second thin film is an ion solvation membrane or an anion exchange membrane. In operation, anode liquid supply and a differential pressure type scheme can be adopted for hydrogen production, and the problems that in an alkaline water electrolysis device adopting a traditional electrode, membrane puncture is caused during pressure operation, and hydrogen in oxygen exceeds the standard can be avoided.
Applicants: XIAMEN JIHE WEILAI ENERGY CO LTD

Title: CATALYST INK, MEMBRANE-CATALYST LAYER ASSEMBLY, CELL STACK, AND METHOD FOR PRODUCING MEMBRANE-CATALYST LAYER ASSEMBLY
Abstract: This catalyst ink for forming an anode catalyst layer (61) on an anion exchange membrane (51) contains a solvent, an electrolyte, and a catalyst. The mass ratio of the electrolyte to the catalyst is 0.07-0.3. Thus, the anode catalyst layer (61) can be satisfactorily formed on the anion exchange membrane (51).

Title: AEM membrane electrode, AEM electrolytic bath and electrolytic hydrogen production method
Abstract: The invention discloses an AEM membrane electrode, an AEM electrolytic bath and an electrolytic hydrogen production method, and belongs to the technical field of electrolytic hydrogen production. The AEM membrane electrode is of a vertical structure and comprises an anode current collection mass transfer catalytic layer, an anion exchange membrane, a cathode catalytic layer and a cathode current collection mass transfer layer from top to bottom, the AEM electrolytic tank comprises an anode end plate, a plurality of small electrolytic chambers and a cathode end plate from top to bottom; every two adjacent small electrolysis chambers are isolated through a positive and negative composite plate; the anode surface of the cathode-anode composite plate is communicated with the alkali liquor inlet and the alkali liquor outlet, and the cathode surface of the cathode-anode composite plate is communicated with the hydrogen outlet; the small electrolysis chamber comprises an AEM membrane electrode, an anode current collection mass transfer catalytic layer of the AEM membrane electrode is in contact with an anode surface of the cathode-anode composite plate, and a cathode current collection mass transfer catalytic layer of the AEM membrane electrode is in contact with a cathode surface of the cathode-anode composite plate. The membrane electrode has better operation stability and more efficient hydrogen production performance, the purity of gas produced by an electrolytic bath is high, the equipment safety is high, the water content of hydrogen is low, and the gas purification and drying cost is low.
Applicants: SHANDONG SAIKESAISI HYDROGEN ENERGY CO LTD

Title: Device and method for preparing high-pressure hydrogen and oxygen
Abstract: The invention discloses a device and a method for preparing high-pressure hydrogen and oxygen, and relates to the field of pure water electrolysis. Liquid water placed in the water passage is electrolyzed under the action of electric field force generated by voltage provided by the power supply, and first electrolytic ions and second electrolytic ions are obtained; the anion exchange membrane passes through first electrolytic ions and is oxidized under the action of electric field force to obtain oxygen and water; the proton exchange membrane passes through second electrolytic ions and is subjected to reduction treatment under the action of electric field force, and hydrogen is obtained; according to the invention, oxygen and hydrogen generated by electrolysis can be isolated from a water passage, so that rapid pressurization of gas can be realized, and preparation and rapid pressurization of hydrogen and oxygen can be realized.
Applicants: GUANGZHOU RUISHUO TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

Title: AEM electrolytic cell membrane electrode and preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses an AEM electrolytic cell membrane electrode and a preparation method and application thereof, the membrane electrode comprises: an anode comprising an anode catalyst growing on a porous metal substrate in situ; the cathode comprises a cathode catalyst and a cathode diffusion layer; the anion exchange membrane is arranged between the anode catalyst and the cathode catalyst; and the cathode catalyst is loaded on the cathode side of the anion exchange membrane. The self-supporting anode is formed in an in-situ growth mode, so that the self-supporting anode has the effects of being stable in performance, good in conductivity, not prone to falling off and the like, gas diffusion is guaranteed, active sites are provided for oxidation reaction, a gas diffusion layer does not need to be considered for the anode when an electrolytic cell is assembled, and assembling is easy and convenient; the cathode catalyst is sprayed on the anion exchange membrane, and the advantages of the CCM are combined, so that the mass transfer path of the cathode is reduced, the ohmic polarization is reduced, and the electrolytic efficiency is improved.
Applicants: ANQING BRANCH GUANGDONG POLYROCKS CHEMICAL CO LTD

Title: Water electrolysis hydrogen production catalyst, preparation method and application
Abstract: The invention discloses a water electrolysis hydrogen production catalyst, a preparation method and application. The water electrolysis hydrogen production catalyst is a NiFeRu catalyst. According to the invention, methanol oxidation is used for replacing positive oxygen evolution reaction (OER) of electrolyzed water, so that the voltage of the system can be obviously reduced. The generation of formic acid by electrochemical oxidation of methanol can be carried out under the condition of 0.8 V (vs.SHE), and compared with 1.8 V of OER, the power consumption of the system is reduced by two thirds. According to the method, the system voltage of methanol electrocatalytic oxidation coupled water electrolysis hydrogen production is successfully reduced in modes of catalyst synthesis, proper anion exchange membrane selection, system voltage control and the like, single formate is obtained from a product, and carbonate generation caused by excessive oxidation of methanol is avoided.

Title: Device and method for seawater electrolysis trigeneration and application of device
Abstract: The invention discloses a device for seawater electrolysis trigeneration. The device comprises a voltage providing device, an anode, a cathode, a diaphragm and an electrolytic cell, wherein the electrolytic cell is provided with electrolyte; the electrolyte comprises an alkali liquid and sodium chloride; the concentration of the alkali liquid is not smaller than 3mol/L; the anode and the cathode are respectively arranged in the electrolytic cell and are in contact with the electrolyte; the voltage providing device is electrically connected with the anode and the cathode; the diaphragm is arranged in the electrolytic cell and is used for isolating the anode from the cathode; and the diaphragm is selected from an anion exchange membrane, a cation exchange membrane or an alkali diaphragm. Theinvention further discloses a method for seawater electrolysis trigeneration and application of the device. In the electrolysis process of the device, the alkali liquid is put into seawater, then theconcentration of the alkali liquid is not smaller than 3mol/L, and seawater electrolysis trigeneration can be achieved, that is, generation of hydrogen, oxygen and sodium chloride.

Title: METHOD FOR PRODUCING WATER ELECTROLYSIS CATALYST COMPRISING NICKEL COBALT SELENIDE AND MOLYBDENUM SELENIDE
Abstract: A manufacturing method of a hybrid nanostructure comprises: a first step of synthesizing a nickel-cobalt precursor by hydrothermal synthesis of a precursor solution manufactured by dispersing a nickel precursor, a cobalt precursor, and glycerol in a solvent; and a second step of forming a nanosphere including nickel cobalt selenide and molybdenum selenide by hydrothermal synthesis after adding the nickel-cobalt precursor to a solution including a molybdenum precursor and a selenite precursor. The present invention can exhibit improved electrochemical catalytic activity in both a hydrogen generation reaction (HER) and an oxygen generation reaction (OER) during a water decomposition reaction using a catalyst for water electrolysis, and the catalyst for water electrolysis can efficiently produce hydrogen with a lower energy supply than an existing noble metal electrode, and can be used for both anion exchange membrane water transfer electrolysis and a solar cell-water electrolysis system.

Title: AEMWE anode non-noble metal catalyst, catalyst slurry, membrane electrode, electrolytic cell and preparation method
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis, and particularly relates to an anode non-noble metal catalyst for AEMWE, catalyst slurry, a membrane electrode, an electrolytic bath and a preparation method. The non-noble metal catalyst NiCo2O4 prepared by the preparation method of the anode non-noble metal catalyst for AEMWE provided by the invention is excellent in performance and simple in preparation cost; meanwhile, the preparation method of the catalyst NiCo2O4 is further improved by controlling the ratio of the water-soluble nickel salt to the water-soluble cobalt salt in the preparation method, controlling the addition of the alkaline solution and controlling the sintered nickel-cobalt hydroxide, so that the technical problem that a large-scale synthesis method of the anode catalyst for the high-performance AEMWE is lacked in the prior art is solved.
Applicants: ZHONGSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;;GUANGDONG NEW ENERGY STORAGE NATIONAL RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

Title: WATER ELECTROLYSIS DEVICE AND OPERATING METHOD OF THE SAME
Abstract: To provide an apparatus and a method that suppress degradation of electrolysis performance caused by accumulation of impurities in the vicinity of a cathode part.SOLUTION: A water electrolysis device 11 comprises a water electrolysis cell 21 in which an anion exchange membrane 33 is provided between a cathode part 31 and an anode part 32, and a power supply device 22 which supplies power to the water electrolysis cell 21, and performs an electrolysis operation for generating water electrolysis by supplying an electrolyte to the water electrolysis cell 21 while the power supply device 22 supplies power to the water electrolysis cell 21, and a removal operation for removing impurities in the vicinity of the cathode part 31 by supplying a removal liquid to the cathode part 31.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

Title: AEM electrolytic bath
Abstract: The invention provides an AEM electrolytic cell which comprises a cathode end plate, a cathode insulating layer, an electrolytic cell, an anode insulating layer and an anode end plate which are sequentially arranged, the electrolytic cell is provided with a first ventilation channel, a second ventilation channel, a first liquid passing channel and a second liquid passing channel, and the cross section of each channel is triangular; in the direction from the cathode end plate to the anode end plate, each small electrolysis chamber comprises a cathode plate, a cathode sealing ring, a cathode gas diffusion layer, an anion exchange membrane, an anode gas diffusion layer and an anode plate which are sequentially arranged, each cathode plate comprises a cathode surface, each anode plate comprises an anode surface, and the cathode plates and the anode plates at the series connection parts between the small electrolysis chambers form a bipolar plate; a cathode reaction cavity is formed between the cathode surface and the cathode gas diffusion layer, an anode reaction cavity is formed between the anode surface and the anode gas diffusion layer, the first ventilation channel and the first liquid channel are communicated with the cathode reaction cavity, and the second ventilation channel and the second liquid channel are communicated with the anode reaction cavity; and flow guide channels are arranged in the cathode reaction cavity and the anode reaction cavity.
Applicants: SHANGHAI JUNA NEW MATERIAL TECH CO LTD

Title: Dp track coupling type MXene loaded phosphide heterojunction electrocatalyst and preparation and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of an MMoP-CoP/Ti3C2 heterojunction electrocatalyst based on dp track coupling and application of the MMoP-CoP/Ti3C2 heterojunction electrocatalyst in alkaline electrolytic water hydrogen evolution (HER) and full water splitting, and belongs to the technical field of electrocatalytic materials and new energy. According to the invention, polyoxometallate (POMs) is encapsulated in a cobalt-based imidazolate framework (ZIFL) and anchored on Ti3C2 MXene, and a strong coupling MMoP (at) CoP/Ti3C2 (M = Fe, Co, Ni, Cu) heterojunction is constructed in situ through low-temperature phosphorization. The heterojunction interface work function difference (delta phi) is accurately regulated and controlled to 0.06 eV through the 3d orbit of the transition metal M and the 3p orbit of the transition metal P, the interface hydrogen overflow potential barrier is remarkably reduced, and efficient alkaline hydrogen evolution and stable anion exchange membrane water electrolysis (AEMWE) are achieved. The overpotential of the obtained FeMoP-coated CoP/Ti3C2 is only 58.9 mV when the voltage is 10 Accm <-2 >, the Tafel slope is 47.85 mV dec-1, a symmetric AEM electrolytic tank can realize 1 Accm <-2 > at 1.96 V and stably operate for 1000 hours, and the method is superior to commercial Pt/C//RuO2. The process is mild, the structure is controllable, the cost is low, and a general preparation strategy is provided for the non-noble metal efficient electrolyzed water catalyst.

Title: Crosslinking of hydroxide stable, polybenzimidazoliums and polyimidazoliums membranes and ionomers
Abstract: Described herein are crosslinked alkylated poly(benzimidazole) and poly(imidazole) polymer materials and devices (e.g., fuel cells, water electrolyzers) including these polymer materials. The polymer materials can be prepared in a convenient manner, allowing for applications such as anion exchange membranes (AEMs). The membranes provide high anion conductivities over a wider range of operating conditions when compared to the analogous membranes that are not cross-linked. The crosslinked polymer materials have improved alkaline stability, when compared to the analogous non-crosslinked polymer materials.

Title: PEEK fiber for water electrolysis hydrogen production diaphragm, diaphragm base cloth and application
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of diaphragm materials for water electrolysis hydrogen production, and particularly relates to a PEEK fiber for a diaphragm for water electrolysis hydrogen production, diaphragm base cloth and application. The PEEK fiber is prepared by adopting a specific cooling and stretching process, and has the advantages of high strength and the like; the base cloth is made of a specific weaving structure and is subjected to shallow sulfonation treatment. The diaphragm prepared from the PEEK fiber and the base cloth has the advantages of high strength, excellent durability and good surface resistance and air tightness, realizes the unification of low resistance, high air tightness, high strength and long service life, and is suitable for being used as a hydrogen production diaphragm of proton exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production equipment; and the diaphragm is also suitable for being used as a hydrogen production diaphragm of alkaline anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production equipment.
Applicants: ZHEJIANG HAILIDE TECH CO LTD;;ZHEJIANG HAILIDE NEW MAT CO LTD;;HAILIDE NEW MATERIAL RES SHANGHAI CO LTD

Title: A reliable electrolyser system
Abstract: Disclosed is a stable electrolysis system. The stable water electrolysis system for producing hydrogen through a water electrolysis reaction according to the present invention includes: a water electrolysis stack for producing hydrogen and oxygen, a check valve in the hydrogen discharge line, a liquid pump composed of a pressurizer, an adsorber and an oxygen discharge line, a three-way valve, an air-cooled heat exchanger, a liquid return tank, an oxygen water separator and a quantitative water pump that supplies a quantitative amount of water consumed during hydrogen production, a power supply that supplies electricity to the auxiliary water tank and the electrolysis stack, a bleed resistance part and a control device, wherein water is supplied in real-time at regular quantities upon producing hydrogen to keep the water electrolysis stack temperature constant, thereby stabilizing the hydrogen production reaction, and a constant concentration of an alkaline electrolyte solution such as anion exchange membrane water electrolysis is maintained, thereby providing constant hydrogen production. In addition, after the discharge step of discharging oxygen from the electrode of the unit cell of the water electrolysis stack, the residual voltage of the water electrolysis stack generated when the water electrolysis system is stopped, a residual voltage is removed by using the bleed resistance, so that an abnormal behavior of the electrolytic stack is prevented.

Title: AEM electrolyzed water membrane electrode and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to the field of AEM electrolyzed water membrane electrodes, and discloses an AEM electrolyzed water membrane electrode and a preparation method thereof. The AEM water electrolysis membrane electrode comprises a cathode catalyst layer, an anion exchange membrane, a hydrogen elimination layer I and an anode catalyst layer which are sequentially arranged from bottom to top, optionally, a hydrogen elimination layer II is also arranged between the cathode catalyst layer and the anion exchange membrane; the hydrogen elimination layer I comprises a first hydrogen elimination layer and a second hydrogen elimination layer, and a hydrogen elimination catalyst in the first hydrogen elimination layer is selected from at least one of platinum, palladium and iridium; a hydrogen elimination catalyst in the second hydrogen elimination layer is selected from at least one of cerium oxide, copper oxide, aluminum oxide, zirconium oxide, niobium oxide, tantalum oxide, tungsten oxide, yttrium oxide, strontium oxide and vanadium oxide. According to the AEM water electrolysis membrane electrode, the usage amount of a noble metal catalyst in the first hydrogen elimination layer is reduced, the problem that the noble metal is exposed to high potential to cause oxidation corrosion and lose the hydrogen elimination effect is solved, and the AEM water electrolysis membrane electrode has a wide application prospect in the field of AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production and hydrogen elimination.
Applicants: CHANGZHOU QINGZHOU ENERGY TECH CO LTD

Title: SEPARATOR, ELECTROLYTIC CELL, CELL STACK, AND HYDROGEN PRODUCTION DEVICE
Abstract: This separator is used in an electrolytic cell provided with an anion exchange membrane. The separator is provided with a conductive plate and a frame body that supports the outer peripheral edge of the conductive plate. The frame body is composed of a resin material that is an electrically insulating material. The frame body includes: a supply manifold that is a supply port for an electrolytic solution; and a supply slit that connects the supply manifold and the inner peripheral edge of the frame body. The electrical resistance value of the supply slit is between 50Ω and 1000Ω inclusive. The electrical resistance value is obtained by dividing a value, which is obtained by dividing the length of the supply slit by the cross-sectional area of the supply slit, by the conductivity of the electrolytic solution flowing through the supply slit.

Title: Macroporous cathode design for anion-exchange membrane water electrolyzer and fabrication method thereof
Abstract: According to the present invention, the cathode electrode for water electrolysis comprises a carbon nanotube array laminated structure in which two or more carbon nanotube arrays are laminated to cross each other in a vertical direction. gas generated by macropores included in the carbon nanotube array laminated structure can be easily discharged, and resistance is low and catalytic activity is excellent.
Applicants: UNIV DONGGUK IND ACAD COOP;;SEOUL NAT UNIV R&DB FOUNDATION;;INST BASIC SCIENCE

Title: Active foamed nickel anode and activation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses an active foamed nickel anode and an activation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of hydrogen production through water electrolysis. The activation method comprises the following steps: carrying out a reaction on pretreated foamed nickel and a solid phosphorus-containing precursor in a non-direct contact manner, introducing inert gas, exhausting air, carrying out programmed heating calcination activation, and carrying out post-treatment to obtain the active foamed nickel anode. The method is simple in process, remarkable in effect and suitable for large-scale production, the specific surface area of the catalyst can be greatly increased, the water electrolysis oxygen evolution (OER) performance of the foamed nickel is enhanced, and the method can be directly applied to hydrogen production through water electrolysis in an alkaline or anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell.

Title: Decoupling hydrogen production device
Abstract: A decoupling hydrogen production device comprises an electrolytic tank used for electrolysis and further comprises a solar panel, a first infusion tube, a cathode plate and an anode plate, the electrolytic tank is connected with the solar panel used for power supply through a wire, one side of the electrolytic tank is connected with the first infusion tube, one end of the first infusion tube is connected with a first infusion pump, and the other end of the first infusion tube is connected with a second infusion pump. A liquid outlet of the first infusion pump is connected with a second infusion tube, one end of the second infusion tube is connected with an oxygen evolution kettle, the bottom end of the oxygen evolution kettle is connected with a third infusion tube, one end of the third infusion tube is connected with a second infusion pump, and a liquid outlet of the second infusion pump is connected with a fourth infusion tube; an anion-exchange membrane is arranged in the middle of the electrolytic tank, a cathode reaction area is arranged on one side of the anion-exchange membrane, and an anode reaction area is arranged on the other side of the anion-exchange membrane. The hydrogen-oxygen separation device is novel in structure and ingenious in conception, prepared hydrogen and oxygen are separated out separately and cannot be mutually mixed, and the explosion risk is reduced.

Title: WATER ELECTROLYSIS APPARATUS
Abstract: To provide a water electrolysis apparatus capable of preventing breakage of an anion exchange membrane resulting from localized pressure.SOLUTION: A water electrolysis apparatus 100 comprises: an anion exchange membrane 11 having a first surface F1 and a second surface F2 which are on opposite sides of each other; a first flow passage member 41 facing the first surface F1; an anode part 20 positioned between the first surface F1 and the first flow passage member 41; a second flow passage member 42 facing the second surface F2; a cathode part 30 positioned between the second surface F2 and the second flow passage member 42; a first gasket 51 enclosing the anode part 20 between the first surface F1 and the first flow passage member 41; and a first protective film 61 including a first outer circumference 611 located between the first surface F1 and the first gasket 51 and a first inner circumference 612 located within the inner edge E1 of the first gasket 51.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

Title: MEMBRANE ELECTRODE ASSEMBLY AND WATER ELECTROLYSIS CELL
Abstract: To maintain a high permeation amount of water from an anode side to a cathode side through an electrolyte membrane as compared with a conventional water electrolysis apparatus in which an electrolyte is supplied only to the anode side.SOLUTION: The membrane-electrode assembly 30 includes the anion exchange membrane 33 including the first surface F1 and the second surface F2 opposite to each other, the cathode 31 facing the first surface F1, and the anode 32 facing the second surface F2, the cathode 31 exhibits higher hydrophilicity than the anode 32, the electrolytic solution is supplied to the anode 32 from the outside, and the electrolytic solution is not supplied to the cathode 31 from the outside.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

Title: METHOD OF PRODUCING MEMBRANE-ELECTRODE JOINT, MEMBRANE-ELECTRODE JOINT, AND WATER ELECTROLYSIS DEVICE
Abstract: To provide a method of producing a membrane-electrode joint of low resistance for use in water electrolysis by suppressing thermal decomposition of an electrolyte membrane constituted of an anion exchange membrane.SOLUTION: The method of producing a membrane-electrode joint for use in water electrolysis by thermal compression bonding of a catalyst layer including a catalyst and an anionic ionomer to an electrolyte membrane comprising an anion exchange membrane, includes wetting a catalyst layer formed on a conductive substrate with a solvent to form a wet catalyst layer, and carrying out thermal compression bonding of the wet catalyst layer present on the conductive substrate to the electrolyte membrane at a temperature equal to or higher than the glass transition temperature and a temperature lower than the thermal decomposition temperature of the electrolyte membrane.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

Title: LDH-NiCoFe nanowire catalyst, preparation method and application
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of electro-catalysis, and discloses an LDH-NiCoFe nanowire catalyst, a preparation method and application, and the LDH-NiCoFe nanowire catalyst is prepared by adopting a liquid phase synthesis method. The morphology of the catalyst is a unique one-dimensional linear shape, the diameter of the nanowire is about 20 nanometers, and the size is uniform. In addition, the micro-size and component adjustability and dispersity of the catalyst are good, and the one-dimensional catalyst is beneficial to electron directional transmission. The method has wide application value and prospect in devices and equipment in the fields of water electrolysis hydrogen production, alkaline electrolytic cells, anion exchange membrane water decomposition systems, photoelectrocatalysis, organic pollutant degradation and the like.
Applicants: YANGTZE RIVER DELTA RES INSTITUTE UESTC HUZHOU

Title: Main chain type polyaryl piperidine polymer as well as preparation method and application thereof
