Abstract: The invention relates to a main chain type polyaryl piperidine polymer as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving a linear structure phenyl monomer, a strong bond energy linear structure phenyl monomer, 1, 2-diphenylethane and N-methyl-4-piperidone to obtain a precursor polymer solution; dropwise adding trifluoroacetic acid and trifluoromethanesulfonic acid to obtain a main chain type polyarene piperidine polymer precursor; and dissolving the polyaromatic piperidine, adding methyl iodide and potassium carbonate, reacting to obtain a quaternized main chain type polyaromatic piperidine polymer, and carrying out membrane treatment and alkali treatment processes to obtain the anion exchange membrane. By introducing the high-rigidity hydrophobic linear monomer with strong bond energy, the problem of mutual entanglement between linear main chains of a traditional polymer is solved, larger free volume and steric hindrance are provided, and high ionic conductivity and high alkali stability of the anion exchange membrane are realized; therefore, the water electrolysis performance of the anion exchange membrane electrolytic tank is further improved, and high-performance and high-stability electrolytic tank application is realized.

Title: Intelligent AEM electrolytic bath control system
Abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent AEM electrolytic bath control system. The system is specifically characterized in that the power generation power of a hydrogen production power supply system, the first operation power interval of an anion exchange membrane AEM electrolytic bath and the second operation power interval of an alkaline electrolytic bath are obtained; based on the generated power, the first operation power interval and the second operation power interval, the actual operation power of the AEM electrolytic cell is controlled; by analyzing the operation strategy of the hydrogen production system, on the basis of the power generation power of the hydrogen production power supply system, the first operation power interval of the AEM electrolytic cell and the second operation power interval of the alkaline electrolytic cell, the start-stop state and the actual operation power of the alkaline electrolytic cell and the AEM electrolytic cell are controlled, and the operation efficiency, reliability and response rate of the hydrogen production system can be improved.
Applicants: ZHEJIANG YIFU HYDROGEN ENERGY EQUIPMENT CO LTD

Title: Resource recycling method and application of spinel type positive electrode material of waste secondary battery
Abstract: The invention discloses a resource recycling method for a spinel type positive electrode material of a waste secondary battery and an anion exchange membrane electrolytic tank. The recycling method comprises the following steps: respectively pretreating a positive electrode material carrier and a negative electrode foil material; dissolving a first metal salt in a first solvent to obtain a metal salt ion electrolyte; dissolving a second metal salt in a second solvent to obtain a metal salt ion solution, adding the pretreated positive electrode material carrier, infiltrating to obtain a positive electrode precursor material, and carrying out heat treatment to obtain a positive electrode material; assembling the negative electrode foil material, the positive electrode material and the metal salt ion electrolyte into a secondary battery, and carrying out electrochemical reaction; disassembling the secondary battery to obtain an electrochemically treated positive electrode material, and carrying out high-temperature cleaning and drying on the obtained positive electrode material by using a third solvent; and stripping the positive electrode material from the carrier to separate the positive electrode material carrier to obtain a positive electrode spinel oxide material and drying. According to the invention, the positive electrode material of the secondary battery can be recycled and used for a new anion exchange membrane electrolytic tank.

Title: CATALYST INK, MEMBRANE-CATALYST LAYER ASSEMBLY, AND CELL STACK
Abstract: This membrane-catalyst layer assembly used in anion exchange membrane-type water electrolysis comprises an anion exchange membrane (51) and an anode catalyst layer (61) in contact with alkaline water. The anode catalyst layer (61) includes a catalyst and a polymer. As the polymer, a polymer or polyolefin neutral in water is used. As a result, the manufacturing cost of the catalyst ink or the membrane-catalyst layer assembly can be reduced as compared with the case in which an expensive polymer having an ionic group is used.

Title: Method capable of reducing concentration of hydrogen in oxygen in anion exchange mode electrolytic cell
Abstract: The invention discloses a bipolar plate and collector plate structure capable of greatly reducing the concentration of hydrogen in oxygen in an anion exchange membrane electrolytic bath, the inner wall surface of a through hole forming a public pipeline on a bipolar plate/collector plate is subjected to insulation treatment, or an insulator and the conductive bipolar plate/collector plate are adopted to form a composite structure; by means of the negative ion exchange membrane electrolytic cell, the concentration of hydrogen in oxygen in the operation process of the negative ion exchange membrane electrolytic cell can be greatly reduced, and therefore the operation safety of the negative ion exchange membrane electrolytic cell is improved. The device has the characteristics of simple structure and low cost, is highly adaptive to the assembly and production process of the conventional anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell, and has remarkable engineering application value.
Applicants: SHANGHAI QINGLUAN TECH CO LTD;;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

Title: Composite anionic membrane for hydrogen production of AEM electrolytic cell and preparation method of composite anionic membrane
Abstract: The invention discloses a composite anionic membrane for hydrogen production of an AEM electrolytic cell and a preparation method of the composite anionic membrane, and relates to a water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane material technology in the field of hydrogen energy. According to the composite anionic membrane, a polyterphenyl polymer without an ether bond skeleton is prepared through super-acid catalytic polymerization, the ratio of p-terphenyl to m-terphenyl is regulated to form an ultramicropore-containing ionomer, and the ultramicropore-containing ionomer is matched with a piperidine ring ion conduction group far away from a polymer main chain and is blended with polybenzimidazole (PBI) to form a homogeneous membrane. The invention solves the technical problems of contradiction between ionic conductivity and dimensional stability, insufficient chemical stability, insufficient mechanical strength and the like of the existing anion exchange membrane (AEM), has the technical effects of high ionic conduction efficiency, good dimensional stability, long alkali-resistant life, excellent mechanical strength and the like, and can meet the long-life use requirement of an AEM electrolytic bath for hydrogen production under pressure.

Title: Self-polymerization microporous ionomer as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a self-polymerized microporous ionomer with the structure shown in the following structural formula (I), the weight-average molecular weight of 7000-70000 and the intrinsic viscosity eta of 1.0-1.5 dL/g, and the self-polymerized microporous ionomer has excellent gas permeability, high conductivity and moderate size swelling ratio, shows excellent battery performance, can be used as an electrode adhesive of a membrane electrode, and can be used for preparing a battery. The method is applied to preparation of a membrane electrode cathode catalyst layer in an anion exchange membrane water electrolyser. Wherein n represents the degree of polymerization and is a positive integer ranging from 10 to 100.

Title: Novel AEM hydrogen production electrolytic cell
Abstract: The invention discloses a novel AEM hydrogen production electrolytic cell which comprises a shell and an anion exchange membrane arranged in the shell, the shell comprises two sub-parts hinged to each other, the two sub-parts are provided with concave grooves, and the two grooves are folded to form a sealed cavity after being rotationally buckled; wherein the two grooves are covered with glands, through grooves are formed in the middles of the glands, when the glands on the two sides are buckled, the through grooves are communicated to form an exchange channel, and the anion exchange membrane is arranged in the exchange channel to divide the cavity into a negative electrode area and a positive electrode area; a negative electrode structure is arranged in the negative electrode area, a positive electrode structure is arranged in the positive electrode area, a communication opening communicated with the outside is formed in the shell, the shell is communicated with the negative electrode area or the positive electrode area on the same side through the communication opening to transmit liquid and gas, and electrode contacts communicated with the negative electrode structure or the positive electrode structure on the same side are further arranged outside the shell. And the electrode contacts are communicated with an external power supply for electrolysis.
Applicants: TIANFU NEW ENERGY RES INSTITUTE;;SICHUAN ENERGY INVESTMENT TIANFU NEW ENERGY RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

Title: Preparation method and application of seawater electrolysis catalyst based on strain engineering
Abstract: The invention belongs to the field of strain engineering materials, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a Mo-doped Fe2O3 HER electrocatalyst and application of the Mo-doped Fe2O3 HER electrocatalyst in large-current seawater electrolysis. The preparation method comprises the following steps: growing Fe2O3 on a self-supporting material through molten salt, soaking (NH4) 6Mo7O24. 4H2O, and calcining to obtain the final Mo-doped Fe2O3 electrocatalyst (2%-Mo-Fe2O3). Under the condition that an anion exchange membrane electrolyzes seawater (electrolyte: 1M KOH seawater, and temperature: 60 DEG C), the current density of 1A/cm < 2 > can be reached only by a working voltage of 2V, and stable operation can be performed for 100 hours under the condition of industrial seawater. Compared with a traditional method for preparing a bifunctional electrocatalyst, the method has the advantages that the problem of slow dynamics in the process of electrolyzing alkaline seawater is solved by utilizing strain engineering, and the catalytic stability can be kept under the condition of high current density while efficient catalysis is ensured; the work provides a strategy for applying strain engineering to preparation of a catalyst for seawater hydrogen production.

Title: Method for synthesizing seawater electrolysis corrosion-resistant anode at room temperature in macroscopic quantity
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of inorganic advanced nano materials, and discloses a method for synthesizing an electrolytic seawater corrosion-resistant anode at room temperature in a macroscopic quantity. A sheet structure is successfully constructed on a current collector through a rapid liquid phase synthesis method, and the sheet structure is subjected to reduction treatment to obtain the iron-doped nickel hydroxide electrocatalyst (V-Ni II-Fe) with oxygen vacancies. The strong Lewis acid Ni < 4 + > generated in the oxygen evolution reaction process has strong selectivity on OH <->, and can effectively resist Cl <-> corrosion. According to the invention, macro synthesis of the electrocatalyst is successfully realized, the alkaline seawater anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell constructed by using the electrocatalyst as the anode can realize long-time stable operation, and the electrocatalyst has important value in future practical application.

Title: Cathode catalyst layer structure for efficient AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production and construction method
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production, and particularly provides a high-efficiency AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production cathode catalyst layer structure and a construction method.The catalyst layer structure comprises a substrate layer, a hydrophilic micropore conducting layer and a cathode catalyst slurry layer which are sequentially arranged, and the substrate layer is a hydrophobic layer; the hydrophilic microporous conductive layer contains a first hydrophilic material and a conductive material, the cathode catalyst slurry layer contains a second hydrophilic material and a catalyst, and the first hydrophilic material and the second hydrophilic material are the same or different. According to the invention, the problem of insufficient water content of the cathode in a mode of only performing single-side liquid feeding of the anode is solved, meanwhile, the transmission of hydrogen generated by the cathode is promoted, and hydrogen with relatively high purity is obtained at the cathode. Compared with an unimproved cathode structure, the cathode structure has lower cell pressure under the same current density, and shows more excellent AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production capacity and stable performance.

Title: Water electrolysis system and control method thereof
Abstract: The present invention discloses a water electrolysis system for increasing the purity of hydrogen generated in an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis stack. According to the present invention, a water electrolysis system comprises: a hydrogen separator for separating hydrogen produced in a water electrolysis stack; a reactor for removing oxygen contained in the hydrogen transferred from the hydrogen separator; a pre-treatment dehumidifier for primary dehumidification of moisture contained in the hydrogen transferred from the reactor; a heat exchanger for cooling the hydrogen that has passed through the pre-treatment dehumidifier; a gas-water separator for separating water from the hydrogen that has passed through the heat exchanger; a dryer for secondary drying of the hydrogen that has passed through the gas-water separator; and a control unit for controlling valves installed in pipelines connecting the reactor, the pre-treatment dehumidifier, the heat exchanger, the gas-water separator, and the dryer, wherein the control unit controls a control valve to bypass the pre-treatment dehumidifier when a moisture value contained in the hydrogen that has passed through the gas-water separator is equal to or less than a set value, and to pass the hydrogen through the pre-treatment dehumidifier to remove moisture before transferring it to the dryer when the moisture value contained in the hydrogen that has passed through the gas-water separator is equal to or greater than the set value.

Title: Catalyst and porous transport electrode for water electrolysis of anion exchange membrane preparation method thereof and use thereof
Abstract: The present invention relates to a catalyst for a negative ion exchange membrane water electrolysis, an electrode comprising the same, a manufacturing method thereof, and uses thereof, wherein the catalyst for the negative ion exchange membrane water electrolysis exhibits a high activity as high as that of a noble metal catalyst by using an inexpensive transition metal, has the advantages of excellent electrical conductivity, including phosphide, and excellent thermal stability, and can optimize water electrolysis cell performance by controlling the porosity of the nickel foam.

Title: Preparation method of AEM water electrolysis anode catalyst
Abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of an AEM water electrolysis anode catalyst, which belongs to the anion exchange membrane water electrolysis technology and comprises the following steps: selecting foam iron, removing oil from the foam iron, and cleaning the foam iron after oil removal of the foam iron is completed; s2, 2mL of Ni-P chemical plating solution is prepared, the pH value ranges from 6.0 to 8.0, and the temperature is usually controlled to range from 80 DEG C to 95 DEG C; s3, after the Ni-P chemical plating solution in the S2 is prepared, 1 g of vulcanxc-72 carbon black powder is added into the chemical plating solution of the Ni-P chemical plating solution; the cleaned foam iron is added into 40 mL of a NaBH4 solution with the concentration being 0.2 mol/L, meanwhile, 2 mL of a prepared Ni-P chemical plating solution is added, a reaction is conducted for 30 min, and the non-noble metal oxygen evolution catalyst is obtained, the catalyst improves the water electrolysis catalytic efficiency and catalytic stability, and it is proved that the catalytic efficiency of the catalyst is good if the current is large by detecting the current under the constant voltage; if the change of the electrochemical active area is small, the catalysis has certain stability.
Applicants: WUXI GUQING NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

Title: Ion exchange membrane, preparation method thereof and water electrolysis hydrogen production device
Abstract: The invention relates to an ion exchange membrane, a preparation method thereof and a water electrolysis hydrogen production device, and aims to solve the technical problem that the stability of an anion exchange group of a related anion exchange membrane is relatively low. The ion exchange membrane and the preparation method thereof provided by the invention comprise the following steps: dissolving meta-PBI in a solvent to obtain a first mixed solution; adding methyl iodide into the first mixed solution to react and generate a precipitate; carrying out purification treatment on the precipitate, so as to obtain Meta-PBI subjected to iodomethanation; dissolving the mixed solution in a dimethyl sulfoxide solution, and adding dibromo-p-xylene to obtain a second mixed solution; and carrying out evaporation treatment on the second mixed solution under a vacuum condition to obtain the ion exchange membrane. The ion exchange membrane containing the 2-phenylbenzimidazole system is prepared, and 2-phenylbenzimidazole ions are used as anion exchange groups with stable resonance, so that the ion exchange membrane can stably exist in a water electrolysis hydrogen production system.
Applicants: CNPC SHENZHEN NEW ENERGY RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;;PETROCHINA CO LTD;;XINJIANG HUANQIU CONTRACTING & ENG CO LTD

Title: High-entropy alloy electrocatalyst with core-shell structure as well as preparation method and application of high-entropy alloy electrocatalyst
Abstract: The invention discloses a high-entropy alloy electrocatalyst with a core-shell structure and a preparation method and application of the high-entropy alloy electrocatalyst with the core-shell structure, the catalyst is synthesized through a two-step method, and the stable and efficient core-shell structure is formed after reconstruction. The invention further discloses cloud application of the high-entropy alloy with the core-shell structure in an oxygen evolution reaction and an anode catalyst layer of an anion exchange membrane water electrolyser. The core-shell structure catalyst constructed by the invention has the characteristics of ultra-stability and high activity, and the performance of the core-shell structure catalyst is superior to that of commercial noble metal RuO2 and other quaternary high-entropy alloy, ternary medium-entropy alloy and binary alloy contrast sample materials.

Title: PHASE INVERSION TECHNIQUES IN MEMBRANE ELECTRODE ASSEMBLY MANUFACTURE AND RELATED METHODS
Abstract: The present invention is related to the field of membrane electrode assembly manufacture. It provides a method for true zero-gap membrane electrode assembly, comprising casting an electrode slurry onto an electrode separator slurry or an electrode separator to form a combination (100), followed by a phase inversion step that induces the formation of the membrane electrode assembly in situ (102). The electrode separator can be a polymeric, polymer-inorganic composite, cation exchange, anion exchange, bipolar or amphoteric membrane. The electrode slurry may include an anode or cathode slurry, and can contain a catalyst, binder, or conductive material. The phase inversion step involves exposing the combination to a non-solvent, such as water or alcohols, at temperatures ranging from about -10 °C to about 100 °C.

Title: Double-effect exchange membrane for water electrolysis and fuel cell and preparation method of double-effect exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention belongs to the field of fuel cells and water electrolysis membrane materials, and relates to a double-effect exchange membrane for water electrolysis and fuel cells and a preparation method of the double-effect exchange membrane. The specific structure of the double-effect polymer exchange membrane can adsorb OH <-> or protons, the capacity of conducting OH <-> or protons is obtained, and a proton exchange membrane or an anion exchange membrane is prepared; the main chain of the double-effect exchange membrane is a quaternized aryl pyridine polymer, so that the double-effect exchange membrane has excellent acid and alkali resistance stability, and the synthesis method and process are simple; a multi-layer structure is arranged in the membrane, imidazole functionalized graphene oxide in different proportions is distributed in different layer structures, graphene in the middle layer is less in distribution, high mechanical strength can be provided, a large number of graphene functional layers are sprayed on the two sides, the number of functional groups in the membrane and the number of impregnated acid or alkali can be increased, and the ionic conductivity is effectively improved; the double-effect exchange membrane prepared by the invention can be applied to water electrolysis and used as a polymer diaphragm in a fuel cell.

Title: CELL STACK AND HYDROGEN PRODUCTION DEVICE
Abstract: A cell stack according to the present invention is to be provided to a hydrogen production device and comprises: a layered body that includes a plurality of electrolysis cells; a first end plate and a second end plate that are provided on respective sides of the layered body; and a fastening mechanism that fastens the first end plate and the second end plate toward each other. The fastening mechanism has an elastic member that presses the first end plate toward the second end plate. Each of the plurality of electrolysis cells has: an anode, anion exchange membrane, and cathode set; and separators that are provided on respective sides of the set. The separators have an electroconductive plate and a frame body that supports an outer peripheral edge part of the electroconductive plate. The frame body is made of resin.

Title: High-entropy alloy electrolytic water catalytic hydrogen evolution material and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a high-entropy alloy water electrolysis hydrogen evolution catalytic material and a preparation method thereof. The catalytic material comprises a conductive substrate material and a high-entropy alloy film deposited on the surface of the conductive substrate material, the chemical formula of the high-entropy alloy film is (FeCoNiCr) 100-xPtx based on the mole percentage of each atom, and x is greater than or equal to 10 and less than or equal to 40. The preparation method comprises the following steps: weighing raw materials of iron, cobalt, nickel, chromium and platinum according to the mole percentage content of each atom, and preparing a master alloy ingot by using a vacuum arc melting method; taking the master alloy ingot as a target material, depositing on a substrate through a pulse laser deposition method to obtain a high-entropy alloy film, and then performing electrochemical treatment to obtain the high-entropy alloy film. The material is low in cost, high in efficiency, high in stability and high in controllability, the high-entropy alloy film electrolytic water hydrogen evolution catalytic material which is excellent in catalytic efficiency and high in applicability is obtained by optimizing the deposition process and reasonably controlling electrochemical treatment conditions, and the high-entropy alloy film electrolytic water hydrogen evolution catalytic material is good in operation stability in an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell.

Title: Method and device for desulfurizing and producing hydrogen by electrolyzing hydrogen sulfide under photovoltaic driving
Abstract: The invention provides a method and a device for producing hydrogen by electrolyzing hydrogen sulfide through photovoltaic driving, and belongs to the fields of low-carbon green acid gas purification technology, environmental protection and renewable energy sources. The system provides electric energy through renewable energy sources, H2S gas enters an electrolytic bath after entering an alkali liquor bottle to be absorbed, the electrolytic bath electrolyzes a sulfur-containing alkaline aqueous solution to obtain hydrogen and polysulfide, and the hydrogen and the polysulfide are acidified and purified through a sulfur recovery tank and a sulfur refining tank. Hydroxyl radicals are generated while hydrogen is generated at the cathode through the AEM electrolytic cell, the hydroxyl radicals are migrated to the anode chamber through the anion exchange membrane and enter the alkali liquor bottle under circulation of the pump for hydrogen sulfide absorption, and the problems that hydrogen sulfide is continuously absorbed by continuously adding alkali liquor, and secondary separation of products is needed are solved; the invention also provides an AEM hydrogen sulfide electrolysis desulfurization hydrogen production device.

Title: Double-effect membrane electrode for water electrolysis and fuel cell and preparation method of double-effect membrane electrode
Abstract: The invention belongs to the field of fuel cells, water electrolysis membrane materials and membrane electrode materials, and relates to a double-effect membrane electrode for water electrolysis and fuel cells and a preparation method. The double-effect membrane electrode comprises a double-effect polymer exchange membrane and double-effect catalyst layers on the two sides, the specific structure in the double-effect polymer membrane can adsorb OH <-> or protons, the capacity of conducting OH <-> or protons is obtained, and a proton exchange membrane or an anion exchange membrane is prepared; the main chain of the double-effect exchange membrane is a quaternized aryl pyridine polymer, so that the double-effect exchange membrane has excellent acid and alkali resistance stability, and the synthesis method and process are simple; secondly, two sides of the double-effect polymer membrane are respectively coated with a double-effect membrane electrode catalyst layer, and a three-dimensional resin material which is the same as that of the double-effect polymer membrane is adopted in catalyst slurry of the catalyst layers, so that interface resistance can be effectively reduced, a catalyst is assisted to conduct ions, and higher water electrolysis or fuel cell performance is further obtained; the prepared double-effect membrane electrode can be applied to water electrolysis and fuel cells.

Title: Alkali-resistant and oxidation-resistant anion exchange resin and application thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to alkali-resistant and oxidation-resistant anion exchange resin, the resin has a structural unit of the following general formula, the structure comprises a polymer of an alkaline stable piperidine monomer and an aromatic monomer with larger steric hindrance and an electron-donating group, and comprises a polymer of a tetramethyl piperidine monomer and an aromatic monomer with an oxidation-resistant characteristic; the polymer resin has excellent alkali resistance and oxidation resistance stability, has high anion conductivity and mechanical stability, is a good anion exchange membrane material, and can be widely applied to the fields of water electrolysis hydrogen production, fuel cells, flow cells, electrodialysis and the like. # imgabs0 #
Applicants: SUQIAN SHIDAI ENERGY STORAGE TECH CO LTD

Title: Ordered array membrane electrode and preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to the field of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production, in particular to a preparation method and application of an ordered array membrane electrode. The ordered array membrane electrode comprises a membrane and a catalyst layer, at least one side of the film is provided with grooves arranged in an array mode, and the catalyst layer covers the at least one side, provided with the grooves, of the film and fills the grooves; the catalyst layer comprises a catalyst and an ionomer; the degree of swelling of the membrane is less than the degree of swelling of the ionomer in the catalyst layer. According to the obtained ordered array membrane electrode, the interface interlocking effect is caused by the swelling degree difference of the membrane-ionomer, the interface bonding strength of the membrane electrode is enhanced, the surface area of the catalyst layer is increased, water transmission in the membrane electrode is enhanced, and the pure water electrolysis performance and durability of the anion exchange membrane are improved.

Title: Electrolytic water self-supporting catalytic material based on electrostatic adsorption as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses an electrolytic water self-supporting catalytic material based on electrostatic adsorption and a preparation method and application, and belongs to the technical field of catalytic materials.The self-supporting catalytic material comprises a self-supporting substrate and a nickel-molybdenum catalyst layer loaded on the surface of the self-supporting substrate; and non-noble metal active metal elements are introduced into the nickel-molybdenum catalyst layer through electrostatic adsorption, so that a highly-oriented metal crystal face structure is formed. The self-supporting catalytic material has excellent performance in an anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water test, has excellent stability and long service life by constructing a stable crystal face, and solves the problems of low activity, poor stability and the like of an existing non-noble metal hydrogen evolution catalytic material in anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water.

Title: Multi-stage mixed electrolytic hydrogen production system and electrolytic hydrogen production method
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of new energy, and discloses a multi-stage mixed electrolytic hydrogen production system and an electrolytic hydrogen production method.The multi-stage mixed electrolytic hydrogen production system comprises a first-stage electrolytic tank electric pile and a second-stage electrolytic tank electric pile; the primary electrolytic tank electric pile is any one of a high-temperature proton conductor electrolytic tank electric pile, a low-temperature proton exchange membrane electrolytic tank electric pile, a low-temperature alkaline electrolytic tank electric pile and a low-temperature anion exchange membrane electrolytic tank electric pile; the secondary electrolytic tank electric pile is a high-temperature oxygen ion conductor electrolytic electric pile; the cathode side of the first-stage electrolytic cell stack is communicated with the cathode side of the second-stage electrolytic cell stack in series, and hydrogen generated by electrochemical reaction of the first-stage electrolytic cell stack can be conveyed to the cathode side of the second-stage electrolytic cell stack. According to the multi-stage mixed electrolytic hydrogen production system, the working efficiency and durability of the high-temperature oxygen ion conductor electrolytic galvanic pile are improved, the service life of the high-temperature oxygen ion conductor electrolytic galvanic pile is prolonged, the complexity and production cost of the multi-stage mixed electrolytic hydrogen production system are reduced, power consumption caused by a circulating pump is avoided, and the hydrogen production efficiency is improved.
Applicants: SHANDONG GUOCHUANG FUEL CELL TECH INNOVATION CENTER CO LTD

Title: Anion exchange membrane for alkaline water electrolysis and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The present invention is to manufacture a blend film of a novel poly(1-butyl-3-vinylimidazolium halide-co-styrene) copolymer (PIS) and polyvinyl alcohol (PVA), and the manufactured blend film of the novel imidazolium-based ion conductive polymer (PIS) and PVA exhibits excellent thermal stability, OH-ion conductivity, hydration properties and water electrolysis performance, etc., thereby being able to be applied as a negative ionic exchange membrane for alkaline water electrolysis.

Title: Preparation method and application of branched polyaryl piperidine membrane containing multiple aromatic ring units
Abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a branched polyaryl piperidine membrane containing multiple aromatic ring units, and belongs to the technical field of fuel cells and water electrolysis hydrogen production anion exchange membranes. According to the invention, a branched polyarylpiperidine main chain is constructed by introducing a multi-aromatic ring branched unit with multiple reaction sites into a conventional linear polyarylpiperidine main chain, so that the bulk density of the main chain is reduced, formation of ion clusters is facilitated, and the conductivity of the membrane is improved. And the branching degree can be regulated and controlled by flexibly adjusting the feeding of the multi-aromatic-ring branched monomer. The conductivity of the branched polyaryl piperidine membrane is increased by more than 26% compared with that of a linear membrane, and the branched membrane has a lower swelling ratio and higher hydrogen-oxygen fuel cell power density and water electrolysis hydrogen production performance.

Title: Preparation method and application of self-supporting B-doped NiFe LDHs oxygen evolution electrode
Abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of a self-supporting B-doped NiFe LDHs oxygen evolution electrode, and belongs to the field of hydrogen production by alkaline electrolysis of water. According to the electrode, foamed nickel serves as a substrate, the substrate is loaded with B-doped NiFe LDHs serving as a catalytic active component, the morphology of the B-doped NiFe LDHs is that a plurality of porous nanometer flower ball structures which are formed by arranging and stacking nanosheets in a staggered mode grow on the foamed nickel substrate, and the diameter of each nanometer flower ball is 500 nm to 2 microns. According to the preparation method, the B-doped NiFe LDHs OER electrode directly and vertically grown on the foamed nickel substrate is obtained through a simple one-step impregnation method, the morphology of a synthetic catalyst can be effectively controlled under a mild condition, and the B-doped NiFe LDHs OER electrode has good catalytic activity and stability. The invention can be applied to renewable fuel cells, photoelectrocatalysis, alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water, seawater electrolysis and electrolytic hydrogen generator devices.

Title: ALKALINE-WATER ELECTROLYSIS MEMBRANE, PRODUCTION METHOD THEREOF, AND MEMBRANE ELECTRODE ASSEMBLY
Abstract: To provide an alkaline-water electrolysis membrane with low swelling and high stress resistance in a peripheral region and a method for producing the same.SOLUTION: A membrane for alkaline water electrolysis in the present disclosure includes a polymer containing an ion-exchangeable anion and has a first region and a second region surrounding the first region. A polymer composing the first region comprises a hydroxide ion as an anion, and a polymer composing the second region comprises virtually no hydroxide ion. The membrane for alkaline water electrolysis can be manufactured by substituting hydroxide ions contained in the peripheral region of the anion exchange membrane with anions other than hydroxide ions by ion exchange.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

Title: Method for preparing AEM water electrolysis anode and application
Abstract: The invention provides a method for preparing an AEM water electrolysis anode and application of the AEM water electrolysis anode. The method comprises the following steps: (1) mixing a ruthenium chloride trihydrate solution with a solvent, and shearing to obtain a dispersion solution; and (2) carrying out hydrothermal reaction on the dispersion solution obtained in the step (1) and foamed nickel, carrying out primary drying to obtain a precursor material, then coating the surface of the precursor material with an anion exchange membrane ionomer, and carrying out secondary drying to obtain the AEM water electrolysis anode. By loading the ruthenium dioxide catalyst on the positive electrode of the foamed nickel electrode in situ, the AEM water electrolysis positive electrode can be directly prepared, the preparation method is simple, and the material utilization rate is high.
Applicants: HUIZHOU EVE HYDROGEN ENERGY CO LTD

Title: Nickel iron molybdate oxygen evolution catalytic electrode and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a nickel iron molybdate oxygen evolution catalytic electrode and a preparation method thereof.The preparation method comprises the following steps that the surface of a foamed nickel sheet is cleaned and dried, and a clean oil-free foamed nickel sheet is obtained; dissolving nickel nitrate, ferric nitrate and ammonium heptamolybdate in deionized water to obtain dispersion liquid; transferring the dispersion liquid into a hydrothermal kettle, putting a foamed nickel sheet into the hydrothermal kettle, carrying out hydrothermal treatment in a drying oven, naturally cooling, washing and drying to obtain foamed nickel loaded with nickel molybdate and iron molybdate catalysts; and preparing an ionomer solution, spraying the ionomer solution onto the electrode precursor, and drying to obtain the oxygen evolution catalytic electrode. The invention provides a preparation scheme of the anion exchange membrane water electrolysis oxygen evolution catalytic electrode which is simple in preparation method, low in synthesis cost, non-toxic and harmless, and the catalyst in the electrode has a microstructure different from that of a common molybdate catalyst and has high electrochemical catalytic activity. The electrolytic bath based on the catalytic electrode can efficiently electrolyze dilute alkali liquor to produce hydrogen, and the energy consumption and the safety of the electrolytic bath are superior to those of a traditional alkaline water electrolysis system.

Title: Multi-energy combined supply system based on biomass gas driving and working method
Abstract: According to the multi-energy combined supply system based on biomass gas driving and the working method, biomass gas serves as fuel, a solid oxide fuel cell and a gas turbine serve as prime movers, and high-temperature waste heat, medium-temperature waste heat and low-temperature waste heat are recycled through a multi-effect distillation subsystem, a refrigeration subsystem and a heat supply subsystem; cascade utilization of energy and zero carbon emission are achieved, the absorption capacity of residual electricity can be effectively improved through the anion exchange membrane by means of hydrogen production through water electrolysis, and therefore multi-energy combined supply of cold, heat, electricity, hydrogen, oxygen and pure water (fresh water) is achieved.

Title: POROUS TRANSPORT LAYER AND METHOD FOR PREPARING THE SAME
Abstract: The present invention provides a porous transport layer having excellent transfer capability for gaseous and liquid substances and a wide contact area with a catalyst layer, and a method for preparing the same. The porous transport layer includes a nickel foam, and has a contact area ratio according to Equation 1 of 27.00% to 92.00%, wherein Equation 1 is contact area ratio (%) = (B/A) x 100, and in Equation 1, A is a total surface area (m^2) of the porous transport layer on the side where the porous transport layer contacts the electrode, and B is an actual contact area (m^2) between the porous transport layer and the electrode. The present invention can significantly improve performance when applied to an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis system.

Title: High surface area anode catalyst for AEM electrolysis cell
Abstract: A novel catalyst layer composition and anion exchange membrane (AEM) cell structure characterized by having open-cell mesoporous particles that provide a high surface area and an electrically conductive support for an anode catalyst is disclosed. The composition includes a low conductivity catalyst grown on the mesoporous particles by a deposition process, or mixed with the mesoporous particles and adsorbed. The AEM cell structure includes the catalyst layer composition as well as a cathode side including a bipolar plate or half-plate, a porous transport layer and a catalyst layer and an anode side similarly equipped but having a mesoporous layer formed from the catalyst composition. And the two sides are separated by anion exchange membranes. Also disclosed are methods of making the AEM cell structure using a spray process and a decal process, improving the efficiency and safety of producing hydrogen and oxygen.

Title: Anion exchange membrane AEM electrolytic bath with asymmetric structure
Abstract: The invention provides an anionic membrane AEM electrolytic bath with an asymmetric structure, and belongs to the field of structural design of alkaline membrane electrolytic baths. The anode side of the electrolytic cell adopts a rigid net as a gas diffusion layer, and the cathode side adopts an elastic net as a gas diffusion layer. According to the electrolytic cell, the asymmetric rigid net and the elastic net are adopted as gas diffusion layers, and a groove flow channel structure is omitted, so that on one hand, the porosity in the electrolytic cell can be increased, a larger flow channel area is provided, the gas-liquid two-phase fluid mass transfer resistance is reduced while the contact area of an electrode of the electrolytic cell and liquid is increased, and bubble discharge is facilitated; the processing and assembling difficulty is reduced; on the other hand, due to the existence of the cathode side elastic net, the assembly reliability can be improved, the sealing problem is solved, the membrane electrode and the bipolar plate are in full contact, the hydrogen bubble generation position is uniform, and the contact resistance is reduced; finally, the rigid net on the anode side can serve as a supporting part and provide larger porosity, and mass transfer resistance is further reduced.
Applicants: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;;SINOPEC BEIJING CHEMICAL RESEARCH INST CO LTD

Title: Method for preparing high-performance AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane electrode
Abstract: The invention discloses a method for preparing a high-performance AEM water-electrolyzed hydrogen production membrane electrode, which comprises the following steps: respectively preparing an AEM water-electrolyzed hydrogen production anode and an AEM water-electrolyzed hydrogen production membrane cathode, then placing the AEM water-electrolyzed hydrogen production anode and the AEM water-electrolyzed hydrogen production cathode on two sides of an anion exchange membrane, and sealing edges to prepare the AEM water-electrolyzed hydrogen production membrane electrode, the preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing catalyst powder with a solvent to prepare catalyst prefabricated slurry, adding an anion exchange resin solution in batches, adding a hydrophobic binder to prepare catalyst slurry, coating the surface of a hydrophobic modified diffusion layer with the slurry, and finally coating the surface of the diffusion layer with the anion exchange resin solution to prepare the hydrophobic modified diffusion layer. And soaking in an organic solvent, and washing. According to the prepared AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane electrode, on the basis that oxygen bubble retention can be reduced, the stability is improved, and meanwhile the activity of the membrane electrode is improved.
Applicants: JIANGSU BOYUAN CATALYTIC TECH CO LTD;;JIANGSU LOPAL TECH GROUP CO LTD

Title: Long-range disordered localized CoOOH ultrathin nanosheet electrocatalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrocatalyst material preparation, and discloses a long-range disordered localized CoOOH ultrathin nanosheet electrocatalyst as well as a preparation method and application thereof, fluorine-doped cobalt selenide nanobelts prepared by a low-temperature annealing method are used as a base material, and the CoOOH ultrathin nanosheet electrocatalyst is prepared by in-situ reconstruction under an alkaline electrolyzed water anode oxygen evolution reaction condition. In the preparation process of the CoOOH ultrathin nanosheet provided by the invention, lattice cobalt is stabilized in the water electrolysis anode reconstruction process through fluorine ions with strong bonding action with cobalt ions, so that the long-range disordered structure of amorphous CoOOH generated after reconstruction is limited by localization, and the alkaline water electrolysis anode reaction performance is improved. The catalyst has activity and durability obviously superior to those of a commercial ruthenium oxide catalyst in industrial application of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production.

Title: Oxygen vacancy mediated Ru/Ni (OH) 2-x based on hydrogen overflow and preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to the field of seawater electrolysis hydrogen production, and discloses an oxygen vacancy mediated Ru/Ni (OH) 2-x based on hydrogen overflow and a preparation method and application thereof. And carrying out anhydrous RuCl3 modification treatment on the Ni/(OH) 2-x with the nanosheet morphology to obtain the hydrogen reduction electrocatalyst (Ru/Ni (OH) 2-x) with defects and noble metal/Ni-based catalyst heterojunction. Wherein the Ru phase is introduced, so that the electronic structure between the two phases can be adjusted, and more oxygen vacancies can be easily generated in the Ni (OH) 2-x phase. Oxygen vacancies generated through H2O2 heterostructure induction further promote electron transfer between Ru and Ni (OH) 2-x, the adsorption behavior of an element reaction intermediate in HER on the catalyst is improved, the hydrogen overflow effect is successfully achieved, and the intrinsic HER activity of the catalyst is improved. When being used as an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell, the anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell can stably electrolyze seawater for hydrogen production for a long time, and has important value in future practical application.

Title: CATALYST INK USABLE WITH A DOCTOR BLADE AND HAVING A HIGH SOLIDS PROPORTION
Abstract: The invention relates to a catalyst ink, to a method for coating substrates with said ink, to the coated substrates obtained using the method, and to the use thereof. It addresses the problem of providing a catalyst ink which has a high solids content and at the same time can still be easily used with a doctor blade. As far as possible, the catalyst ink should not contain any solvents which are known to be carcinogenic, mutagenic or toxic to reproduction. The coated substrates produced using the catalyst ink should be usable, in particular, in alkaline membrane water electrolysis as a catalytically active or activatable anion exchange membrane. This problem is solved by a solvent mixture containing alkanol and acetonitrile. The improvement consists in that both the proportion by weight of the acetonitrile and also the proportion by weight of the alkanol are each greater than the proportion by weight of the binder contained in the catalyst ink.

Title: PdH (at) Ru nanorod as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of catalysts, and particularly relates to a PdH (at) Ru nanorod and a preparation method and application thereof. The PdH-Ru nanorod provided by the invention can expose more catalytic active sites due to the special morphology, the hollow bamboo joint structure can promote the collision probability of reaction molecules and promote the optimization of the reaction kinetic reaction rate, the one-dimensional structure also has higher proton and electron transmission capability, and the dual HER active components in the Ru shell layer and the PdH core have a synergistic effect, so that the catalytic activity of the PdH-Ru nanorod is improved. And finally, the catalytic performance is improved, so that the cathode of the anion exchange membrane water electrolysis device shows relatively high catalytic activity.

Title: Rare earth element doped nickel-iron alloy material as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: According to the preparation method of the rare earth element doped ferro-nickel alloy material, a mixed solution containing ferric salt, nickel salt, rare earth salt and sodium chloride serves as a deposition solution, a conductive substrate serves as a cathode, and the rare earth element doped ferro-nickel alloy material is prepared through an electrochemical deposition method. According to the invention, the preparation of the short-range ordered lanthanide atom doped nickel-iron alloy material can be realized by introducing the lanthanide metal element of which the atomic radius is larger than that of the nickel-iron atom, and the alloy material is used as an anode of an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell; excellent water electrolysis performance can be shown, and long-term stable operation can be kept under industrial-grade large current density; in addition, the disorder degree can be accurately regulated and controlled by regulating and controlling the doping amount of lanthanide atoms, the electrocatalytic activity of the alloy material is further improved, and the stability of the alloy material is improved.

Title: ELECTROLYSIS SYSTEM
Abstract: The present invention relates to an electrolysis system comprising: an electrolysis stack in which a plurality of electrolysis cells having a cathode electrode and an anode electrode are stacked on both sides of an anion exchange membrane; and an alkaline solution supply device for supplying an alkaline solution to the anode electrode, and generating hydrogen from the cathode electrode by supplying current to the cathode electrode and the anode electrode. The electrolysis system of the present invention further comprises: a condenser which is arranged downstream of a separation tank and condenses a material on a gas containing hydrogen discharged from the separation tank so as to freeze moisture; a separation tank which is arranged upstream of the condenser such that a component other than hydrogen frozen in the condenser is introduced and accommodated, to which a material containing hydrogen discharged from the electrolysis stack is introduced such that impurities contained in the introduced material are separated from hydrogen and accommodated, and which is configured to leak hydrogen to the condenser; and a dehumidifying device which is arranged downstream of the condenser and allows a material for adsorbing moisture to be arranged on a path through which the material on the gas containing hydrogen discharged from the condenser passes so as to remove moisture from the material on the gas.

Title: Nickel-molybdenum alloy catalyst with three-dimensional component gradient and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a nickel-molybdenum alloy catalyst with three-dimensional component gradient and a preparation method thereof, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: 1) taking foamed nickel as a substrate, cleaning and airing; 2) adding deionized water into nickel salt and molybdate until the volume is 1 L, performing ultrasonic treatment, stirring, and adjusting the pH value to obtain a precursor solution; (3) soaking the substrate obtained in the step (1) into the precursor solution, and carrying out hydrothermal reaction; naturally cooling, washing and drying; a precursor material is obtained; and 4) heating the precursor material to 400-600 DEG C in a reducing atmosphere, and keeping the temperature for 2-3 hours to obtain the nickel-molybdenum alloy catalyst with three-dimensional component gradient. The catalyst provided by the invention shows ultralow overpotential and excellent dynamics in an alkaline hydrogen evolution reaction, and realizes industrial-grade current density and long-term stability in an alkaline anion exchange membrane water electrolyser.

Title: Heterojunction nano-catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention provides a heterojunction nano-catalyst. The heterojunction nano-catalyst comprises a foamed nickel carrier and a double-metal hydroxide, wherein the double-metal hydroxide and the surface of foamed nickel form a heterostructure; the surface of the foamed nickel is provided with a defect-rich NiSx nano structure; the bimetallic hydroxide is doped with metal atoms except bimetallic elements in the bimetallic hydroxide, and the metal elements in the bimetallic hydroxide are selected from two of transition metal elements Ni, Fe and Co. The invention further provides the heterojunction nano-catalyst and an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell. The heterojunction nano-catalyst provided by the invention has excellent activity and long-period stability under high current density.
Applicants: UNIV CHINA PETROLEUM BEIJING;;SHAANXI COAL CHEMICAL IND TECH RES INST CO LTD

Title: Preparation method and application of Pt-N-C catalyst with N atomic ratio of pyridine to pyrrole being 1/1
Abstract: The invention aims at providing a preparation method and application of a Pt-N-C catalyst with the N atomic ratio of pyridine to pyrrole being 1/1, and belongs to the technical field of electro-catalytic materials and alkaline electrolytic water hydrogen production. ZIF-8 and ZIF-67 serve as precursors, the proportion of Zn/Co is adjusted, then pyrolysis is conducted at the temperature of 920 DEG C in the H2/Ar atmosphere, the reaction that H2 and C are hydrogenated into methane at the high temperature is utilized, and the Pt-N-C catalyst with the N atomic ratio of pyridine to pyrrole being 1/1 is obtained. According to the method, pyrrole N (N5) and pyridine N (N6) are used as raw materials, carbon ring reconstruction is catalyzed by means of Co nanoparticles (Con) generated in situ, the proportion of pyrrole N (N5) to pyridine N (N6) is close to 1: 1, Pt single atoms are anchored through N coordination, and the Con-Pt1 (at) N [5]/[6] C catalyst is prepared. The catalyst has high activity and high stability, the overpotential is as low as 17 mV and is superior to that of commercial Pt/C, and the catalyst can stably run for 400 hours under the conditions of 70 DEG C and 1A/cm in an anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer (AEMWE).

Title: Cationic COF-doped AEM electrode and preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to a cationic COF-doped AEM electrode and a preparation method and application thereof.The preparation method comprises the steps that a covalent organic framework material (COF) which is small in particle size, good in alkali stability and rich in cationic groups is adopted as filler and is blended with a cathode catalyst and an ionomer through ultrasonic dispersion, and cathode catalyst slurry is prepared; and preparing the anion exchange membrane electrode with uniform COF dispersion and excellent performance by adopting a catalyst coating membrane technology or a catalyst coating substrate technology, and applying the anion exchange membrane electrode to the field of water electrolysis hydrogen production. A regular one-dimensional pore channel of the cationic covalent organic framework can provide a rapid transmission channel for gas-liquid transmission, and abundant cationic groups are beneficial to formation of a high-efficiency hydroxyl ion conduction channel, so that the mass transfer efficiency of gas, liquid and ions is remarkably improved, a three-phase reaction interface of a catalyst, gas and water is optimized, and the catalytic activity of the catalyst is improved. Therefore, the overall electrolytic hydrogen production performance is improved.

Title: ELECTROLYTIC HYDROGEN PRODUCTION SYSTEM COUPLED WITH CAPTURING CARBON DIOXIDE FROM FLUE GAS
Abstract: An electrolytic hydrogen production system coupled with capturing carbon dioxide from flue gas. The system comprises an absorption device (1), an electrolytic hydrogen production device (2), a first gas-liquid separation device (3) and a second gas-liquid separation device (4). The electrolytic hydrogen production device (2) comprises an anode chamber (21), an intermediate chamber (22) and a cathode chamber (23), which are separated by anion exchange membranes (24). In addition, the present invention further relates to a method for using the electrolytic hydrogen production system coupled with capturing carbon dioxide from flue gas. The method comprises: absorbing carbon dioxide from flue gas by using the absorption device (1); allowing the obtained absorption liquid to enter the anode chamber (21), so as to obtain a carbon-dioxide-containing gas-liquid mixture; allowing the gas-liquid mixture to enter the first gas-liquid separation device (3) to undergo separation, so as to obtain carbon dioxide and a first separation liquid; allowing the first separation liquid to enter the intermediate chamber (22), so as to realize the regeneration of the absorbent under the action of ion exchange; and returning the regenerated absorbent to the absorption device (1) again to continue the absorption of carbon dioxide.

Title: Anode porous transmission layer for electrolyzed water as well as preparation method and application of anode porous transmission layer
Abstract: The invention relates to an anode porous transmission layer for water electrolysis and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: providing a nickel substrate; cleaning the nickel substrate, drying and collecting; taking nickel salt, ferric salt, boric acid and ammonium chloride, and adding pure water to prepare electroplating liquid; hydrochloric acid is dropwise added into the electroplating solution, and the pH value is adjusted; a two-electrode electrolytic bath system is adopted, the dried nickel substrate is immersed in the electroplating liquid with the adjusted pH value for electroplating, and the modified anode porous transmission layer is obtained through aftertreatment. The broccoli-shaped structure containing nickel and iron elementary substances and alloy is formed on the surface of the modified substrate, so that the conductivity, the electrochemical stability and the interface transmission efficiency are remarkably improved, the catalyst loading is more uniform and firmer, reactant transmission and bubble escape are smooth, the contact resistance is reduced, and the service life is prolonged. The anode PTL material shows excellent electrocatalytic oxygen evolution performance in alkaline or anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production, the hydrogen production energy consumption and cost are effectively reduced, and the technical problems of an existing anode PTL material and a modification method are solved.

Title: AEMWE cathode electrode material under large current density and macro preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention provides an AEMWE cathode electrode material and a preparation method thereof. The AEMWE cathode electrode material provided by the invention comprises a metal foam substrate, a transition metal hydroxide formed on the surface of the metal foam substrate, and a modified metal nanosheet array deposited on the surface of the metal hydroxide. Wherein the metal hydroxide in the middle layer can promote proton coupling electron transfer, induce metastable lattice distortion and promote formation of lattice dislocation/twin crystal/twisted crystal boundaries. Meanwhile, through the multi-field coupling effect of an electric field or an electric field and a magnetic field, controllable growth of nanosheets is achieved, the hydrogen evolution performance is effectively improved, the charge transfer resistance is greatly reduced, and the hydrogen evolution performance and long-period stability of the catalytic material under the conditions of large current density and industrialization are achieved. According to the AEMWE scheme provided by the invention, AEMWE water electrolysis hydrogen production under high current density can be realized only by 1.8 V, and stable operation exceeds 1000 hours.

Title: Method for producing hydrogen through electrolysis of water vapor
Abstract: The invention relates to the field of hydrogen production through water electrolysis, and discloses a method for producing hydrogen through electrolysis of water vapor. The method comprises: under theaction of direct current, carrying out a reduction reaction on a cathode side to produce hydrogen, and carrying out an oxidation reaction on an anode side to produce oxygen, wherein the electrolyteson the anode side and the cathode side are water vapor with a temperature of 100-200 DEG C, the cathode side and the anode side are isolated by an electrode assembly, and the electrode assembly is anion exchange membrane with two side surfaces respectively coated with a cathode catalyst and an anode catalyst. According to the invention, by adopting the method, the low-heating-value waste heat steam with a temperature of 100-200 DEG C can be effectively utilized, the quick start-stop requirement can be met, the electrolysis device can be simplified, the electrolysis efficiency can be improved,and the energy consumption can be reduced.
Applicants: CHN ENERGY INVEST GROUP CO LTD;;NAT INST CLEAN & LOW CARBON ENERGY

Title: Cobalt-iron composite oxide oxygen evolution catalyst and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a ferrocobalt composite oxide oxygen evolution catalyst and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production catalysis. The preparation method of the cobalt-iron composite oxide oxygen evolution catalyst comprises the following steps: mixing cobalt oxide and iron oxide, carrying out dispersion treatment by using isopropanol after first grinding, and then carrying out ball milling, cooling, washing and drying to obtain a precursor; and mixing the precursor and lithium chloride, performing secondary grinding, and sintering to obtain the ferrocobalt composite oxide oxygen evolution catalyst. The cobalt-iron composite oxide oxygen evolution catalyst provided by the invention has the advantages of high activity, high stability, long service life and low cost, can be used as an oxygen evolution catalyst of systems such as alkaline electrolyzed water and anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water, has excellent catalytic performance, and can greatly reduce the energy consumption of water electrolysis hydrogen production.
Applicants: CSSC HANDAN PERIC HYDROGEN ENERGY TECH CO LTD

Title: Hollow array oxygen evolution electrode and preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a self-supporting nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide nanosheet coated cuprous sulfide hollow array oxygen evolution electrode, and belongs to the field of alkaline electrolyzed water. A self-supporting nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide nanosheet coated cuprous sulfide hollow array oxygen evolution electrode is obtained through a hydrothermal method in an alkaline medium; foamy copper is used as a substrate, the electrode structure comprises an outer layer consisting of a plurality of layered nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide nanosheets and an inner layer consisting of cuprous sulfide hollow nanorods, and the final morphology characteristics are as follows: the average diameter of each nanorod is 100-500nm, and the length of each nanorod is 2-3mu m; the electrode can effectively control the morphology of a synthetic catalyst under mild conditions, and has good catalytic activity and stability. The electrode is applied to the oxygen evolution reaction in the water electrolysis hydrogen production process under the catalytic alkaline condition. The invention can be applied to renewable fuel cells, photoelectrocatalysis, alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water and electrolytic hydrogen generator devices.

Title: Amorphous Sr-CoOOHv ultrathin nanosheet electrocatalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of preparation of two-dimensional nano material electrocatalysts, and particularly relates to an amorphous Sr-CoOOHv ultrathin nanosheet electrocatalyst as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The strontium-doped cobalt selenide nanobelt is prepared through a hydrothermal method to serve as a substrate, and in-situ electrochemical reconstruction is carried out under the alkaline electrolyzed water anode oxygen evolution reaction condition to obtain the strontium-doped cobalt selenide nanobelt. According to the Sr-CoOOHv ultrathin nanosheet rich in cobalt vacancies, due to the existence of the metal cobalt vacancies, cobalt-oxygen covalence can be enhanced, lattice oxygen can be activated, meanwhile, hydroxyl affinity can be improved, and the lattice oxygen can be filled, so that the catalyst shows excellent catalytic activity and durability in industrial application of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production.

Title: Preparation method of adjustable NiCoFe LDH/PTFE composite porous diaphragm
Abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of an adjustable NiCoFe LDH/PTFE composite porous diaphragm, and belongs to the technical field of diaphragms. Hydrophilic polytetrafluoroethylene is used as a porous diaphragm substrate, layered double hydroxides are grown on the surface of the porous diaphragm substrate and in the diaphragm by a hydrothermal method, and the morphology and performance of the composite porous diaphragm are regulated and controlled by changing the overall feed liquid concentration of the layered double hydroxides. The composite membrane prepared by the method has good organic-inorganic interface compatibility, shows the advantages of high hydrophilicity, high conductivity, low ohmic resistance and the like, overcomes the defect of poor alkaline stability of a traditional anion exchange membrane, and can maintain long-term alkali resistance. The membrane preparation process is green and low in cost, and has a good application prospect in the process of hydrogen production by alkaline electrolysis of water.

Title: Barium-based B-site high-entropy perovskite oxide and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a barium-based B-site high-entropy perovskite type oxide and a preparation method thereof, the molecular formula of the barium-based B-site high-entropy perovskite type oxide is represented as ABO3, the A site is Ba element, the B site is at least five of Ti, Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Y and Zr element, the molar content of the A-site element is 50%, and the molar content range of the B-site element is 5%-20%; by optimizing the configuration entropy, the novel barium-based B-site high-entropy perovskite OER catalyst is prepared, and the OER activity and stability of perovskite are greatly improved. In devices such as an alkaline electrolytic bath and an anion exchange membrane electrolytic bath, the catalyst with high OER activity can effectively reduce the overpotential of electrolyzed water, and the oxygen production and hydrogen production cost of the electrolytic bath is greatly reduced.
Applicants: UNIV NANJING SCI & TECH;;SUZHOU DAQING NEW MATERIAL TECH CO LTD

Title: Electric pile device, control method and control system of electric pile device and related equipment of electric pile device
Abstract: The invention relates to a galvanic pile device, a control method and system of the galvanic pile device and related equipment of the galvanic pile device, and relates to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production. The galvanic pile device comprises a plurality of clusters connected in parallel; wherein each cluster comprises a plurality of AEM electric piles which are connected in series; the AEM stack comprises a plurality of unit cells connected in series, and each unit cell comprises an electrode material, a catalyst layer and an anion exchange membrane. Based on the galvanic pile device, the efficiency of the galvanic pile device is remarkably improved, so that the galvanic pile device can meet the requirements of large-scale industry and energy markets, and the effects of reducing the cost of the galvanic pile device and expanding the application scene of the galvanic pile device are achieved.
Applicants: WOLONG ELECTRIC DRIVING GROUP CO LTD;;WOLONG YINGNAIDE ZHEJIANG HYDROGEN ENERGY TECH CO LTD

Title: High-stability AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production electrolytic cell capable of rapidly desorbing bubbles
Abstract: The high-stability AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production electrolytic cell comprises a membrane electrode assembly, an electrode plate and an end plate, the membrane electrode assembly comprises an anion exchange membrane, a catalytic layer plate, a gas diffusion layer plate and a bipolar plate, a bidirectional snakelike flow channel is formed in the side, close to the electrode plate, of the bipolar plate, and the end plate is arranged in the bipolar plate. A gas diffusion layer plate is arranged on the bipolar plate, a catalyst layer plate is arranged on the gas diffusion layer plate, a radial flow channel is arranged on one side of the bipolar plate close to the gas diffusion layer plate, a low-density through hole and a high-density through hole are arranged on the gas diffusion layer plate, and a groove is arranged on the catalyst layer plate. Through a bipolar plate gradient flow field and a turbulent flow increasing effect, electrolyte distribution dynamic balance is realized, gas discharge is accelerated, bubbles are forcibly stripped by utilizing a fluid momentum difference, rapid desorption of the bubbles is ensured, and through combination of high and low density through holes and micron-sized honeycomb grooves, the bubbles are directionally migrated and desorbed, and the desorption speed of the bubbles is accelerated.

Title: Oxygen evolution reaction catalyst electrode, preparation method and application
Abstract: The invention provides an oxygen evolution reaction catalyst electrode, a preparation method and application, and relates to the technical field of electro-catalysis nanometer material preparation.According to the oxygen evolution reaction catalyst electrode, a heterostructure formed by combining nickel sulfide and iron phosphide is obtained on the surface of a nickel net, and the heterostructure serves as the oxygen evolution catalyst electrode and is applied to an anion exchange membrane water electrolyser; the activation and reaction stability of the electro-catalysis oxygen evolution reaction are improved, and the current density of 10 mA cm <-2 > and 100 mAcm <-2 > can be obtained only through 226 mV overpotential and 258 mV overpotential respectively. The catalyst electrode FeP4-Ni3S2/NF is used as an anode in a membrane electrode, the current density of 1A cm <-2 > can be obtained by only needing 1.81 V cell voltage in a low-temperature environment of 50 DEG C, and the current density of 1A cm <-2 > can be obtained by only needing 1.94 V and 1.91 V cell voltage at near room temperature of 30 DEG C and 40 DEG C.

Title: Three-dimensional porous cavity CrN-c nanocage electrocatalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a three-dimensional porous cavity CrN-c nanocage electrocatalyst as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of three-dimensional nanomaterial synthesis and electrolysis water catalysis. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing a chromium hydroxide nanocage as a precursor through a solvothermal method, protecting by utilizing silicon dioxide in a high-temperature nitridation process, and then etching to remove the silicon dioxide to prepare the three-dimensional porous cavity CrN-c nanocage. According to the three-dimensional porous cavity CrN-c nanocage provided by the invention, due to the confinement of the porous cavity and the unsaturated coordination edge, hydroxyl reactants can be enriched on a reaction interface, the formation and release of oxygen bubbles can be promoted, and the concentration of a dissolved oxygen product is reduced; the three-dimensional porous cavity CrN-c nanocage shows catalytic activity and long-term stability superior to those of a commercial ruthenium oxide catalyst in an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production anode oxygen evolution reaction.

Title: AEM anode slurry and preparation method of membrane electrode of AEM anode slurry
Abstract: The invention discloses an AEM anode slurry and a preparation method of a membrane electrode thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing an anode catalyst with a first solvent, and fully ball-milling to obtain an anode catalyst prefabricated slurry; mixing the ionomer with a second solvent, adding a surfactant, and carrying out ultrasonic treatment to obtain an ionomer solution; mixing the anode catalyst prefabricated slurry with the ionomer solution, adding a proper amount of binder, and performing shear mixing to obtain anode catalyst slurry; the prepared AEM anode slurry and the corresponding cathode catalyst slurry are respectively coated or coated and transferred on two sides of an anion exchange membrane to obtain a membrane electrode. By designing a slurry dispersion system, form and processing in the casting process of the membrane electrode are optimized, and sample falling of an anode catalyst layer is effectively avoided; the prepared membrane electrode is improved in water electrolysis performance and excellent in state, and the preparation method is simple and easy to operate.

Title: Preparation method of heterogeneous nano-particle/graphene composite hydrogen evolution catalytic material and product and application of heterogeneous nano-particle/graphene composite hydrogen evolution catalytic material
Abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a heterogeneous nanoparticle/graphene composite hydrogen evolution catalytic material as well as a product and application of the heterogeneous nanoparticle/graphene composite hydrogen evolution catalytic material, and belongs to the field of green hydrogen production energy. According to the method, CuBTC is used as a precursor, RuCl3 and phosphorous acid inorganic salt are sequentially introduced and quantitatively loaded on carbon paper, and then rapid carbonization treatment is performed through a direct laser scribing technology. The octahedral structure of the precursor is converted into the network-shaped graphene composite structure by regulating and controlling the doping amount of Ru and P, the laser power, the scribing distance and other parameters, and more active sites are exposed. The obtained material has excellent hydrogen evolution catalytic activity and stability under the alkaline condition, is simple in preparation method and low in cost, can replace a commercial Pt/C catalyst, and is suitable for the field of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production.

Title: POLYARYL ISATIN-BASED CATIONIC POLYMER, PREPARATION METHOD THEREFOR, AND USE THEREOF
Abstract: Provided in the present invention are a polyaryl isatin-based cationic polymer, a preparation method therefor, and the use thereof. The cationic polymer is a novel polyaryl isatin scaffold synthesized by a Friedel-Crafts polycondensation reaction under the catalysis of a superacid. An isatin structural unit in the cationic polymer possesses a very large molecular volume, which can improve the dimensional stability and mechanical properties of the cationic polymer after film formation; in addition, the N site of a cation grafted onto the cationic polymer is located on the para-position of the isatin structural unit, and such a remote grafting strategy can further improve the alkali resistance stability of the cation in the film. Therefore, the cationic polymer of the present invention exhibits extremely high ionic conductivity and mechanical and chemical stability, and can thus be used as an anion exchange membrane or an anion exchange polymer adhesive for alkaline water electrolysis, alkaline fuel cells, carbon dioxide reduction and flow batteries.

Title: Preparation method of CoP/Co (OH) 2 sea urchin-shaped heterojunction catalyst growing on foamed nickel and application of CoP/Co (OH) 2 sea urchin-shaped heterojunction catalyst in anion exchange membrane water electrolysis
Abstract: The invention belongs to the field of preparation of nano materials, and discloses a CoP/Co (OH) 2 sea urchin-shaped heterojunction catalyst growing on foamed nickel and a preparation method and application of the CoP/Co (OH) 2 sea urchin-shaped heterojunction catalyst. Alkali cobalt carbonate (CoCH) is used as a precursor, a crystalline phase CoP substrate is generated through a low-temperature phosphating method, then the surface of the crystalline phase CoP substrate is uniformly coated with an amorphous Co (OH) 2 layer through an electro-deposition process, and the self-supporting phosphating/hydroxyl heterogeneous structure catalyst (CoP/Co (OH) 2) is successfully constructed. The obtained CoP/Co (OH) 2 shows excellent complete water splitting performance, and is benefited from the high-activity specific surface area (Cdl = 44.66 mF cm <-2 >) and the interface rapid electron conduction characteristic (Rct = 0.43 omega) of a heterogeneous structure; when two electrodes are assembled to fully decompose water, the cell voltage is only 1.780 V when the current density is 250 mA cm <-2 >, and after continuous operation is carried out for 24 hours, the performance is basically kept unchanged, and the voltage fluctuation ratio is lower than 0.5%.
