CoP/Co (OH) 2 is prepared into a 2 * 2cm < 2 > self-supporting electrode to construct AEMWE, only 2.08 V cell voltage is needed under the ultrahigh current density of 1A cm <-2 >, the AEMWE can stably run for 250 hours, the attenuation rate is 80 mu V h <-1 >, meanwhile, the hydrogen production efficiency is calculated to reach 96.2% through gas metering and Faraday law, and the engineering potential of the AEMWE in large-scale hydrogen production application is verified.
Applicants: FOSHAN GAOKE HECHUANG TECH CO LTD

Title: Ultra-small platinum ruthenium iron cobalt nickel copper high-entropy alloy particle/carbon paper composite material and preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to an ultra-small platinum-ruthenium-iron-cobalt-nickel-copper high-entropy alloy particle/carbon paper composite material and a preparation method and application thereof. Metal chloride and carbon paper serve as raw materials, the ultra-small platinum-ruthenium-iron-cobalt-nickel-copper high-entropy alloy particle/carbon paper composite material us-HEA/CFP is prepared through a solvothermal method and high-temperature thermal shock, and the preparation method comprises the following steps that a, a platinum-ruthenium-iron-cobalt-nickel-copper precursor/carbon paper is prepared through the solvothermal method; b, the precursor is subjected to high-temperature thermal shock to prepare us-HEA/CFP, the overpotentials under the current density of-100 mA/cm <-2 >,-500 mA/cm <-2 > and-1000 mA/cm <-2 > are only 31.4 mV, 69.2 mV and 102.5 mV respectively, and the Tafel slope is 28.9 mV dec-1. When the temperature is 60 DEG C, an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell constructed by taking us-HEA/CFP as a cathode needs the voltage of 1.94 V to reach the industrial-grade current density of 1000 mA cm <-2 >, and the anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell can stably operate for 500 hours under the current density, so that the anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell shows great practical application potential. The method can be expanded to design of other high-entropy materials, and a new idea is provided for efficient preparation of an electrocatalyst with excellent performance.

Title: HYDROGEN-CONTAINING WATER-GENERATING APPARATUS
Abstract: A hydrogen-containing water-generating apparatus provided with: a cylindrical anode body that is for electrolyzing raw water; a cylindrical cathode body that is disposed so as to surround the outer circumferential surface of the anode body and is for electrolyzing the raw water; an anion exchange membrane that is disposed so as to separate the outer circumferential surface of the anode body from the inner circumferential surface of the cathode body, passes hydroxide ions from the cathode body side to the anode body side, and prohibits the transfer of hydrogen from the cathode body side to the anode body side and transfer of oxygen from the anode body side to the cathode body side; and an electrolysis tank in which the anode body, the cathode body and the anion exchange membrane are housed and which has an inflow port into which the raw water flows, a discharge port for discharging oxygen that is generated near the anode body, and an outflow port from which hydrogen-containing water that contains hydrogen generated near the cathode body flows out.

Title: Method for preparing electrolyzed water catalyst through ultrafast corrosion and application
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electrolysis water catalysis, and discloses a method for preparing an electrolysis water catalyst based on ultrafast electrochemical corrosion. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing deep eutectic ionic liquid (DEIL) from choline chloride and ethylene glycol, adding metal salt and thiourea to form electrolyte, and carrying out electro-deposition within 15 seconds through a two-electrode system to obtain the sulfide catalyst. The method has the advantages of high preparation speed (shortened by more than 100 times compared with a traditional method), excellent catalytic activity (241 mV at 100 mA cm <-2 >), high stability (the performance is attenuated by 57 mV after continuous working for 100 hours) and the like, and is particularly suitable for large-scale preparation of the anode catalyst layer of the anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell.

Title: Electrocatalyst and preparation and application thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to an electrocatalyst and preparation and application thereof, and belongs to the field of catalysts. The invention provides an electrocatalyst preparation method, which comprises: dispersing V2O3 in an alcohol substance, adding an Ir salt, and stirring to react for 8-12 h; and drying, and treating at 250-350 DEG C for 1-3 hours to obtain the electrocatalyst Ir-V2O3. Compared with Ir-VO2 and Ir-V2O5, the electrocatalyst Ir-V2O3 obtained in the invention has the lowest overpotential of 10 mA cm <-2 > in 1.0 M of KOH and 0.5 M of H2SO4, and the highest flip frequency value and mass activity. The Ir-V2O3RuO2 shows high stability of 22 hours when the current density of the Ir-V2O3RuO2 in an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell is 100 mA cm <-2 >, which indicates that the Ir-V2O3RuO2 has the potential of practical application.

Title: Water electrolysis hydrogen production device with turbulent flow strengthening module and method
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and discloses a water electrolysis hydrogen production device with a turbulent flow strengthening module and a method, an end pressing polar plate comprises a cathode end pressing polar plate and an anode end pressing polar plate, and a square groove for placing a flow field module is formed in the center of the inner side of the end pressing polar plate; the flow field module comprises a cathode flow field module and an anode flow field module, one surface is smooth, and the other surface is provided with a snakelike thread flow channel; the metal electrode comprises a metal cathode and a metal anode and is a porous electrode; and the diaphragm is positioned between the cathode end pressing plate and the anode end pressing plate. The flow field module is used as a turbulent flow strengthening module, the mass transfer effect in a flow channel can be strengthened, an electrolyte washes an electrode in the flow field, the gas-liquid mass transfer capacity is strengthened, the water electrolysis efficiency is improved, the flow field is convenient to clean, and the assembly difficulty is reduced; the device can cope with electrodes of various types and thicknesses, can realize switching of different flow fields, and adapts to two water electrolysis working conditions of alkaline anion exchange membrane water electrolysis and proton exchange membrane water electrolysis.

Title: Carbon-supported ruthenium alloy hydrogen evolution catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and particularly relates to a carbon-supported ruthenium alloy hydrogen evolution catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof. A carbon material with a hydrophilic surface is used as a carrier, metal ions are uniformly adsorbed on the surface of the carbon material by utilizing coulomb force between active groups on the surface of the carbon material and the metal ions, then uniformly-loaded ruthenium alloy nanoparticles are prepared by a one-step wet chemical method or a two-step precipitation-reduction method, the particle size of the obtained alloy is smaller than 3nm, and the ruthenium content is lower than 10wt%. According to the preparation method, catalytic sites are exposed to the maximum extent, intrinsic catalytic activity is further improved through an alloying strategy, excellent hydrogen evolution activity is shown, and when being used as a cathode material for an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis device, the composite material can directly replace a commercial platinum-carbon catalyst, and the service life of the composite material is prolonged. The problems that a catalyst prepared in the prior art is high in cost, complex in process, low in hydrogen production efficiency and the like are solved.

Title: Hierarchical heterostructure electrocatalyst for ethanol electrocatalytic oxidation and preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of electro-catalytic materials and energy conversion, and particularly relates to a hierarchical heterostructure electro-catalyst for ethanol electro-catalytic oxidation as well as a preparation method and application of the hierarchical heterostructure electro-catalyst. The preparation method comprises the following steps: providing a conductive substrate; growing an amorphous porous transition metal sulfide layer on the surface of the conductive substrate in situ to obtain a composite intermediate; the transition metal sulfide is nickel sulfide; and performing in-situ growth of a two-dimensional metal organic framework nanosheet array on the surface of the composite intermediate to obtain a target product. The catalyst disclosed by the invention can still keep relatively low working voltage under the condition of high current density, is beneficial to electron transfer and reaction at an interface, and can solve the problems of weak interface coupling, harsh preparation conditions, easily damaged structure, poor stability under the condition of high current density and the like of the catalyst in the prior art. Good application prospects are shown in ethanol-assisted water electrolysis hydrogen production and anion exchange membrane electrolysis cells.

Title: Seawater hydrogen production system
Abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of seawater hydrogen production, in particular to a seawater hydrogen production system. In the system, an anode chamber, a concentration chamber, a desalination chamber and a cathode chamber are arranged in a desalination device, a first cation exchange membrane is arranged between the desalination chamber and the cathode chamber, an anion exchange membrane is arranged between the concentration chamber and the desalination chamber, and a second cation exchange membrane is arranged between the anode chamber and the concentration chamber; therefore, seawater positive ions and seawater negative ions in the desalination chamber can be continuously removed by utilizing the circularly flowing electrolyte, so that efficient desalination is realized, and more fresh water resources are obtained; meanwhile, fresh water output by the desalination chamber is introduced into the electrolysis device, so that the electrolysis device is used for carrying out electrolysis hydrogen production on the fresh water from the desalination chamber.

Title: Ionic solvent film, preparation method and application thereof and water electrolysis device
Abstract: The invention provides an ionic solvent membrane, a preparation method and application thereof and a water electrolysis device, and belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis anion exchange membranes. The preparation method of the ionic solvent membrane comprises the following steps: preparing a membrane casting solution from polybenzimidazole, a main pore-foaming agent and a reinforcing agent; preparing the membrane casting solution into a membrane, and reacting the membrane casting solution with alkali to prepare an ionic solvent membrane; wherein the main pore-foaming agent comprises at least one of a polyether pore-foaming agent and a polyethylene lactam pore-foaming agent; the reinforcing agent comprises at least one of cellulose and silicon dioxide. The main pore-foaming agent and the reinforcing agent are introduced into the polybenzimidazole, so that the mechanical property and the ionic conduction property of the ionic solvent film can be improved.
Applicants: QINGHE YUANTAI CHANGZHOU NEW MATERIAL TECH CO LTD

Title: Strontium-doped low-crystalline-state hydroxyl ferronickel oxide electrolyzed water nano-catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a strontium-doped low-crystalline-state hydroxyl ferronickel oxide electrolyzed water nano-catalyst as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of electrocatalyst preparation. The catalyst has an ultrathin nanosheet structure, is in a low crystalline state, and is prepared from a strontium-doped ferronickel selenide pre-catalyst through in-situ electrooxidation reconstruction. The strength of a metal-selenium bond is weakened through strontium (Sr) doping, phase change is induced to generate low-crystalline-state Sr-doped hydroxyl ferronickel oxide (NiFeOOH) rich in bimetal active sites, bimetal vacancies are introduced while the covalence of the metal-oxygen bond is enhanced, the adsorption energy of an oxygen-containing intermediate is optimized, the electrocatalytic activity and stability of an anode oxygen evolution reaction are remarkably improved, and the preparation method is suitable for industrial production. The method has an excellent industrial application prospect in an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production system.

Title: Oxygen-containing anion modified oxygen evolution electrode for AEMWE and preparation method of oxygen-containing anion modified oxygen evolution electrode
Abstract: The invention aims at providing an oxygen-containing anion modified oxygen evolution electrode for AEMWE and a preparation method of the oxygen-containing anion modified oxygen evolution electrode, and belongs to the technical field of hydrogen production through electrolysis of water. Introducing a second cation and an oxygen-containing anion through dipping treatment; and finally, carrying out cyclic voltammetry electrochemical activation treatment to obtain the oxygen evolution electrode modified by the oxygen-containing anion. The invention provides an AEMWE anode gas diffusion electrode preparation route which is rapid, controllable, simple in method and relatively mild in synthesis condition, the oxygen evolution electrode prepared by the method has high activity and long-term durability under ampere-level current density, and has low cell pressure and long-term stability under AEMWE industrial conditions; the catalyst cost and the hydrogen production energy consumption are effectively reduced. The preparation method is suitable for cheap iron-based metal materials, different oxygen-containing anions can be introduced, and the preparation method has huge potential application value and wide application prospects.
Applicants: UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY;;SHANXI RES INSTITUTE HUAIROU LABORATORY

Title: Method for producing a catalyst for water electrolysis containing copper cobalt sulfide and tungsten disulfide
Abstract: The method for manufacturing a catalyst for water electrolysis according to the present invention comprises: a first step of hydrothermally synthesizing copper-cobalt bilayer hydroxide (cuco ldh) on a metal foam by using a solution including a copper precursor and a cobalt precursor; and a second step of forming a hybrid structure by hydrothermally synthesizing the copper-cobalt bilayer hydroxide in a solution including a tungsten precursor and a sulfur precursor. In addition, the catalyst for water electrolysis according to the present invention includes a hybrid structure including copper sulfide cobalt and tungsten disulfide, and the hybrid structure may be represented by cuco_2s_4-ws_2. According to the present invention, improved electrochemical catalytic activity can be exhibited in both hydrogen evolution reaction (her) and oxygen evolution reaction (oer) during water electrolysis reaction. In addition, the catalyst for water electrolysis of the present invention can efficiently produce hydrogen with a lower energy supply than an existing noble metal electrode, and can be used in both an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis and a solar cell-water electrolysis system.
Applicants: KOREA ADVANCED INST SCI & TECH;;KUMOH NAT INST TECHNOLOGY IND ACAD COOP FOUND

Title: Preparation method and application of nitrogen-doped carbon nanotube coated with platinum-ruthenium alloy
Abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of a nitrogen-doped carbon nanotube coated with platinum-ruthenium alloy, and is characterized in that the nitrogen-doped carbon nanotube of which the tube wall is coated with PtRu alloy nanoparticles is prepared by using a chemical vapor deposition process assisted by an anodic aluminum oxide template and subsequent ammonia gas annealing; although the contents of Pt and Ru are respectively as low as 0.8 wt% and 4.2 wt%, the combined action of Pt, Ru and N doping enables the platinum-ruthenium-nitrogen doped carbon nanotube composite material to have excellent HER electrocatalytic activity in alkaline, acidic and neutral electrolytes, and the HER activity of the composite material in the alkaline and acidic electrolytes exceeds that of a commercial Pt/C catalyst; besides, after the platinum-ruthenium-nitrogen-doped carbon nanotube composite material is used as a cathode electrocatalyst to assemble an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell, the electrolytic cell provides low voltage of 1.78 V under the industrial grade current density of 1Acm <-2 >, and the electrolytic cell has good durability; therefore, the invention provides a new opportunity for designing and synthesizing a high-performance pH universal HER electrocatalyst.
Applicants: HUZHOU CITY NANXUN DISTRICT JIANDA ECOLOGICAL ENV INNOVATION CENTER

Title: Surface modification method and device for improving catalytic activity of metal material, metal catalytic material prepared by method and application of metal catalytic material
Abstract: The invention provides a surface modification method and device for improving the catalytic activity of a metal material, the metal catalytic material and application of the metal catalytic material. The surface modification method for improving the catalytic activity of the metal material comprises the steps that the metal material is provided; surface mechanical grinding treatment is applied to the surface of the metal material, and the surface mechanical grinding treatment comprises the steps that shock waves are generated through a vibration generator to drive balls to impact the metal material, so that the surface of the metal material is modified, and the catalytic activity of the metal material is improved. In the embodiment of the invention, the metal catalytic material subjected to surface mechanical grinding treatment has very high catalytic activity and good catalytic stability, and can be applied to an alkaline electrolytic bath and an anion exchange membrane electrolytic bath, so that the water electrolysis hydrogen production efficiency is greatly improved, and water electrolysis hydrogen production under high current density is realized.
Applicants: CITY UNIVERSITY OF HONG KONG SHENZHEN RESEARCH INST

Title: Membrane electrode assembly and method for hydrogen evolution by electrolysis
Abstract: The present invention discloses a membrane electrode assembly and a method for hydrogen evolution by electrolysis, the method for hydrogen evolution by electrolysis comprises: immersing the membrane electrode assembly in an alkaline aqueous solution, the membrane electrode assembly comprising: an anode comprising a first catalyst layer on a first gas-liquid diffusion layer; a cathode including a second catalyst layer on the second gas-liquid diffusion layer; and an anion exchange membrane interposed between the first catalyst layer of the anode and the second catalyst layer of the cathode, wherein the chemical structure of the first catalyst layer, the second catalyst layer, or both is MxRuyN2, M is Ni, Co, Fe, Mn, Cr, V, Ti, Cu, or Zn, x is greater than 0 and less than 1.3, y is greater than 0.7 and less than 2, x + y is equal to 2, and MxRuyN2 is a cubic system or an amorphous system; and applying a potential to the anode and the cathode to electrolyze the alkaline aqueous solution,so as to enable the cathode to generate hydrogen and the anode to generate oxygen.

Title: Membrane electrode assembly and method for producing hydrogen by electrolysis
Abstract: The present invention discloses a membrane electrode assembly and a method for producing hydrogen by electrolysis. The membrane electrode assembly comprises: an anode comprising a first catalyst layeron a first gas-liquid diffusion layer; a cathode including a second catalyst layer on a second gas-liquid diffusion layer; and an anion exchange membrane clamped between the first catalyst layer of the anode and the second catalyst layer of the cathode, wherein the chemical structure of the first catalyst layer is M'aM''bN2 or M'cM''dCe, M' is Ni, Co, Fe, Mn, Cr, V, Ti, Cu, or Zn; M'' is Nb, Ta,or a combination thereof, 0.7 =a<=1.7, 0.3<=b<=1.3, a+b=2, 0.24<=c<=1.7, 0.3<=d<=1.76, 0.38<=e<=3.61, M'aM''bN2 is a cubic system, and M'cM''dCe is a cubic system or an amorphous system.

Title: Iron-doped nickel hydroxide composite nickel selenide material as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrode materials and industrial catalysis, and particularly relates to an iron-doped nickel hydroxide composite nickel selenide material and a preparation method and application thereof. The iron-doped nickel hydroxide composite nickel selenide material provided by the invention comprises a conductive substrate and a NiSe nanosheet loaded on the conductive substrate, the Fe-doped Ni (OH) 2 is loaded on the surface of the NiSe nanosheet; the Fe-doped Ni (OH) 2 is in the shape of a nanosheet; the Fe element in the Fe-doped Ni (OH) 2 is doped into the Ni (OH) 2 crystal. The iron-doped nickel hydroxide composite nickel selenide material provided by the invention has the advantages of excellent intrinsic electrocatalytic activity, high electrochemical active area and good stability, and shows excellent water electrolysis performance in an alkaline anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer under the condition of high current density.

Title: High-activity alkaline hydrogen evolution catalyst and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a high-activity alkaline hydrogen evolution catalyst and a preparation method thereof, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) stirring precursors (including a platinum precursor and a nickel precursor), ferric chloride, hexadecyl trimethyl ammonium chloride, polyvinylpyrrolidone and tungsten hexacarbonyl at room temperature by using ethanol as a solvent to obtain a uniform dispersion liquid; the preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing a first dispersion liquid containing a WOx-Pt3Ni nano octahedron by adopting a solvothermal method; (2) removing a surface adsorbent from the WOx-Pt3Ni nano octahedron obtained in the step (1) by using acetic acid to enhance the hydrophilicity and obtain a second dispersion liquid; and (3) adding the first dispersion liquid obtained in the step (2) into a carbon carrier, and ultrasonically mixing uniformly to obtain the alkaline hydrogen evolution catalyst (WOx-Pt3Ni/C). The preparation method and experimental operation are simple and efficient, high in yield and environment-friendly; the prepared catalyst shows excellent electrocatalytic hydrogen evolution and anion exchange membrane water electrolysis performance in an alkaline medium.

Title: Self-supporting NiFe-LDH oxygen evolution electrode based on through hole structure porous transmission layer and preparation and application of self-supporting NiFe-LDH oxygen evolution electrode
Abstract: The invention relates to a self-supporting NiFe-LDH oxygen evolution electrode based on a through hole structure porous transmission layer and preparation and application of the self-supporting NiFe-LDH oxygen evolution electrode, an AEM water electrolysis anode electrode can be prepared in a low-cost, environment-friendly and large-batch mode, the defect that an electrode preparation method in the same field is tedious at present is overcome, and the prepared electrode is high in catalytic activity and good in stability and has good application prospects. The commercialized development of an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production technology is expected to be promoted.
Applicants: JILIN CHUANYUE HYDROGEN ENERGY TECH CO LTD

Title: Carbonate intercalated iron-cobalt-nickel layered hydroxide catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention provides a carbonate intercalated iron-cobalt-nickel layered hydroxide catalyst as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of hydrogen production by electrolysis of water. The carbonate intercalated iron-cobalt-nickel layered hydroxide catalyst comprises iron-cobalt-nickel hydroxide laminates and carbonate ions located between the laminates, and in the iron-cobalt-nickel hydroxide, the molar ratio of an iron element to a cobalt element to a nickel element is 1: (0.025-3): (0.25-4) in sequence. The catalyst can effectively improve the intrinsic defects of poor conductivity and catalytic activity, limited interlayer mass transfer and the like of the traditional transition metal layered hydroxide, so that the corresponding anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell has higher current density.
Applicants: CHONGQING MANENSITE NEW MATERIAL TECH CO LTD

Title: Low-impedance water electrolysis hydrogen production preparation method of nickel-based monatomic catalyst interface anchoring composite membrane and application of low-impedance water electrolysis hydrogen production preparation method of nickel-based monatomic catalyst interface anchoring composite membrane
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of anion exchange membranes, in particular to a low-impedance water electrolysis hydrogen production preparation method of a nickel-based monatomic catalyst interface anchoring composite membrane and application of the low-impedance water electrolysis hydrogen production preparation method of the nickel-based monatomic catalyst interface anchoring composite membrane. Then washing with deionized water until the solution is neutral after washing, and drying the washed polyether-ether-ketone porous membrane in a vacuum drying oven to prepare a hydroxylated polyether-ether-ketone base material; according to the invention, through an interface anchoring technology, firm combination and uniform dispersion of the nickel monatomic catalyst on the surface of the substrate are realized. According to the technology, catalyst agglomeration is avoided, full exposure of active sites is ensured, the interface bonding force between the catalyst and the base material is greatly enhanced, catalyst falling in the electrolysis process is reduced, and guarantee is provided for stable operation of the composite membrane.
Applicants: BEIJING YINENG HYDROGEN SOURCE TECH CO LTD

Title: Phosphorus-doped CoFe-LDH electrode for high-current hydrogen production as well as preparation method and application of phosphorus-doped CoFe-LDH electrode
Abstract: The invention provides a phosphorus-doped CoFe-LDH electrode for high-current hydrogen production as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing foamed nickel subjected to acid pickling treatment with a red phosphorus solution, and carrying out hydrothermal reaction to obtain NiP; the preparation method comprises the following steps: immersing NiP into a mixed solution of cobalt acetate tetrahydrate and 2-methylimidazole to obtain Co-ZIF-L-coated NiP; and the Co-ZIF-L (at) NiP is immersed in a ferrous sulfate tetrahydrate solution, and the CoFe-LDH (at) NiP-120 electrode is obtained through heating. An anion exchange membrane water electrolysis device (AEM) based on the electrode shows remarkable activity when the voltage is 1.85 V, the current density reaches 100 mA cm <-2 >, and obvious performance degradation does not occur when the AEM stably operates for 70 h under the large current density of 100 mA cm <-2 >. Compared with an existing electrolyzed water electrode, the method has the characteristics that active sites are accurately regulated and controlled, the structural stability is improved, and the process cost is reduced.

Title: Macro preparation method of AEMWE defect-rich anode electrode material under large current density
Abstract: The invention provides a preparation method of an anode electrode material for AEMWE, which comprises the following steps: firstly, placing a conductive substrate in a non-noble metal mixed solution, and carrying out electro-deposition by taking the conductive substrate as a working electrode to obtain a precursor; and placing the precursor obtained in the previous step in an alkali solution, and carrying out an alkali etching reaction to obtain the anode electrode material for AEMWE. The non-noble metal mixed solution is a mixed aqueous solution of a Ni source, a Fe source, a Co source and an Al source. According to the preparation method provided by the invention, the non-noble metal-based defect-rich nano array structure catalyst prepared by combining an electrodeposition-alkali etching method can realize macro preparation, and more active sites are exposed on the basis of enhancing good permeation and oxygen transfer of electrolyte; stronger interface charge transfer performance and excellent stability are provided, and the synergistic effect jointly enhances the oxygen evolution performance of the catalyst.

Title: Flaky porous electrode for ALK/AEM electrolytic bath and preparation method of flaky porous electrode
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of hydrogen production through water electrolysis, and particularly relates to a sheet-shaped porous electrode for an alkaline electrolytic cell (ALK) and an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell (AEM) and a preparation method of the sheet-shaped porous electrode. The electrode is prepared by taking an alloy thin strip with specific components as a base material through punching and dealloying treatment. The general formula of alloy components is FeaCobNicCudMx, M is one or more of Nb, Ti, Ta, Hf, Zr, Al and Mo, and the atomic percent of all the components meets the condition that a + b + c + d + x = 100 at%; 0 < = a, b, c and d < = 55 at%, 0 < = x < = 15 at%; the alloy is prepared by smelting pure elements with the purity larger than or equal to 95 wt%, the thickness of the prepared thin strip is smaller than 1 mm, the width ranges from 10 cm to 50 cm, and the length is larger than 1.5 m. The preparation of the large-size high-performance catalytic electrode is successfully realized through a process of combining punching and dealloying. The electrode has high catalytic activity and a unique porous structure, due to the structure-function integrated design, the designed catalytic electrode has the functions of a catalytic layer and a gas diffusion layer at the same time, the integration level and the electrolysis efficiency of a system are improved, and good application adaptability is achieved.

Title: Platinum-rare earth based intermetallic compound as well as rapid high-throughput preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a platinum-rare earth based intermetallic compound as well as a rapid high-flux preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, fully ultrasonically mixing a metal salt precursor, an inorganic auxiliary reagent and carbon black, freeze-drying the mixed solution, and then carrying out short-time Joule heating treatment to prepare the carbon-loaded platinum-rare earth-based intermetallic compound catalyst. Compared with reported preparation methods such as a physical metallurgy method and an electric arc melting method, the method has the advantages that the platinum-rare earth based intermetallic compound catalyst can be rapidly prepared at high flux, the prepared intermetallic compound is uniformly distributed on the surface of carbon black and is uniform in size and small in particle size, the problem of agglomeration of nano-particles is avoided, and meanwhile the platinum-rare earth based intermetallic compound catalyst has the advantages of being stable in structure, high in stability and the like. And the composite material has multiple active sites, shows excellent electrocatalytic activity on cathode hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) of an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis system, and has considerable energy application potential.

Title: Photovoltaic and water electrolysis hydrogen production integrated device
Abstract: The invention discloses a photovoltaic and electrolytic water hydrogen production integrated device which comprises a photovoltaic power generation module, an electrolytic hydrogen production module, an intelligent matching control module, a waste heat recovery module and an integrated bearing shell. The photovoltaic power generation module is laid on the outer surface of the top of the integrated bearing shell and used for converting solar energy into direct current. A large-width anion exchange membrane and a high-efficiency nickel-based composite catalyst are adopted, the working current density of the electrolytic cell can be flexibly adjusted in a range of 100-1000mA/cm < 2 >, the hydrogen evolution overpotential is as low as 1.2 V, and the hydrogen production efficiency is high; meanwhile, efficient hydrogen and oxygen separation and deep hydrogen drying are achieved through corrugated plate separation and molecular sieve drying, the purity of produced hydrogen is larger than or equal to 99.99%, the water content is smaller than or equal to 10 ppm, and the industrial-grade and civil-grade hydrogen energy application requirements are met.

Title: Thermal shock induced ferrocobalt double-doped metastable-phase nickel/nickel oxide heterostructure composite electrode as well as preparation method and application of thermal shock induced ferrocobalt double-doped metastable-phase nickel/nickel oxide heterostructure composite electrode
Abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of a thermal shock induced ferrocobalt double-doped metastable phase nickel/nickel oxide heterostructure (Co, Fe-Ni/NiO/NF) composite electrode. The preparation method comprises the following steps: cutting and cleaning the foamed nickel substrate; the preparation method comprises the following steps: growing a nickel-cobalt-iron layered double hydroxide nanosheet on a foamed nickel substrate through a constant-voltage deposition method; nickel-cobalt-iron prussian blue analogue nanoparticles grow in situ on the surface of the nickel-cobalt-iron layered double hydroxide nanosheet through an ion exchange method; and preparing the Co, Fe-Ni/NiO/NF composite electrode through a thermal shock method. The composite electrode has excellent catalytic activity and stability as a working electrode for hydrogen evolution and oxygen evolution reactions. The composite electrode can be directly used as a cathode and an anode of an anion-exchange membrane electrolytic cell to efficiently catalyze a full-water decomposition reaction at different temperatures, and the electrolytic cell can stably operate for 1000 hours and 240 hours under the current densities of 0.1 A cm <-2 > and 1.0 A cm <-2 > respectively, so that the composite electrode has a good application prospect.

Title: Modeling method, system, medium and equipment for unified operation model of mixed electrolytic cell
Abstract: The invention provides a unified operation modeling method, system, medium and equipment for a mixed electrolytic bath, and belongs to the technical field of electrolytic bath hydrogen production, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining fixed data, operation data and technical data of different types of electrolytic baths; based on the obtained fixed data and the operation data, different types of electrolytic cell electrochemical models are established, and hydrogen production efficiency curves of different types of electrolytic cells are drawn according to the established electrolytic cell electrochemical models and by utilizing a Faraday calculation formula; and on the basis of hydrogen production efficiency curves and technical data of the two types of electrolytic cells, depicting constraint conditions, and establishing a mixed electrolytic cell unified operation model. For an alkaline electrolytic cell (AEL) and an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell (AEMEL), the difference of the technical characteristics of hydrogen production efficiency, starting time delay, upper and lower limits of input electric power and the like of the two types of electrolytic cells is fully considered, and a unified operation model covering the input-output response relation constraint, the operation interval and the climbing constraint of the electrolytic cells is constructed.

Title: Chloride ion intercalation nickel-iron layered double hydroxide catalytic electrode as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a chloride ion intercalation ferronickel layered double hydroxide as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of electro-catalytic materials. The chloride ions occupy the interlayer domain and do not damage the main body laminate structure, and the interlayer spacing is stably expanded through the electrostatic interaction. The method for preparing the material by a one-step hydrothermal method comprises the following steps: immersing the foamed nickel into a mixed solution containing chlorine salt, nickel salt, ferric salt and urea for hydrothermal reaction to obtain the in-situ growth nano flower-shaped array structure catalytic electrode. The overpotential of the catalytic electrode in alkaline water oxidation under 10mAcm <-2 > is only 179mV, and the catalytic electrode can stably operate for more than 500 hours in an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis device, and has excellent electrooxidation activity on biomass molecules such as glycerol, methanol, ethanol, urea and the like. The method is simple in preparation process, low in cost and suitable for the fields of alkaline water electrolysis and biomass-assisted electrolytic hydrogen production.

Title: Acid-base asymmetric membrane electrode and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses an acid-base asymmetric membrane electrode and application thereof. The acid-base asymmetric membrane electrode is formed by hot-pressing and compounding a hydrogen evolution gas diffusion layer, an anion exchange membrane loaded with a hydrogen evolution catalyst, a proton exchange membrane loaded with an oxygen evolution catalyst and an oxygen evolution gas diffusion layer, wherein the catalyst is sprayed on the surface of the membrane through an electrostatic spraying method, so that the prepared catalyst layer is uniform in structure, fluffy and porous, has abundant catalytic active sites, and can provide sufficient channels for mass transfer and diffusion of electrolyte and gas. According to the acid-base asymmetric membrane electrode, acid-base neutralization energy can be effectively utilized, so that the theoretical voltage of hydrogen production by electrolysis of water is effectively reduced; the acid-base asymmetric membrane electrode water electrolysis device is constructed on the basis of the acid-base asymmetric membrane electrode, and the device not only can realize higher catalytic current density under lower voltage, but also has excellent electro-catalysis stability, and can improve the compactness and hydrogen purity of an electrolysis structure, so that the device has a good application prospect.

Title: Gas-liquid separation and liquid storage balancing device for anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer
Abstract: The gas-liquid separation and liquid storage balancing device comprises a cathode liquid storage chamber and an anode liquid storage chamber, one side wall of the cathode liquid storage chamber is fixedly provided with a cathode flow channel communicated with the inside of the cathode liquid storage chamber, one side wall of the anode liquid storage chamber is fixedly provided with an anode flow channel communicated with the inside of the anode liquid storage chamber, and the cathode flow channel is communicated with the inside of the anode liquid storage chamber. The cathode flow channel is communicated with the anode flow channel, a blocking filter membrane capable of exchanging water molecules and blocking hydrogen and oxygen from passing through is arranged between the cathode flow channel and the anode flow channel, and the blocking filter membrane is arranged between the anode flow channel and the cathode flow channel and can isolate gas such as hydrogen and oxygen generated in the cathode liquid storage chamber and the anode liquid storage chamber. And meanwhile, water molecules can be freely exchanged by the barrier filter membrane, so that the electrolyte concentration balance between the anode liquid storage chamber and the cathode liquid storage chamber is ensured.

Title: Gas diffusion layer and membrane electrode assembly
Abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and provides a gas diffusion layer and a membrane electrode assembly. The gas diffusion layer comprises a supporting part and an extending part, and the supporting part is formed by folding a zigzag porous nickel net. And the extension part is used for connecting a power supply. The pore size of the porous nickel net is 30-60 meshes, and the thickness of the porous nickel net is 200-350 microns. And the thickness of the supporting part is 40 to 60mm. And the area of the supporting part is 20-40cm < 2 >. The membrane electrode assembly comprises an anode gas diffusion layer, a cathode gas diffusion layer, an anode catalyst layer, an anion exchange membrane and a cathode catalyst layer. According to the utility model, the corrosion resistance and chemical structure stability of the gas diffusion layer can be improved, the stability of the membrane electrode assembly is further improved, the diffusion layer replaces a polar plate, the assembly process of the AEM electrolytic bath is simplified, and the production cost is saved.
Applicants: SUQIAN LYUNENG HYDROGEN TECH CO LTD

Title: Ni-NiO/CeO2 heterojunction nano-catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a Ni-NiO/CeO2 heterojunction nano-catalyst as well as a preparation method and an application of the Ni-NiO/CeO2 heterojunction nano-catalyst. The catalyst is prepared by taking nickel and cerium ions as precursors through a one-step controllable incomplete reduction method, the process is simple, the yield is close to 100%, and the catalyst is suitable for mass production. In the catalyst, CeO2 effectively promotes water molecule dissociation, NiO species finely regulates and controls a hydrogen intermediate (H *) adjacent to a nickel active site to adsorb free energy, the bottleneck problems that a traditional nickel-based material is too high in H * adsorption and slow in water dissociation kinetics are synergistically solved, the catalyst shows excellent hydrogen evolution reaction activity in a 1M KOH electrolyte, and the catalyst can be applied to the field of hydrogen production. The overpotential is only 62 mV (relative to a reversible hydrogen electrode) under the current density of 10 mA cm <-2 >, and the performance is equivalent to that of a commercial 60% Pt/C catalyst; after the electrode is pressed into an integral electrode, the electrode can stably run for 300 hours under the ultrahigh current density of 1A cm <-2 > without activity attenuation. The catalyst disclosed by the invention is suitable for cathode hydrogen evolution reaction of alkaline electrolyzed water and anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water systems, and has an important industrial application prospect.

Title: Nickel-selenium-based mesh electrode and preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of water electrolysis and gassing, in particular to a nickel-selenium-based mesh electrode and a preparation method and application thereof, and the nickel-selenium-based mesh electrode comprises a nickel-selenium-based electrocatalyst and a conductive current collector, the nickel-selenium-based mesh electrode is of a three-dimensional structure integrating a self-supporting micro-nano array mesh structure and a mesh conductive current collector, wherein the self-supporting micro-nano array mesh structure is assembled by secondary crosslinking of nanosheets, and the preparation method of the nickel-selenium-based mesh electrode comprises the step of in-situ growth of a nickel-selenium-based electrocatalyst on the mesh conductive current collector. The prepared nickel-selenium-based mesh electrode is used for preparing hydrogen by decomposing water in alkaline and anion exchange membranes or seawater electrolysis cells. The nickel-selenium-based mesh electrode is of a three-dimensional structure, the three-dimensional mesh structure has high specific surface area and rich pores, has excellent mass transfer and bubble transfer characteristics, relieves concentration polarization, improves reaction efficiency, and provides a new thought for a new generation of electrolytic cell electrode design.

Title: Nickel-iron-cobalt-based self-supporting oxygen evolution electrode and preparation and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a nickel-iron-cobalt-based self-supporting oxygen evolution electrode and preparation and application thereof. A cleaned substrate nickel felt is soaked in a metal salt solution, taken out, subjected to vacuum drying and then reduced in a hydrogen atmosphere, and the self-supporting electrode can be prepared. The formed catalyst particles are in a nickel-iron-cobalt alloy state and grow in dense pores of the nickel fibers, and the unique self-supporting structure is beneficial to proceeding of the mass transfer process, reduction of charge transfer resistance and improvement of electrode stability. When the electrode is used for an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell, the current density is as high as 2.3 A cm <-2 > under the cell pressure of 2.0 V. During a durability test, the electrode maintains stability for more than 1400 hours at a current density of 1 A cm <-2 >. The preparation process does not need to use a binder, the production cost is reduced, and the catalyst is expected to be applied to the actual water electrolysis hydrogen production process due to excellent catalytic performance and durability.
Applicants: SHANGHAI QINGLUAN TECH CO LTD;;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

Title: Preparation method of perovskite-based catalyst membrane electrode assembly for producing hydrogen by electrolyzing water
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of electro-catalysis, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a perovskite-based catalyst membrane electrode assembly for producing hydrogen by electrolyzing water. The perovskite material is prepared by using a sol-gel method, the A site has a vacancy defect, and the B site is doped with reducible transitional metal. A perovskite material is prepared into catalyst printing ink, the catalyst printing ink is sprayed on the surface of foamed nickel, in-situ reduction is carried out in a tubular furnace, reducible metal is separated out from perovskite oxide crystal lattices, nano-particles are formed on the surface of the catalyst, a unique combination mode with a catalyst body exists, and good thermodynamic and chemical stability is shown. The metal nanoparticles are embedded into the metal structure of the perovskite material, so that the metal nanoparticles separated out from crystal lattices of the perovskite oxide show excellent stability and excellent catalytic performance. The invention provides a novel catalyst and a membrane electrode preparation method for an anion exchange membrane electrolytic tank, so that the water electrolysis hydrogen production efficiency is effectively improved, and the cost is reduced.

Title: Hydrogen production method for coupling preparation of azofurazan energetic material based on WS2/Pt composite catalyst
Abstract: The invention discloses a hydrogen production method for preparing an azofurazan energetic material by coupling based on a WS2/Pt composite catalyst, which comprises the following steps: placing a CC (at) Pt/WS2 electrode in a sodium carbonate solution, and placing a copper oxide nanowire electrode in an amino furazan-containing alkali solution; a CC (at) Pt/WS2 electrode is taken as a cathode, and a copper oxide nanowire electrode is taken as an anode, so that an H-type electrolysis system separated by an anion exchange membrane is formed; based on the H-type electrolysis system, cathode hydrogen production and anode 3, 3 '-diamino-4, 4'-azofurazan energetic material synthesis are achieved. According to the method, a reaction for synthesizing the 3, 3 '-diamino-4, 4'-azofurazan energetic material through electrochemical oxidation with a lower oxidation potential is used for replacing a traditional oxygen evolution reaction, and is coupled with water electrolysis hydrogen production, so that low-energy-consumption hydrogen production and green synthesis of the azofurazan energetic material can be realized.

Title: Preparation method of self-supporting nickel-based oxygen evolution electrode based on magnetron sputtering technology
Abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of a self-supporting nickel-based oxygen evolution electrode based on a magnetron sputtering technology, which comprises the following steps: selecting a nickel-based porous transmission layer as a base material, and improving the surface roughness of the base material by using the magnetron sputtering technology and a corrosion process. According to the self-supporting nickel-based oxygen evolution electrode prepared by the invention, the active area and the adhesive force of the catalyst layer are obviously enhanced; when the material is applied to an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell, the material shows excellent reaction activity and operation stability in an actual test link, and the technology can realize batch preparation, the process is mature, and the preparation process is simple and safe.
Applicants: HEFEI DONGLIANG SHOUHENG GREEN ENERGY CO LTD

Title: Preparation method and application of non-noble metal Ni-based oxygen evolution catalyst
Abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a non-noble metal Ni-based oxygen evolution catalyst. The catalyst provided by the invention comprises nickel selenide nanoparticles and graphene quantum dots loaded on the surfaces of the nickel selenide nanoparticles, wherein the mass ratio of the graphene quantum dots to the nickel selenide nanoparticles is (1-8): 50. The graphene quantum dots can be loaded on the surface of nickel selenide through a simple hydrothermal reaction, the preparation method is simple and convenient, the overpotential of an oxygen evolution reaction can be greatly reduced while the cost of the prepared catalyst is reduced, and the catalyst has relatively high electrochemical performance and stability in an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell and is suitable for industrial production. Wide application prospects are realized.

Title: AEM electrolytic cell assembly process and membrane electrode preparation method
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrogen energy equipment manufacturing, and discloses an AEM electrolytic cell assembly process and a membrane electrode preparation method, the preparation method comprises the following steps: S1, slurry preparation: respectively preparing anode slurry and cathode slurry; s2, diffusion layer treatment: soaking and cleaning the diffusion layer; and S3, slurry transfer: respectively and uniformly spraying cathode slurry and anode slurry on the diffusion layer treated in the S2 by using a spraying machine to obtain a catalyst layer/diffusion layer complex. S4, membrane pretreatment: carrying out soaking and cleaning treatment on the anion exchange membrane; s5, AEM groove assembly is carried out; and S6, testing the membrane electrode prepared in the step S5. In the membrane electrode preparation process, the catalyst utilization rate is increased by 40%, and the precious metal consumption is reduced by 30%. The qualified rate of the membrane electrode is increased from 75% to 95%, in addition, the overall performance of the membrane electrode reaches the current density (60 DEG C/1M KOH) of 1 A/cm under the voltage of 1.622 V, and the attenuation rate of 200 h is stabilized; 3%.
Applicants: ZHONGKE HANNENG ANHUI NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

Title: Testing method for real-time measurement of internal temperature field distribution of bipolar plate of AEM electrolytic cell
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of sensor monitoring, in particular to a testing method for real-time measurement of internal temperature field distribution of a bipolar plate of an AEM electrolytic bath, which comprises the following steps of: arranging a micro blind hole array aligned with a runner ridge part on the side, opposite to a membrane electrode, of the bipolar plate, and packaging an all-medium fluorescent temperature measurement probe at the bottom of the hole in situ; and a high-thermal-conductivity insulating medium is used for eliminating contact thermal resistance. Signals are led out to an external multi-dimensional signal demodulation unit through the multi-core optical fiber bundle and the pressure self-tightening sealing assembly. The central signal processing engine adopts a time-gated photon counting logic and differential noise suppression technology, captures a fluorescence decay characteristic time constant, inverts a distributed temperature field of an internal reaction zone of the bipolar plate, and realizes dynamic early warning of the health state of the anion exchange membrane in combination with a thermal degradation model. According to the invention, the problem that the temperature field in the electrolytic cell is difficult to accurately and nondestructively monitor in real time in high-voltage, strong-alkali and electromagnetic interference environments is solved, and data support is provided for thermal management and safe operation of the AEM electrolytic cell.
Applicants: CHANGZHOU QINGZHOU ENERGY TECH CO LTD

Title: Polyaryl-piperidine polymer electrolyte membrane, preparation method and application
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of high-molecular polymer membrane materials, and discloses a polyaryl-piperidine polymer electrolyte membrane, and a preparation method and application thereof. The raw materials comprise an aryl monomer and 1-benzyl-4-piperidinecarboxaldehyde, or the aryl monomer, the 1-benzyl-4-piperidinecarboxaldehyde and a branching agent. A benzyl-containing piperidinium molecular framework is designed, a piperidine ring is connected with a main chain through a flexible spacer, meanwhile, benzyl is connected to an N atom, and the benzyl has large steric hindrance, so that the stability of AEM under an alkaline condition, especially under a high-temperature and high-concentration severe condition, is effectively relieved. Branching agents such as triphenylbenzene are added into a main chain structure to enhance the mechanical property and alkali-resistant stability of the main chain structure, and the polymer electrolyte membrane with high conductivity, high mechanical property and high alkali resistance is prepared by adopting a simple solution casting method and is applied to AEMWE.

Title: NiFe-based LDH catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to the field of electro-catalysis, in particular to a NiFe-based LDH catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof. According to the preparation method provided by the invention, the NiFe-based LDH catalyst is innovatively prepared by using a simple one-step hydrothermal method under the condition that a pH regulator does not need to be additionally added, and charge sharing among NiFe LDH metals is induced by introducing metal M into NiFe LDH, so that the catalytic activity of the NiFe-based LDH catalyst is improved, and the catalytic activity of the NiFe-based LDH catalyst is improved. The reaction energy barrier is reduced, the active site is stabilized, the long-term stability of the catalyst in operation is enhanced while the alkaline OER reaction kinetics is promoted, the large current of the catalyst under the low electrolytic cell voltage condition in an AEMWE device is realized, and the long-term stable operation under the large current is realized; and when AEMWE water electrolysis is carried out for 4750 h under the large current of 500 mA/cm < 2 >, obvious attenuation is not found, and the commercial application prospect of the AEMWE water electrolysis technology is greatly improved.

Title: Electrolyzed water catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to the field of alkaline electrolyzed water, in particular to an electrolyzed water catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof. The electrolyzed water catalyst provided by the invention realizes successful doping of alkali metal, replaces atoms on the surface of a non-platinum metal cluster without changing the size of the cluster, realizes improvement of alkaline hydrogen evolution performance, and specifically, the alkali metal is doped with the non-Pt metal cluster, and the surface microenvironment of the catalyst is regulated and controlled, so that the hydrogen evolution performance is improved. Stronger interaction between alkali metal ions and interface water is utilized to promote water dissociation, so that improvement of alkaline hydrogen evolution kinetics is promoted, and long-term stable operation under high current is realized. According to the preparation method, the non-platinum metal cluster is successfully loaded on the nitrogen-doped carbon material by adopting a post-adsorption and one-step pyrolysis method, the metal loading capacity is reduced, the preparation method of the economical and effective AEMWE catalyst is provided, and the large-current and stable water electrolysis performance under low cell pressure is shown in an alkaline AEM electrolytic tank.

Title: High-performance nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide catalytic electrode, preparation method and application
Abstract: The invention discloses a high-performance nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide catalytic electrode, a preparation method and application, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: step 1, uniformly mixing a certain amount of nickel salt solution and a certain amount of iron salt solution respectively, and then putting an activated nickel-containing substrate material into the mixed solution; and 2, depositing at room temperature for a certain time to obtain the catalytic electrode with a ferro-nickel double-metal hydroxide oxygen evolution catalyst growing on the surface. The invention designs a synthesis method for normal-temperature in-situ growth of a nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide (NiFe-LDH) oxygen evolution catalyst on a nickel-containing substrate material, low-cost batch green synthesis with nearly 100% of raw material utilization rate, zero waste liquid and no size limitation is realized, and the obtained catalytic electrode has excellent oxygen evolution catalytic performance and long-time stability; the method can be directly applied to alkaline (ALK) electrolytic baths and anion exchange membrane (AEM) electrolytic baths, the cost of the ALK electrolytic baths and the AEM electrolytic baths is remarkably reduced, and the method has important industrial application value.
Applicants: MAT INST CHINA ACADEMY ENG PHYSICS

Title: Hydrogen-oxygen generating assembly and hydrogen-oxygen generating equipment
Abstract: The utility model discloses a hydrogen-oxygen generating assembly and hydrogen-oxygen generating equipment. The hydrogen and oxygen generating assembly comprises a mounting substrate and two electrolysis modules, and the mounting substrate is arranged between the two electrolysis modules; wherein a water inlet flow channel and a water outlet flow channel are formed in the mounting base plate, andthe water inlet flow channel and the water outlet flow channel respectively penetrate through the mounting base plate; wherein the electrolysis module comprises a positive plate, a negative plate, anion exchange membrane and a titanium mesh, the ion exchange membrane is arranged between the positive plate and the negative plate, a first water permeable hole and a second water permeable hole are formed in the positive plate, the titanium mesh is arranged between the positive plate and the ion exchange membrane, and the titanium mesh is arranged between the negative plate and the ion exchange membrane. The titanium mesh covers the first water permeable hole and the second water permeable hole and forms a water flowing gap between the positive plate and the ion exchange membrane; the first water-permeable hole is communicated with the water inlet flow channel, and the second water-permeable hole is communicated with the water outlet flow channel. The hydrogen output of the hydrogen-oxygen generating assembly is improved.

Title: Ferronickel-based oxygen evolution electrode and preparation method thereof based on interface confinement
Abstract: The invention provides a ferronickel-based oxygen evolution electrode and a preparation method thereof based on interface confinement. The preparation method of the ferronickel-based oxygen evolution electrode comprises the following steps: preparing a precursor solution containing ferrous ions and ferric ions; the foamed nickel substrate is cleaned; the cleaned foamed nickel is tightly attached to the surface of the bottom of the reaction container, the foamed nickel is immersed in the precursor solution, under the room-temperature standing condition, divalent and trivalent iron ions are induced to be subjected to a synergistic hydrolysis and coprecipitation reaction through a physical interface confinement space formed by an attached interface, and the nickel-based composite material is obtained. Therefore, a high-activity and high-uniformity nickel-iron-based (oxygen) hydroxide catalyst layer (DIC-NiFeOOH/NF) is grown on the surface of the foamed nickel in situ. The method is simple in process, green and energy-saving, and the prepared nickel-iron-based oxygen evolution electrode shows excellent performance in oxygen evolution reaction and anion exchange membrane water electrolysis.
Applicants: SUQIAN LYUNENG HYDROGEN TECH CO LTD

Title: Preparation method of self-supporting anode catalyst, catalyst and application thereof
Abstract: The invention provides a preparation method of a self-supporting anode catalyst, the catalyst and application of the catalyst, and relates to the technical field of electrolyzed water oxygen evolution catalysts.The method comprises the steps that a foamed ferronickel substrate is provided and pretreated; immersing the pretreated foamed ferronickel substrate into the first precursor solution for standing reaction, forming a transition metal sulfide layer on the surface of the substrate through in-situ growth, and washing and drying to obtain an intermediate product; and placing the intermediate product in a second precursor solution for hydrothermal reaction, and growing on the surface of the transition metal sulfide layer to form a layered double hydroxide catalyst layer, thereby obtaining the self-supporting anode catalyst with a three-layer structure of layered double hydroxide, transition metal oxide and foamed ferronickel. According to the invention, the problems of weak binding force between a non-noble metal anode catalyst layer and a substrate and poor stability under high current density can be effectively solved, so that high-activity, high-stability and long-life oxygen evolution reaction in an alkaline or anion exchange membrane electrolysis water system can be realized.
Applicants: CHENGDU DRAINAGE CO LTD;;TIANFU YONGXING LABORATORY

Title: Selenium vacancy-containing high-entropy selenide catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a selenium vacancy-containing high-entropy selenide catalyst as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The catalyst is prepared from a nickel-based base material and a high-entropy selenide on the surface of the nickel-based base material, wherein the high-entropy selenide is (FeCoNiVCrMn) Se < 2 >. According to the method, Fe, Co, Ni, V, Cr and Mn metal salts are prepared into a mixed precursor solution, a multi-metal precursor layer is formed on the surface of a nickel-based substrate through electro-deposition, and then Joule heating rapid annealing is adopted in the presence of an inert atmosphere and a selenium source, so that high-entropy selenylation and Se vacancy construction are realized. In the catalyst, Se vacancy can promote water molecule activation and improve hydrogen evolution performance; in the oxygen evolution process, the surface of the catalyst is subjected to in-situ reconstruction to form a high-entropy hydroxide active phase, and a SeO4 < 2-> interface layer is synchronously generated/anchored and used for regulating reaction intermediate adsorption and inhibiting metal dissolution and Cl <-> corrosion. The catalyst is suitable for alkaline seawater electrolysis and anion exchange membrane full-water decomposition devices, and has high activity, high stability and excellent corrosion resistance.

Title: Composite bifunctional catalyst based on perovskite as well as preparation method and application of composite bifunctional catalyst
Abstract: The invention provides a perovskite composite difunctional (oxygen evolution and hydrogen evolution) catalyst with rich active sites. The perovskite composite difunctional (oxygen evolution and hydrogen evolution) catalyst is composed of a main phase perovskite oxide substrate with electrochemical activity and a nanosheet proton conductor beta-NaFeO2 with excellent proton affinity. A two-step self-assembly strategy is adopted for preparation of the composite catalyst, and formation of a high-energy interface between two phases is ensured, so that an electronic structure between a perovskite substrate and a proton conductor is effectively adjusted, and multiple active sites beneficial to oxygen evolution and hydrogen evolution reaction are induced. On one hand, the formed two-phase high-energy interface is helpful for exciting lattice oxygen on the surface of the catalyst to participate in oxygen evolution reaction, so that the lattice oxygen is induced to participate in an oxygen evolution reaction mechanism; the deprotonation rate of an oxygen evolution reaction and the water splitting rate of a hydrogen evolution reaction are accelerated through the cooperation of the composite material and a proton conductor, so that the oxygen evolution and hydrogen evolution performance of the composite material is greatly improved, and the composite material has a good application prospect in the field of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production.

Title: Porous transmission layer and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of anion exchange membrane electrolysis, in particular to a porous transmission layer and a preparation method thereof.The preparation method comprises the following steps that a porous transmission layer base material is selected, the porous transmission layer base material comprises an inner-layer nickel net and an outer-layer nickel net, and the inner-layer nickel net and the outer-layer nickel net are subjected to ultrasonic cleaning; performing etching treatment on the outer-layer nickel net subjected to ultrasonic cleaning to obtain a porous transmission layer base material subjected to etching treatment; carrying out multi-stage cleaning treatment on the etched porous transmission layer base material; and carrying out drying treatment on the porous transmission layer base material subjected to the multi-stage cleaning treatment to obtain the porous transmission layer. According to the preparation method, the inner layer and the outer layer of the porous transmission layer base material are subjected to differentiated treatment, so that the inner layer keeps the original structure to ensure the interface stability, the surface appearance of the outer layer is optimized through accurate acid etching, and the interface contact performance and the mass transfer efficiency of the porous transmission layer prepared through the preparation method are greatly improved.

Title: Dibenzofuran-containing polyaryl suspended side chain type anionic polymer
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of macromolecules, and particularly discloses a dibenzofuran-containing polyaryl suspended side chain type anionic polymer, which successfully overcomes the defect that a main chain of a traditional polyarylether material is easy to break and degrade under a strong alkali condition by introducing a dibenzofuran structure, improves the chemical stability and the thermal stability of the material, and has a good application prospect. A benzene ring, quaternary ammonium or piperidine cation group is introduced by utilizing a side chain suspension strategy, microphase separation in the polymer is effectively promoted, and an efficient ion transmission channel can be constructed, so that the membrane material has good hydroxyl ion conductivity which can be up to 170.2 mS/cm at the temperature of 80 DEG C while a relatively low swelling rate is maintained, and the membrane material can be widely applied to the field of membrane materials. The polymer shows excellent mechanical properties, the tensile strength of a dry film is excellent, the alkali-resistant durability is excellent, and the conductivity loss is small when the polymer is soaked in a strong alkali (KOH) solution at 80 DEG C for more than 1800 hours. The anion exchange membrane prepared by the invention has good application value in the fields of fuel cells, water electrolysis hydrogen production and the like, and shows strong commercial potential.

Title: PtRu-based nanocage catalyst based on chromium regulation and control as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a PtRu-based nanocage catalyst based on chromium regulation and a preparation method and application thereof, and the method comprises the following steps: (1) introducing a ruthenium precursor, a platinum precursor and a chromium precursor into a ZIF-8 metal organic framework material, and carrying out reaction adsorption loading to form a multi-metal precursor/ZIF-8 compound with a hollow porous nanocage structure; (2) carrying out heat treatment on the multi-metal precursor/ZIF-8 compound in a hydrogen-containing reducing atmosphere to obtain a PtRuCrZnO intermediate; and (3) removing ZnO in the PtRuCrZnO intermediate by adopting an acidic etching solution, so as to obtain the PtRu-based nanocage catalyst. The obtained catalyst is particularly suitable for an AEMWE system, and a technical scheme capable of being implemented on a large scale is provided for constructing a low-precious-metal-loaded and high-efficiency water electrolysis hydrogen production catalytic material.

Title: Low-Ru alkaline HER electrocatalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electrocatalysts, and discloses a low-Ru alkaline HER electrocatalyst and a preparation method and application thereof. The low-Ru alkaline HER electrocatalyst comprises an M-N-C substrate formed by anchoring metal M on nitrogen-doped carbon at a single point location, and Ru uniformly distributed on the M-N-C substrate, wherein the metal M comprises at least one of Ga, In, Sn or Sb. According to the low-Ru alkaline HER electrocatalyst, metal M is anchored on nitrogen-doped carbon (N-C) in a unit point form to form M-N-C, Ru is uniformly distributed on an M-N-C carrier in the form of clusters of about 2 nm, and strong catalyst-carrier interaction is generated between the Ru clusters and the M-N-C due to interaction between Ru and M. Meanwhile, Ru-H adsorption can be optimized, and the oxophilic M further enhances the water dissociation capacity, so that the alkaline HER performance is improved. The Ru content of the electrocatalyst is low, the Ru loading capacity at the cathode of an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell is only about 0.08 mg cm <-2 >, and the cost is greatly reduced while the catalytic activity is guaranteed.
Applicants: BEIJING DONGQING XINNENG TECH CO LTD

Title: Off-line activation device for electrolyzed water membrane electrode
Abstract: The utility model relates to the field of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production, and provides an off-line activation device of an electrolysis water membrane electrode, which comprises an alkali liquor storage tank, a non-alkali liquor storage tank, a pure water storage tank and a plurality of membrane electrode activation units, each membrane electrode activation unit comprises a cathode chamber and an anode chamber, and a membrane electrode is arranged between the cathode chamber and the anode chamber; an inlet of the cathode chamber is communicated with a cathode liquid inlet pipeline, and one end, far away from the cathode chamber, of the cathode liquid inlet pipeline is communicated with an alkali liquor storage tank and a non-alkali liquor storage tank; an outlet of the cathode chamber is communicated with an alkali liquor outlet branch and a non-alkali liquor outlet branch, one end, far away from the cathode chamber, of the alkali liquor outlet branch is communicated with an alkali liquor storage tank, and one end, far away from the cathode chamber, of the non-alkali liquor outlet branch is communicated with a non-alkali liquor storage tank; the pure water storage tank is communicated with the anode chamber; an alkali liquor inlet valve is arranged on the alkali liquor inlet branch; a non-alkali liquid inlet valve is arranged on the non-alkali liquid inlet branch; an alkali liquor outlet valve is arranged on the alkali liquor outlet branch; a non-alkali liquor outlet valve is arranged on the non-alkali liquor outlet branch; and an anode liquid inlet valve is arranged on the anode liquid inlet pipeline. The method has the advantage of improving activation efficiency.
Applicants: HONGJI CHUANGNENG TECH GUANGZHOU CO LTD

Title: PtRu nanocage as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a PtRu nanocage and a preparation method and application thereof, and the method comprises the following steps: (1) adsorbing ruthenium chloride and chloroplatinic acid to ZIF-8 to form a PtRu ZIF-8 composite material; (2) performing high-temperature calcination on the PtRu-ZIF-8 composite material in a hydrogen-argon reducing atmosphere to reduce the PtRu-ZIF-8 composite material into metal Ru and Pt, and forming an intermetallic compound by Zn generated by decomposition of ZIF-8, Ru and Pt to obtain a PtRuZn composite material; and (3) selectively etching the PtRuZn composite material by using a hydrochloric acid solution to remove Zn so as to obtain the PtRu nanocage with the cage-shaped structure. The method is easy and convenient to operate, the catalytic activity can be remarkably improved, and the Pt dosage can be greatly reduced. The material is suitable for AEMWE, and a new solution is provided for developing a low-cost and high-stability water electrolysis hydrogen production technology.

Title: NiMoO4-coated NiFe (OH) x hierarchical structure catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention provides a NiMoO4-coated NiFe (OH) x hierarchical structure catalyst as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the catalyst comprises the following steps: removing oil stain and an oxide layer on the surface of foamed nickel; the preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving nickel nitrate and ammonium molybdate in deionized water, putting the solution and foamed nickel into a high-pressure reaction kettle for hydrothermal reaction, and growing NiMoO4 on a foamed nickel substrate in situ; after the reaction is finished, cleaning and drying to obtain foamed nickel loaded with NiMoO4; soaking the Fe-NiMoO4-loaded nickel foam in a ferric salt solution to obtain Fe-NiMoO4-loaded nickel foam; and soaking the NiMoO4-coated NiFe (OH) x catalyst in alkali liquor, cleaning and drying to obtain the NiMoO4-coated NiFe (OH) x hierarchical structure catalyst. The preparation method is simple and safe, large-scale production can be achieved, and the prepared catalyst has a three-dimensional hierarchical structure and shows excellent catalytic performance and stability in a three-electrode system and an AEMWE electrolytic cell.
Applicants: SUQIAN LYUNENG HYDROGEN TECH CO LTD
